It adds new eligible activities for teacher training, staff hiring and parental support, sets fixed hourly rates, and requires a mandate for applications by po-schools.

It sets application windows, a required activity plan and joint signatures by competent authorities, obligations to cooperate with monitoring and knowledge-sharing, a 100% advance payment, and a reporting deadline of 13 February 2026.

The draft is open for public comment for six weeks, and 39 manufacturer requests under Article 3(2) Wgp are granted, removing maximum prices for those products for two years.

This ministerial regulation sets the 2025 fee bands and rates for supervision costs (bekostiging financieel toezicht) charged to firms supervised by the AFM and DNB, including credit providers, accountancy firms, investment firms, banks, payment institutions, pension funds and insurers. It fixes fixed amounts and per-unit rates based on metrics such as client numbers, turnover, balance sheet totals and premium income.
Besluit bekostiging financieel toezicht 2019 artikel 9, eerste lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending regulation tightens and clarifies the SLIM subsidy rules for training within sectoral development paths, including new definitions for employer and training provider, exclusion of training bought from related organisations, a per-applicant cap of EUR 100,000 per year, and a requirement for partner-party declarations on collective applications. It also adjusts budgets, application windows and decision deadlines, and adds a transitional provision keeping the previous rules for applications submitted before entry into force.

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling aanwijzing luchtruim en luchtverkeersdienstverleners BES to formally set the airspace classes for Caribbean Netherlands airspace parts, to apply the Flamingo ATZ with defined hours, and to make several technical updates and corrections. It also updates the annex of air traffic routes and procedures, effective 1 July 2025.
Besluit luchtverkeer BES 2, derde lid, 3, 70, eerste lid en 74, eerste lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This amending regulation updates the Subsidy Scheme for Continuity of Critical Youth Care to transfer the tasks of the Youth Authority (Jeugdautoriteit) to the Netherlands Authority for Healthcare Markets (NZa) from 1 January 2026. It also replaces the Youth Authority definition with the NZa, applies the NZa as the authority named in the scheme, and lowers the 2026 subsidy ceiling from €20 million to €14.6 million.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation changes the start of supplementary funding for newcomer students in secondary education from arrival in the Netherlands to the first school enrolment date, and redefines the first and second newcomer categories accordingly. It also requires schools to keep proof (such as an enrolment form or COA email) when newcomers are enrolled under an onderwijsnummer, and clarifies the validation and recalculation of funding.

This regulation amends the LFNP functiebeschrijving of Senior GGP (a police job grade) to add the role of praktijkbegeleider (practical trainer for new police officers) to the list of roles that certified and designated holders may perform. It is a minor technical change to the police job-classification annex, agreed with police unions in the CGOP.
Besluit bezoldiging politie artikel 6, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Subsidieregeling instituten voor toegepast onderzoek by updating ministry names, adding the Minister of Klimaat en Groene Groei as a competent minister, and redefining the WOT Modellen, applicaties en data theme. It also raises the 2024 and 2025 subsidy ceilings for applied research institutes such as Deltares, MARIN and NLR. The changes are largely technical and administrative, with no new obligations or sanctions for citizens.
Kaderwet EZK- en LNV-subsidies 3; Kaderwet subsidies I en M 3
Ministerie van Landbouw, Visserij, Voedselzekerheid en Natuur

This amending regulation adjusts the young farmer establishment subsidy module so that farm takeovers under regular tenancy (reguliere pacht) or perpetual leasehold (erfpacht) qualify, and adds definitions of farm, tenancy and starting a farm. It also moves the 1 January 2023 cut-off into a clearer condition and makes the control-over-property wording cover these tenancy forms.

verordening (EU) 2021/2115 (strategische GLB-plannen) not specified; verordening (EU) 2021/2116 (financiering, beheer en monitoring van het GLB) not specified; Kaderwet EZK- en LNV-subsidies artikel 3; Landbouwwet artikelen 13, 15 en 19

This subsidy regulation sets rules for grants to volunteer organisations that support detainees and former detainees (justitiabelen) in re-integration activities during 2026–2028, with an annual budget of €4,299,260 indexed for wage adjustments. It defines eligible activities, refusal grounds, volunteer screening (VOG no older than four years), co-financing obligations, and reporting and audit requirements.
Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening

This amending regulation extends the experimental rules allowing housing corporations to sell homes to housing cooperatives at a discount of up to 50% of market value, changing the end date from 1 July 2025 to 1 January 2028. The explanatory note justifies using the maximum five-year experiment duration because uptake has been low and banks are now more open to financing.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This amending regulation changes the Regeling ambulancezorgvoorzieningen so that emergency call triage at the ambulance dispatch centre may be performed by ambulance care professionals meeting the competencies in a sector quality framework, not only by registered nurses under the BIG Act. It also updates the definitions of minister and response time accordingly.

This ministerial regulation fills in detailed rules under the Wet bemanning zeeschepen and the Besluit bemanning zeeschepen on manning ships, covering crew plans, nationality exemptions for captains, monsterboekjes (seafarer record books), and certificates of competency. It sets out technical content, required documents, fees-related procedures, and exemptions for specific vessel types such as garnalenkotters and schelpdiervaartuigen.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation adds an article creating supplementary funding for schools for practical education (pro) to provide additional career guidance to school leavers, at EUR 30.37 per enrolled pupil for 2025 and 2026. It also sets the 2025 payment to be fixed by November 2025 on verified pupil numbers, with no revision.
Wet voortgezet onderwijs 2020 5.9, eerste lid; Uitvoeringsbesluit WVO 2020 6.1, vierde lid
Ministerie van Landbouw, Visserij, Voedselzekerheid en Natuur

The regulation extends by three years, from 1 July 2025 to 1 July 2028, the temporary exemption allowing removal of part of the hind toe in breeding roosters in the meat-breeding sector. It also makes technical corrections to the Regeling diergeneeskundigen, such as updating an article reference and removing an expired exemption for ear-marking pigs.
Wet dieren 7.5, eerste lid, en 10.1, eerste lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling genetisch gemodificeerde organismen milieubeheer 2013 by adding one host organism (Talaromyces derxii) to list A1 of annex 2 and updating pathogenicity-class entries for several viruses in annex 4. It is a technical update to keep the annexes aligned with current scientific knowledge, taking effect on 1 July 2025.
Besluit genetisch gemodificeerde organismen milieubeheer 2013 2.2, eerste lid en 2.10, eerste lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Subsidy Regulation of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs 2006 to set out a new Section 4 that allows subsidies for building the capacity of civil society organisations in low- and middle-income countries, targeting eight thematic policy goals such as HIV/AIDS, harmful practices, women's economic empowerment, and LGBTIQ+ and religious minority rights. It also renames 'ontwikkelingssamenwerking' to 'ontwikkelingshulp' in the regulation's headings and adds a transitional provision keeping the old Section 4 in force for earlier subsidies.
Kaderwet subsidies Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken 3, eerste lid; Subsidiebesluit Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken 2
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending regulation adds a fourth application window to the financial education subsidy scheme for schools, open to mbo, vo and po institutions in mainland Netherlands, with €10 million available split across sectors (4:3:2) and subsidy bounds per sector. It also updates application periods, project periods, exclusions of previously funded schools and Nationaal Programma Leefbaarheid en Veiligheid po-schools, and removes references to Caribbean Netherlands.

The decision amends the Nationaal Frequentieplan 2014 to change the allocation of the remaining digital radio spectrum in the 174-230 MHz band (layer 6) for commercial broadcasters from auction or comparative selection to first-come, first-served, on the ground that scarcity no longer exists. It also deletes footnotes HOL004, HOL005, HOL006 and HOL006A and replaces footnote HOL007 with a list of frequency blocks reserved for digital radio broadcasting.
Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei

This ministerial regulation makes technical corrections to the VEKI industrial climate-investment subsidy module: it expressly excludes costs not capitalised and charged directly to the profit and loss account, lowers the electricity CO2 emission factor from 0.29 to 0.14 kg CO2/kWh, and removes the cap of five milestones per project. It is justified as correcting errors from a previous amending regulation and takes effect the day after publication.
Kaderbesluit nationale EZK- en LNV-subsidies artikel 4 en artikel 15
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

A Minister of Education, Culture and Science decision restricts public access to the archive of the Higher Education Appeals Tribunal (College van Beroep voor het Hoger Onderwijs) for 1971–2011, with a long list of inventory numbers made accessible only from 2060–2070 onward to protect personal privacy. Access or reproduction of the restricted files requires prior written permission from the Chief National Archivist, who may attach conditions.
Archiefwet 1995 artikel 15, lid 1, onder a en b; Archiefbesluit 1995 artikel 10

This joint arrangement under Article 38 of the Charter for the Kingdom formally withdraws the 2006 protocol on guardianship cooperation between the Netherlands and the former Netherlands Antilles, which required temporary guardians for minors from the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom moving to European Netherlands. It ends the special guardianship regime, citing digital communication tools and the lack of objective justification for geographic differentiation, so minors from these territories are treated like those from other independent countries.
Statuut voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden 38, eerste lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation sets rules for subsidies to mbo instructors (and their employers) for bachelor or associate degree study, covering tuition, study materials, travel and study leave for the 2025 calendar year with a budget of EUR 800,000. It sets eligibility criteria, application windows, a first-come-first-served allocation, repayment grounds and a sunset on 1 January 2026.
Wet overige OCW-subsidies 4 en 5; Kaderregeling subsidies OCW, SZW en VWS 1.3
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation amends the Regeling zorgverzekering to temporarily include selumetinib (Koselugo) in the basic health insurance package for symptomatic, inoperable plexiform neurofibromas in paediatric NF1 patients aged three and over, with effect from 1 January 2028 per the amended Bijlage 0 entry. The explanatory note explains that this lifts the earlier 'sluis' exclusion following a financial arrangement with the supplier and that the inclusion is time-limited.

This decree makes electronic filing mandatory for professional legal representatives (curators, bewindvoerders, mentors with three or more protégés) in communications with the kantonrechter in curatele, bewind and mentorschap cases, effective 1 January 2026. It does not impose new information duties but requires existing filings to be made through the electronic channel.
Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering 33, tweede lid; Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 1 383, achtste lid; 435, achtste lid; 452, achtste lid

This amending decree (AMvB) modifies the Binnenvaartpolitiereglement, the Scheepvaartreglement territoriale zee and the Besluit administratieve bepalingen scheepvaartverkeer to add rules for LNG-fuelled vessels, shore power obligations, testing of highly automated vessels, and to correct outdated references. It replaces references to the Rhine ship inspection regulation with ES-TRIN and makes various technical adjustments to signs, lights, mooring rules and water lists.

This year-end decree amends numerous implementing tax decrees, including income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, transfer tax, VAT, car and motorcycle taxes, and environmental taxes, mainly with technical adjustments such as tables, deadlines, definitions and exemption conditions. It also introduces new rules on the reporting of pension and lifetime annuity data and on exemptions for ambulances and hearses.

This decree implements the Wet minimumbelasting 2024 by setting detailed rules on qualifying income, election options, calculation of covered taxes, the effective tax rate, safe harbours and transitional rules for the global minimum tax. It elaborates administrative guidance from the OECD Inclusive Framework and applies retroactively to fiscal years beginning on or after 31 December 2023.
Wet minimumbelasting 2024 6.2, derde en vierde lid, 7.2, zesde lid, 7.3, tiende lid, 7.5, tiende lid, 8.3, zesde lid, 8.13, zesde en zevende lid en 14.1, zesde lid
Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening

This amending decree (Besluit, Staatsblad 2024) makes several changes to the Besluit toegelaten instellingen volkshuisvesting 2015, covering capital contributions to affiliated entities, the income threshold differentiation for multi-person households extended to 2030, administrative services, income proof for family reunification, and novation of base-rate loans. It mainly loosens rules for housing associations and extends a temporary higher DAEB income limit for multi-person households.
Woningwet 1, eerste lid, 21a, derde lid, 35, eerste en tweede lid, 36, eerste lid, 45, zevende lid, aanhef en onderdeel c, 46, tweede lid, 47, tweede lid, 55a, tweede lid en 104a, tweede lid

This AMvB annually indexes the national fine amounts in the Besluit bestuurlijke boete overlast in de openbare ruimte by raising most fines by EUR 5 to EUR 10 (and some by EUR 20 or EUR 60 increments) to match prosecutorial fines for the same offences from 1 February 2025. It makes no policy changes; it only aligns amounts with the Openbaar Ministerie's Tekstenbundel.

This amending decree to the Besluit energie vervoer lifts the exclusion so that supplied biofuels and renewable fuels for aviation and shipping can again be credited in the register, lowers the saving limits for renewable fuel units (from 25 to 10 percent for obligated suppliers, 10 to 4 percent for credit holders, and the maximum from 2,000 to 1,000 units), and adds certification requirements and a new credit-holder category for hydrogen supplied by container to inland and sea vessels. It also deletes the verification provisions and makes technical adjustments, with effect from 1 January 2025 and retroactive where publication is late.
Wet milieubeheer 9.7.1.2, tweede lid, 9.7.4.4, eerste lid, 9.7.5.6, tweede lid, en 9.8.4.6, tweede lid

This AMvB amends the Besluit elektronische deponering handelsregister so that large legal entities and certain medium-sized subsidiaries must deposit their annual reports electronically via SBR from financial years starting on or after 1 January 2025, and allows the SBR standard to support the EU ESEF format. It also removes most exemptions, extends the online self-deposit service to all legal entities, and takes effect on 1 January 2026.
Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening

This amending decree extends by one year, to 1 January 2026, the transitional rule allowing public authorities to publish omgevingsbesluiten using the older RO-standards (IMRO) instead of the Omgevingswet standards, with narrower scope from 2025 and rules for completing procedures begun earlier. It also exempts those acts from certain publication-consolidation duties until 2032.
Bekendmakingswet 16, eerste en tweede lid, en 19, eerste en tweede lid; Omgevingswet 16.139, eerste lid

This decree amends the Activities Living Environment, Quality Living Environment and Environment Decree to require operators to report emissions of very hazardous substances (ZZS) through an electronic formulier and database, and to create a public ZZS emissions register, whose entry into force is conditional on a later evaluation. It also adds a technical rule on expiry of noise production ceilings on provincial roads and a rule on storage of consumer fireworks.
Omgevingswet 2.24, eerste lid, 4.3, eerste lid, 16.1, tweede en derde lid, 16.139, 20.6, eerste lid, en 20.10; Aanvullingswet geluid Omgevingswet 3.2a, eerste lid, onder a
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This AMvB amends the annex to the Uitvoeringsbesluit Ambtenarenwet 2017 to update the oath and pledge (eed- en belofteformulieren) texts for national, provincial, municipal, water board, joint-arrangement and ZBO civil servants. It adds, replaces and deletes numerous municipal, provincial and waterschap formulas and takes effect on 1 January 2025.

This decree amends the 2011 Besluit that fixes the liability limits of air carriers under the Montreal Convention, raising the per-kilogram cargo limit from 22 to 26 units of account and the passenger death/injury and delay/baggage limits by the ICAO inflation factor of 17.9 percent. The new amounts apply only to damage occurring after entry into force on 28 December 2024.

This amending decree to the Besluit politiegegevens implements EU Directive 2023/977 on information exchange between law enforcement authorities by revising the grounds for refusing or conditioning onward transmission of police data to other EU member states and by correcting two drafting omissions. It also corrects the heading of paragraph 5 and extends the applicable provisions of article 5:1 to article 5:3.
Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei

This amendment to the Warmtebesluit changes how the maximum heat tariff is calculated: operational costs of a central heating boiler are based on average maintenance contracts, and real increases in gas energy tax are excluded from the gas reference price from 2025. It also introduces averaging of gas contract prices over September to November of the prior year, effective 1 January 2026.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amendment to the Besluit register onderwijsdeelnemers allows the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment to receive a student's personal number and basic education-register data, on request, to administer subsidies under the Kaderwet SZW-subsidies aimed at strengthening labour-market position through training, initially the praktijkleren subsidy in the third learning pathway. It adds a new paragraph to article 39 and a corresponding column in the annex table specifying which data fields are shared.

This decree designates the AFM and De Nederlandsche Bank as competent authorities under the EU crypto-asset regulation MiCA, sets which articles they can enforce by periodic penalty or administrative fine and the fine categories, and allows temporary disqualification of executives. It also amends the Wwft implementing rules to extend anti-money-laundering obligations to crypto-asset service providers under the transfer-of-funds regulation TFR and removes the old registration regime.

This amending decree adds rules to the Besluit dierlijke producten requiring qualified persons (gekwalificeerde personen) who examine shot game for human consumption to register in a ministerial register with personal and training-certificate data, and to report refresher training. It also lets the minister strike registrations and lays down data-sharing with Benelux authorities and the training body, with further rules left to a ministerial regulation.

This decree amends article 35(1) of the Uitvoeringsbesluit Meststoffenwet so that all farmers, not only certain groups, must annually supply data from their administration to the minister, exclusively electronically. It implements a condition of the EU derogation decision requiring the electronic manure register to be mandatory for all agricultural holdings from 1 January 2025.

This amending decree lowers the statutory interest rate (wettelijke rente) under Book 6 of the Dutch Civil Code from 7 to 6 percent with effect from 1 January 2025. The rate is set by the existing calculation method, based on the ECB base refinancing rate plus a 2.25 percent margin, rounded to the nearest half percent.

Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening

It also updates Bijlage II of the regulation, which lists the referenced standards and publications, to reflect the new calculation method versions.
Omgevingswet 2.24, tweede lid, onder b, en 4.3, vierde lid

This amending decree (Wijzigingsbesluit financiële markten 2024) makes various technical and some substantive changes to financial-sector decrees, including new procedural requirements for schadeverzekeraars handling letselschade (personal injury claims) and conditions on appointments at dispute-resolution bodies. It also corrects references, fine categories and implementation details across several related regulations.

Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

The decree amends the Mediabesluit 2008 to fix the maximum share of advertising and teleshopping at 8 percent of the public broadcaster's programme offer from 2025, dropping the planned step-down to 5 percent, and deletes article 29c. It also doubles the maximum association reserve for broadcasting associations from EUR 750,000 to EUR 1,500,000.
Mediawet 2008 2.95, eerste lid, aanhef en onder a; 2.174a, eerste lid; 9.14e, eerste lid

This decree amends the Besluit tenuitvoerlegging strafrechtelijke beslissingen to add a new title on suspension of prison sentences (strafonderbreking), harmonising rules for adults and young offenders previously set out in ministerial regulations. It lets the Minister grant temporary or indefinite suspension in exceptional personal circumstances, with conditions, balancing interests and a three-month maximum for temporary suspension.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

It also withdraws the old Warenwetbesluit provisions and designates NVWA and ACM as supervisors.

This AMvB amends the Besluit tarieven in strafzaken 2003 to index for 2025 the fee rates for Pro Justitia rapporteurs (by 5.263%) and the minimum hourly rate for interpreters. It applies to assignments given on or after 1 January 2025 and enters into force on that date.

This Besluit implements the Wet gegevensverwerking door samenwerkingsverbanden, setting out detailed rules for contact points handling data-subject rights, data quality, nationality data, inter-partnership data exchange, the rechtmatigheidsadviescommissie, retention limits, training and audits, and specific rules for the Financieel Expertisecentrum and Infobox Crimineel en Onverklaarbaar Vermogen. It also fixes the entry-into-force date of the Wet and of the 2024 amending Wet on parliamentary involvement in designating other partnerships.

Tabaks- en rookwarenwet artikel 2, achtste en negende lid

It also updates fine amounts and references in the Warenwetbesluit bestuurlijke boeten and corrects an erroneous date reference in the Warenwetbesluit attractie- en speeltoestellen 2023.
Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening

This amending decree to the Besluit bouwwerken leefomgeving extends mandatory CO2 meters to all primary and secondary school buildings, tightens dry fire-hose standpipe requirements (double connections in new buildings, for example), and revises accessibility rules for building entrances and ramps. This AMvB sets a uniform fee of EUR 300 that central government administrative bodies may charge for processing claims for damages from lawful government action (nadeelcompensatie), payable within four weeks of filing, effective 1 January 2025. This Decree sets the 2020 amounts of decentralisation and integration grants paid to municipalities and provinces, listed in three annexes covering specific programmes such as anti-discrimination, literacy, teacher shortages, homelessness and sport coaches. It also extends Bedrijventerrein 't Veen's boundary and adds a cost-recovery experiment there, with a deadline of 1 January 2024.

This ministerial regulation sets the rules for the national budget and accountability of the Dutch central government for 2022, incorporated by reference to an online annex, and repeals the 2021 version. It also fixes the amounts above which the Minister of Finance must notify parliament in writing of intended private-law transactions such as founding companies or providing equity.

Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This rectification corrects an error in the Staatscourant publication of the 8 July 2021 amendment to the Temporary subsidy scheme for childcare financing in Caribbean Netherlands (COVID-19). It fixes the wording of the amendment instruction in article I, part E, point 2, extending a deadline to 1 December 2021 or four months after subsidy award.

This regulation sets out the substance conditions (office holders resident in the recipient's state, qualified staff, bank accounts, bookkeeping, a minimum wage-cost amount weighted by a residence-state factor, and a 24-month office) under which a royalty or interest recipient is presumed not to be abusing the withholding tax anti-abuse rule, unless the inspector proves otherwise. It also contains an annex table of residence-state factors and an explanatory note on the anti-abuse framework.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This Decree sets rules for the municipal registration system that issues registration numbers for tourist rental of residential space under the Huisvestingswet 2014. It requires the system to be operational before the registration obligation takes effect and specifies identification, data fields, a randomly generated non-traceable number format, free issuance, and deletion procedures.

This amendment to the Besluit bestuurlijke boete overlast in de openbare ruimte updates the fixed municipal administrative fine amounts for public-nuisance offences and aligns them with the criminal fines in the Tekstenbundel from 1 January 2021. It mainly indexes amounts by a few euros, changes some offence descriptions, and adds one new prostitution-related offence (A.41a) at €250.

This Besluit amends three Dutch aviation decrees to implement EU rules on unmanned aircraft (drones) under Regulation 2018/1139, Delegated Regulation 2019/945 and Implementing Regulation 2019/947, which apply from 31 December 2020. It designates the minister as competent authority, lets the minister designate entities and conformity assessment bodies, sets transitional rules until 1 January 2022 for existing permits, and delegates zoning and further rules to ministerial regulation.

The regulation designates the Dienst Wegverkeer (RDW) as the competent authority under article 17(1) of EU Implementing Regulation 2019/947 for issuing online theory-exam completion certificates and remote pilot competence certificates, maintaining pilot records, and operating a registration system for UAS operators. It assigns these tasks because the RDW has the registry and document-handling expertise, while the ILT declined them after its own feasibility test.

This Aanvullingsbesluit amends several executive regulations under the Omgevingswet to set noise rules for roads, railways and industrial sites, including new noise-sensitive building definitions, standard and limit values, and rules for noise production ceilings as environmental values. It also sets out how authorities must achieve these ceilings, with exceptions and transitional arrangements.

Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends the Temporary COVID-19 measures regulation to add article 6.7a, requiring public transport operators to carry only international passengers arriving from abroad who can show a negative PCR test no more than 72 hours old. It sets exemptions for domestic and short regional cross-border trips, children up to 12, travellers from non-high-risk countries, border workers, diplomats and transport personnel, and provides for fines and enforcement by police.

This ministerial regulation amends the Uitvoeringsregeling zeevisserij to align Dutch sea-fishing rules with the EU fishing-opportunity regulations for 2021 (and deep-sea species for 2021-2022), including provisional quotas set at 25% (65% for some pelagic stocks) of 2020 levels due to Brexit uncertainty. It also updates cross-references, replaces annexes 8, 9 and 11 with new species, bycatch and price-threshold tables, and adds a conditional rule on Union-UK reciprocal fishing access that enters into force only if the related EU amending regulation does.
Landbouwwet 17 en 19; Reglement zee- en kustvisserij 1977 3 en 4

This omnibus decree amends several tax implementing decrees, including limiting the 30% wage tax ruling to five years, dropping the loonheffingennummer requirement, extending VAT exemption for personnel provision in youth and social care, designating valuable goods, and adjusting motor vehicle, environmental, WOZ data and innovation box rules. Most changes are technical and some take effect later or are retroactive.

This amending regulation adds an article 5a to the Sars-CoV-2 mink measures regulation, exempting empty mink farms from articles 3c, 3d, 3da, 3e and 3f when all minks have been killed and the investigation under article 2a is negative. It applies from the day after publication in the Staatscourant and is justified by the early ban on fur farming and the resulting zero infection risk.
Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren artikel 17

This Besluit amends the Besluit algemene rechtspositie politie and the Besluit bezoldiging politie to formalise remaining points of the 2018-2020 police collective labour agreement, including an early-retirement scheme (RVU) with a one-off payment for officers working until the AOW age, a cap on socially burdensome hours with compensation in life-phase hours, changes to police training and salary provisions, and adjustments to disability and WIA compensation. Several provisions take effect on 1 January 2026 and some apply retroactively.

This Besluit amends the annex to the Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften, the Besluit OM-afdoening and the Besluit justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens, mainly to index the administrative and out-of-court fine tariffs for traffic offences. The annex lists per offence code the tariff in euros for each road-user category, covering licence, vehicle, speed and traffic-rule violations.
Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften 2, vijfde lid, en 35; Wet justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens 2, tweede lid; Wetboek van Strafvordering 257b en 257ba
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This decree extends the temporary 10% allocation room for low middle-income households in social housing (the higher DAEB income limit) from expiry on 1 January 2021 to 1 January 2022, by amending article 16 of the BTIV 2015. It also deletes article 129 of that decree, which contained changes tied to the expiring limit.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This AMvB supplements the Omgevingswet implementing rules: it adds housing category rules (social rental, social ownership, mid-rent, private commissioning) to the omgevingsplan, sets out land consolidation (ruilbesluiten and geldelijke regelingen) rules, and rewrites the voorkeursrecht and onteigening decision content requirements and cost-recovery (kostenverhaal) rules.

This regulation sets Dutch national rules for unmanned aircraft: flight height limits, distances from roads and railways, restrictions near controlled airspace and vital infrastructure, register registration, training-body recognition, fees, and criminal offences for breaches. It also amends several related regulations and sets transitional rules.

The regulation sets geographic zones in which drones in the open category may not fly above 30 metres, including low-flying routes and areas for civil and military aircraft, and it bans open-category flights in certain zones around uncontrolled airports, heliports and ports. It also restricts subcategory A3 flights in low-flying zones, and the text is cut off mid-way through the port zones in article 4.

This ministerial regulation adds Guernsey, Gibraltar and the United Kingdom to the list of driving licences exchangeable into Dutch licences without a new practical exam, with conditions tied to the date the holder settled in the Netherlands. It also clarifies that from 1 January 2021 UK-issued licences are treated as third-country licences, with a transitional exchange window for certain holders.

This ministerial regulation bans passenger air traffic from the United Kingdom and South Africa to Dutch airports until 1 January 2021 to limit the spread of COVID-19 variants, exempting medical personnel and cargo flights. It replaces the previous second ban, repeals that regulation, and is enforced by the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport.

This ministerial regulation amends several ministerial regulations to introduce an APK inspection, registration and licence-plate obligation for agricultural and forestry tractors, and a registration and plate obligation for low-speed motor vehicles and mobile machines. It also makes many technical changes to driving exam requirements, plate-manufacturer and dealer rules, inspection-station requirements, and vehicle definitions.

It also sets the entry-into-force dates for its parts.
Kaderbesluit nationale EZ-subsidies 2, eerste lid, 5, eerste en tweede lid, 6, derde lid, 16, 25 en 34, eerste lid

This AMvB amends the Besluit internationale verplichtingen extraterritoriale rechtsmacht to establish Dutch jurisdiction over offences endangering aircraft safety or on-board order when the flight's departure or next scheduled landing point is in the Netherlands and the aircraft lands there with the suspect aboard, implementing the 2014 Montreal Protocol to the Tokyo Convention. It also amends the Besluit toezicht luchtvaart BES to oblige passengers to follow the captain's instructions, with an offence for non-compliance, in Caribbean Netherlands.

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling publieke gezondheid so that the notification duty for pneumococcal disease applies to persons aged 60 and over, not only to those born after March 2006. The purpose is to make vaccination status available to evaluate the newly introduced pneumococcal vaccination programme for older adults, effective 1 April 2021.
Wet publieke gezondheid artikel 22, vierde lid

This amending regulation indexes a large set of ILT and Kiwa fees across rail, passenger transport, dangerous goods, cable installations and explosives for 2021, using a 1.7% and 1.4% adjustment. It also introduces new ERATV registration fees, lowers the fee for new vehicle-type approvals on existing types, and changes the payment timing for machinist licence applications to after invoicing.

Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This regulation amends the Temporary subsidy scheme for wage costs and income loss CN so that the subsidy can be refused or suspended not only when conditions are not met but also upon a serious suspicion that the conditions in articles 6, 9 or 12 are not met, or upon a notification from the applicant. It aligns the scheme with the NOW 1, 2 and 3 emergency measures, and the explanatory note states that such decisions must be motivated in a decision open to objection and appeal, without requiring thorough prior investigation.

This ministerial regulation makes technical amendments to several police regulations so that the new rechtspositie for police volunteers in the Barp is reflected consistently, including the recruitment requirements and the definition of volunteer trainees. It also removes references to the repealed Brvp and excludes police volunteers from some police schemes, such as the life-course, social statute, study facility and damages regulations.
Besluit algemene rechtspositie politie 7, eerste lid, onderdelen b, c en d, 8c, 39, tweede lid, 47a, 55i, vijfde lid, 55u, 58, vierde lid, 67, vijfde lid en 69a, zesde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation replaces Annex V to the Uitvoeringsregeling huurprijzen woonruimte, setting the 2021 maximum rent increase percentages from 1 July 2021: 2.4 percent for lower-income households in self-contained dwellings and 5.4 percent for higher-income households, with 2.4 percent for non-self-contained rooms, caravans and pitches. It implements the annual inflation-linked rent ceiling set by the statute, with the government's announced inflation plus one percentage point policy for lower-income tenants.
Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte artikel 10, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation raises the statutory maximum taxi fares for 2021 by applying a 0.91% index (LTI) to the fixed, per-kilometre, per-minute and waiting-period amounts. It is an annual technical indexation with no change to the tariff structure.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This Besluit amends the Besluit uitvoering Crisis- en herstelwet (twentieth tranche) and the Besluit milieueffectrapportage. It adds experimental rules disapplying the positive fictitious decision for certain environmental permits, extends and adapts several existing local experiments (building without permits in listed municipalities, bestemmingsplan designations for solar fields, cost recovery), adds sustainable energy generation to the project-implementation decision category, and creates a plan-mer assessment option for small-area or minor plan changes.
Crisis- en herstelwet 2.4; Wet milieubeheer 7.2a, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation amends the job descriptions in the police LFNP (Landelijk Functieniveau Nederlandse Politie) so that Assistent, Medewerker and Generalist Beveiliging staff may take, secure and record DNA material from arrestees and convicted persons for the national DNA database. It also adds corresponding performance indicators and removes the DNA task from the Assistent Beveiliging B main component, replacing it with a uniform 'Aanwenden dwangmiddelen' wording.
Besluit bezoldiging politie artikel 6, tweede lid; Besluit DNA-onderzoek in strafzaken artikel 2, zevende lid

This ministerial regulation sets up a one-off specific grant of at most 60 million euros for municipalities to cover costs of temporary staff who support or carry out supervision and enforcement tasks, for costs incurred between 15 December 2020 and 30 June 2021. It sets a fixed base amount plus a per-inhabitant amount per municipality, eligible cost rules, accountability via SiSa, and recovery of undue payments.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling Bouwbesluit 2012 by adding Article 3.11 and Annex VIII, which set detailed measurement rules for the noise level of outdoor heat and cooling installations at property boundaries and near openable windows. It specifies measurement quantities, operating conditions, corrections for tonal noise and daytime operation, and measurement locations, and enters into force together with the related Bouwbesluit amendment.
Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat

This technical amendment corrects the Regeling subsidie financiering vaste lasten MKB COVID-19 so that companies registered under SBI codes 64.2, 64.30.3 or 70.10 can qualify for the fixed-cost subsidy through a listed secondary activity, with a rule for calculating the subsidy percentage. It also excludes credit and financial institutions under the EU temporary state-aid framework and applies retroactively from 25 November 2020.

This amendment to the Vreemdelingen 2000 implementing regulation adjusts immigration fees (leges) for 2021 by indexation and new fixed amounts, introduces new residence document specimens for EU citizens and cross-border workers under the Withdrawal Agreement, and sets a three-day advance notice rule for vessel departures for exit stamping at the Schengen border. It also removes Togo as a safe country of origin and adds the United Kingdom as one.

This amending regulation adds an extra application window from 15 to 27 December 2020 to the third tranche of the temporary emergency wage subsidy scheme (NOW 3), so employers who did not apply before 13 December can still claim during the lockdown. It is given retroactive effect to 15 December 2020.
Kaderwet SZW-subsidies 3, eerste lid, en 8, eerste lid
Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat

This corrective amending regulation rewrites article 4.5.2(6) of the Regeling nationale EZK- en LNV-subsidies so that the ISDE subsidy for solar PV and wind turbines can also go to natural persons who keep a business running, where the installation serves that business. It fixes an omission from the earlier 9 December 2020 amendment that had wrongly excluded sole proprietors and partnerships.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending ministerial regulation changes the temporary subsidy scheme for childcare in Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba) by setting a 2021 subsidy ceiling for Saba, moving the licensing and transition-plan deadlines to February and May 2021, adding a one-time advance payment option, and adjusting parent contribution and daypart rules, with retroactive effect. It is based on the Kaderwet SZW-subsidies and applies no sanctions or new obligations beyond the scheme's own conditions.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

It sets the model layout and filling-in rules for the mbo-verklaring, and takes effect on 1 August 2021.

Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

The regulation amends the Regeling reductie energiegebruik woningen by raising the funding ceiling for specific grants to municipalities for household energy-saving measures from €70 million to €100 million. It takes effect the day after publication and applies to applications already submitted, as no new opening of the scheme is planned.

This amending decree raises the fee maxima that psychiatrists, psychologists and other experts receive for criminal-case work (Pro Justitia reports) by about 3.4 percent for 2021, implementing an annual indexation. It applies to assignments given on or after 1 January 2021.
Wet tarieven in strafzaken 3, eerste lid en 6, eerste lid

This Dutch AMvB raises the per-point tariff for third-party professional legal aid costs in administrative appeal and higher appeal proceedings from €534 to €748, effective 1 July 2021, except for WOZ and BPM tax cases, which stay at €534. It aims to push administrative bodies to prepare decisions better and reduce litigation, and drops a proposed explicit power for judges to award above-tariff costs.

This decree amends the fee regulation for the Raad voor strafrechtstoepassing en jeugdbescherming, setting new monthly remuneration for the chair, deputy chair and members, and per-session or per-case fees for extraordinary members. It restructures the fee categories by linking them to judicial civil-servant salary scales, with retroactive effect to 1 September 2020.
Instellingswet Raad voor strafrechtstoepassing en jeugdbescherming 2015 artikel 8
Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat

The regulation extends the application window of the Garantie ondernemingsfinanciering uitbraak coronavirus and Garantie Klein Krediet Corona subsidy modules to 15 June 2021 with a new expiry date of 1 July 2021, and allows stacking of Klein Krediet loans up to 50,000 euro, including loans granted from 10 October 2020. It also updates EU state aid approval references and budgets in the RNES and the 2020 and 2021 openstelling regulations.
Kaderbesluit nationale EZ-subsidies 2, 4, 5, eerste en tweede lid, 7, tweede lid, 16, 25 en 30, vijfde lid

It also adds a transitional rule until 1 July 2021 allowing persons with completed examination modules to record building envelope and installation data under the BRL.
Bouwbesluit 2012 1.5, eerste lid; Besluit Omgevingsrecht 4.4; Besluit energieprestatievergoeding huur 2, derde lid; Besluit energieprestatie gebouwen 3.1
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

The regulation amends the Regeling Bouwbesluit 2012 by designating updated versions of numerous NEN and NEN-EN building standards, correcting references, deleting provisions now covered elsewhere (articles 2.3, 5.8c, 5.10a), and clarifying thermal bridge calculation in annex VII. It takes effect on 1 January 2021 and is largely technical with a modest cost increase for pile foundations.

Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation amends the 2020 rules for a one-off specific grant to municipalities for housing vulnerable groups, extending a deadline in article 2(3) from 1 December to 31 December 2020. It also corrects the annex by replacing the municipality of Goes with Vlissingen, with retroactive effect to 30 November 2020.

The regulation sets the 2021 annual contribution that conscientious objectors must pay per motor vehicle to the Fonds Middelen Gemoedsbezwaarden to obtain an exemption certificate from compulsory motor liability insurance. It keeps the contribution unchanged at the 2020 level because the fund's assets exceed the target band.
Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat

This ministerial regulation implements the CO2 levy on industry under the Environmental Management Act, setting monitoring and reporting rules for industrial installations, calculation of the industrial annual emissions load, and the register and calculation of dispensation rights. It fills in detailed technical procedures delegated by the statute, including activity-level and allocation formulas.

Besluit BDU verkeer en vervoer artikel 4, derde lid

This ministerial subsidy regulation sets rules for grants of up to EUR 5,000 per pilot project to quality assurers (kwaliteitsborgers) participating in pilot projects preparing for the Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen. It caps total funding at EUR 900,000, sets application and reporting obligations, and provides for revocation of subsidies in certain cases, with the regulation expiring on 1 January 2022.

This ministerial regulation amends the Temporary climate adaptation impulse scheme 2021-2027 by inserting a missing percentage of the budget available to the water region Delfland in the annex. It is a technical correction effective from 1 January 2021, made without internet consultation.

This ministerial regulation amends the Besluit erkenning cursussen en diploma's proefdieren and the Regeling certificaten groen beroepsonderwijs to recognise a new certificate for performing animal-experiment procedures (K0606) combined with animal-care diplomas as meeting the training requirements for animal laboratory caretakers.
