This ministerial regulation sets out the application and auction procedure for reallocating returned non-national commercial FM radio licences under the Frequentiebesluit 2013. It fixes eligibility limits by demographic reach, application requirements, deposits, a binding commitment to Dutch/Frisian programming, and the simultaneous multi-round auction rules.

The regulation re-designates Stichting De Thuiskopie as the legal person responsible for collecting and distributing the private-copying remuneration under the Copyright Act and the Neighbouring Rights Act, for up to five years. It requires that any contract with a third organisation be for a fixed term and specify termination conditions.
Auteurswet 16d, eerste lid; Wet op de naburige rechten 10, onderdeel e
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amendment to the Regeling Wfsv abolishes, for new cases, the option for temporary employment agencies to be classified in a sector other than the temporary work sector (sector 52), by removing the 50% sector-allocation exception and replacing the fifth paragraph. Employers already classified or who had applied before the entry-into-force date may remain in their existing sector under the old rules.
Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen 95, eerste lid, en 96, derde lid

This AMvB amends the Besluit meetinstrumenten en marktdeelnemers to designate weighing of loaded containers for public safety under the SOLAS convention as a regulated measuring task, so that certified automatic catch-weighers, non-automatic weighbridges and dynamic weighbridges may be used. It implements the SOLAS container-weighing obligation without creating new obligations itself.

This amending decree to the Besluit omgevingsrecht requires that municipalities and provinces assign the preparation of permits, supervision and enforcement for listed categories of activities to designated environmental services (omgevingsdiensten), and sets procedural criteria for uniform enforcement policy, implementation programmes, monitoring and reporting. It also establishes mandatory connection to the Inspectieview Milieu information-sharing system for designated authorities and sets rules on data access, responsibility and cost sharing.
Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht 5.3, vierde lid, 5.7, eerste lid, en 5.8, tweede en derde lid; Wet op de economische delicten 58a, eerste lid

This amending decree adjusts several financial-sector AMvBs: it extends the Wft advisor-diploma requirement to advice on general pension funds and voluntary joining of industry pension funds, corrects cross-references and terminology, aligns the calculation of shareholdings with that of voting rights in the disclosure decree, and adjusts fine categories under the sector penalties and anti-money-laundering decrees. It also restores a retroactive gap for pension advisors and makes technical prospectus and terminology fixes.

Wet op het financieel toezicht 3:57, tweede lid, 4:9, derde lid, 4:14, tweede lid, 4:15, tweede lid, 4:25a, 4:37o, zesde lid, 5:38, vijfde lid; Sanctiewet 1977 2, eerste lid, en 3; Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme BES 5.11, tweede lid en 5.12, eerste lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

The regulation sets the statutory minimum wage under the Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag from 1 July 2017 at EUR 1,565.40 per month, EUR 361.25 per week and EUR 72.25 per day, following the statutory indexation formula based on CPB contract wage forecasts. It also publishes derived minimum hourly wages for 36, 38 and 40-hour working weeks and notes that youth minimum wages are set in a separate Besluit.
Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag artikel 14, tweede en tiende lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation amends the temporary scheme providing learning materials funding for vocational students from low-income households, extending it by one year to study year 2017–2018 and raising the budget from €4.968 million to €10 million. It also relaxes the accountability and spending rules for the additional funds so that unspent money can go to other funded activities.
Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.2.3, tweede en derde lid

This AMvB sets detailed procedural rules for Schiphol airport's tariff and investment regime under the Wet luchtvaart, covering how the operator publishes and consults on tariff proposals, investment programmes and project estimates, and how cost over- or under-recoveries are settled. It also defines exceptional circumstances, the 5% budget-variance threshold and the 12-month Euribor used for settlement interest.
Wet luchtvaart 8.1b, eerste lid; 8.25di, eerste lid; 8.25e, twaalfde lid; 8.25f, achtste lid; 8.25fa, zevende lid; 8.25g, vijfde lid; 8.29a, tweede lid

This AMvB makes a set of technical amendments to the Reglement verkeersregels en verkeerstekens 1990, including updating definitions, parking and lighting rules, helmet exemptions, and adding new road signs for bus/tram/freight lanes, passing lanes and passing places. It is a minor, largely redactional and clarifying revision with no intended change in practice for most parts.

This AMvB amends article 3.1.6 of the Besluit ruimtelijke ordening, replacing the three-step Ladder for sustainable urbanisation with a simplified requirement to describe the need for a new urban development and, if located outside existing urban areas, to motivate why the need cannot be met within them. It also allows the Ladder test to be deferred from the bestemmingsplan to the later wijzigings- or uitwerkingsplan and replaces the term 'actuele regionale behoefte' with 'behoefte'.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending AMvB tightens quality requirements for childcare staff in voorschoolse educatie (preschool education): a raised Dutch language level (3F), a mandatory keuzedeel on developmental teaching or a proof of at least 12 days of targeted training, a yearly training plan per location, and inclusion of preschool education in the pedagogical policy plan. It takes effect in stages from 2017 to 2019 with transitional rules for current staff.
Wet kinderopvang en kwaliteitseisen peuterspeelzalen 1.50b, aanhef en onder a, and 2.8, aanhef en onder a

This ministerial regulation amends two existing regulations on the use and installation of measuring instruments so that containers can be weighed under the SOLAS convention with less accurate weighing instruments (accuracy classes Y(b), IIII, 0.5 and 1). It implements the mass verification requirement for loaded containers before loading onto ships.

This Besluit amends the Besluit milieueffectrapportage to implement the 2014 EIA Directive revision, the second Espoo amendment, and to repair implementation gaps. It changes the screening procedure for activities below threshold, removes the defence exemption article, adds a chapter on exemption requests, and adjusts the EIA annex categories including a new wind farm threshold of 20 turbines.
Wet milieubeheer 7.2, eerste, tweede, derde en vierde lid, en 7.5, vijfde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation amends the 2016 list of vocational qualification dossiers by adding new qualifications (such as Machinist hijswerk, Koude- en klimaatsystemen and Bootmannen), removing older ones, and re-establishing certain existing dossiers in Annex 2. It adds statutory professional requirements (wettelijke beroepsvereisten) to several qualifications and gives transitional rights for students in outdated programmes.
Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 7.2.4, tweede lid; Uitvoeringsbesluit WEB 2.2.3, vierde lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling taken Dienst Wegverkeer to implement Directive 2014/47/EU on roadside technical inspection of commercial vehicles, replacing references to the repealed Directive 2000/30/EG. It assigns the RDW tasks such as conducting further inspections, managing the risk classification system, acting as national contact point and exchanging information with the European Commission.
Wegenverkeerswet 1994 4b, tweede lid, aanhef en onderdeel b

This regulation postpones the entry into force of an earlier amendment to the Regeling diervoeders 2012 that caps phosphorus content in cattle feed, moving the start date from 15 May 2017 to 15 August 2017. It also postpones to 1 October 2017 the date from which farms may demonstrate that no more than 3.5 grams of gross phosphorus per kg dry matter is fed to cattle, because monitoring showed the feed measure was achieving its phosphate-reduction target.
Wet dieren 10.1, eerste lid; Besluit diervoeders 2012 3.8, eerste lid, onderdeel b

This amending regulation adds two tasks to the Dienst Wegverkeer (RDW): voluntary inspection of heat-resistant cladding on LPG tanker trucks under NTA 8820:2015, and assigning world manufacturer identification (WMI) codes for EU vehicle identification numbers. It also allows the RDW to charge fees for the heat-resistant cladding inspection.

This ministerial regulation amends the APK inspection and vehicle regulations to implement EU Directive 2014/45/EU on periodic technical roadworthiness testing. It adds new inspection requirements and equipment (such as play detectors, LPG/CNG/LNG leak detectors), new hydrogen and LNG installation rules, and warning-light and brake checks for vehicles first registered after 31 December 2017.
Richtlijn 2014/45/EU (EU Directive on periodic technical inspection); Wegenverkeerswet 1994 83, vierde lid; 84, eerste lid; 85a, vierde en vijfde lid

This rectification corrects several errors in a 10 May 2017 regulation amending the Plant Health Act tariff regulation and the regulation on import, export and movement of plants. It fixes the maximum per-consignment fee for Chinese goods under article 2b and an amount in article 38.

This amending regulation extends the deadline for the Commission evaluating the point-allocation system for subsidised legal aid from 1 June 2017 to 1 November 2017 for its final report. It also sets the expiry of the establishing regulation at 1 November 2017.

The regulation amends the fees for plant health inspections under the Plantenziektenwet, adding a new tariff for PSTVd research, raising and indexing several NAK export inspection fees, and removing obsolete tariffs. It also reinstates emergency measures on wooden packaging from China, extending their end date to 1 August 2018 in line with EU Implementing Decision 2017/728.
Uitvoeringsbesluit (EU) 2017/728 van de Commissie; Plantenziektenwet artikel 2, eerste lid, en 6a
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This regulation amends the Regeling zorgverzekering to set out the tasks and information duties of the Dutch national contact point for cross-border healthcare, assigned to the Zorginstituut and in practice carried out by the CAK. It implements Directive 2011/24/EU and an implementing directive on recognition of prescriptions, and gives retroactive effect to 25 October 2013.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This monthly amendment to the Regeling zorgverzekering adds, replaces and removes drug entries in the reimbursable pharmaceuticals annexes (bijlage 1), including adding eliglustat (Cerdelga) for Gaucher disease and restricting its use in bijlage 2 to treatment per accepted professional guidelines. It also sets the entry-into-force and retroactive effect dates for the changes.

The regulation corrects the Dutch wording of code 96 in the annex to the driving-licence restrictions regulation so that it matches the corrected EU directives, changing the trailer mass threshold from 'at most 750 kg' to 'more than 750 kg'. It enters into force the day after publication and is presented as a technical correction with no administrative burden.
Rectificatie van Richtlijn 2012/36/EU (PbEU 2017 L 81/20) and Rectificatie van Richtlijn (EU) 2015/653 (PbEU 2017 L 89/18); Wegenverkeerswet 1994 118, vierde lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling tarieven scheepvaart 2005 to add a fee of USD 2,112 for the costs of detaining a ship under port state control in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. It also removes from the Regeling aanwijzing toezichthoudende ambtenaren Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport the designation of officials for articles already covered directly by the Wet havenstaatcontrole.

This temporary regulation sets substitute noise-load limits (L night) at the enforcement points around Schiphol airport so that they correspond to a maximum of 32,000 commercial night flight movements for the 2018 usage year, ahead of an amendment to the Luchthavenverkeerbesluit. It applies from 1 November 2017 until 1 November 2018 and lapses earlier if the LVB amendment takes effect sooner.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation amends the Regeling zorgverzekering to exclude nusinersen, an intramural drug for 5q spinal muscular atrophy, from the basic health insurance package, so it does not automatically enter the package. The exclusion is justified by the drug's very high budget impact and is meant to allow time for an assessment and price negotiation before possible inclusion.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation adjusts the Regeling tegemoetkoming kosten opleidingsscholen for 2017: it reopens subsidy for previously refused partnerships, sets 2017 budget ceilings and per-school amounts for aspirant training schools, moves the application deadline to 1 September 2017, and adds a list of primary teacher-training programmes given priority. It also introduces a rule that changes in the lead partner take effect the following school year and makes late student-number reporting a ground for refusal.
Wet overige OCW-subsidies artikel 2, eerste lid, onderdeel a, juncto artikel 4, tweede lid

This amendment to the universal service regulation removes the permitted per-call information tariff above the basic call cost for 090x customer-service numbers, so only the ordinary call charge may be billed for service calls under a concluded contract. It follows a 2 March 2017 Court of Justice ruling interpreting the basic-tariff rule of the Consumer Rights Directive, and enters into force on 1 July 2017.
Telecommunicatiewet 7.8; Besluit universele dienstverlening en eindgebruikersbelangen 3.6a

This amending regulation updates the Regeling veilig gebruik luchthavens en andere terreinen to exclude certified airports (Schiphol, Rotterdam, Maastricht) from its scope, adjusts a helicopter obstacle height limit in line with ICAO Annex 14, and makes technical corrections including how annex amendments take effect. It also replaces the Regeling burgerluchthavens article on annex amendments in parallel.

This decree amends the Besluit ruimtelijke ordening so that municipalities can designate liberalised middle-rent dwellings as a separate housing category in land-use plans and exploitation plans, with rent caps set by municipal ordinance and indexed annually. It also requires such dwellings to be maintained as middle-rent for at least ten years after occupation, effective 1 July 2017.

This ministerial regulation indexes two monetary thresholds in the police legal status decree and one threshold in the national police social statute by 1.6 percent, in line with projected market contract wage growth, raising the amounts from 76,000 to 77,000 euro and from 51,000 to 52,000 euro. The changes take effect retroactively from 1 January 2017.
Besluit algemene rechtspositie politie artikel 55y, tiende lid; Regeling landelijk sociaal statuut politie artikel 20d, eerste lid, onderdeel b

This amendment to the Besluit Infrastructuurfonds adds a subsidy basis for the ERTMS rail signalling system, allowing organisations other than ProRail to be subsidised. It also sets a sunset date of 1 January 2025 for the subsidy provisions of the decree, while keeping them applicable to subsidies requested or granted before that date.
Wet Infrastructuurfonds 8, vierde en negende lid, en 9, eerste lid

This decree removes the Centrale Organisatie voor Radioactief Afval N.V. (COVRA) from the A2-list of entities with a limited cash management function, so it is no longer obliged to hold its liquid assets in the state treasury. The change follows a stated intention to treat COVRA like other state participations, which are not required to bank with the treasury, given the unclear split between public and private funds.

This amending regulation adds two new subsidy modules to the national Topsector Energie subsidy scheme: carbon capture, utilisation and storage (CCUS) and hydrogen, each with funding intensities, a ceiling of EUR 250,000 per project, a four-year realisation period, and scoring criteria. It also opens the CCUS, hydrogen, DEI and Eurostars subsidy windows in 2017.

Kaderbesluit nationale EZ-subsidies 2, tweede lid, 4, onderdelen a, b, c, d en h, 5, 15, 16, 17, eerste lid, aanhef en onderdeel b, en derde lid, 19, derde lid, 23, onderdeel b, 25, 34, eerste lid, en 44, tweede lid

This amending regulation to the Fosfaatreductieplan 2017 restricts the phosphate-reduction scheme to milk-producing farms only, removing non-dairy holdings with retroactive effect to 1 March 2017. It adds a young-stock ratio (jongveegetal), changes the levy and solidarity-levy calculations, adds a rule that cows returning to a dairy farm within four months trigger recalculation, and modifies exemptions and collection rules.

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling nationale EZ-subsidies by extending the expiry dates of several subsidy modules, including PPS-toeslag onderzoek en innovatie, TKI MKB-versterking, Innovatieprestatiecontracten and Garantstelling gericht op bankgaranties. It also corrects a misplaced clause and a wrong statutory cross-reference in article 3.14.12.
Kaderbesluit nationale EZ-subsidies artikel 2, tweede lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling aanmelding en toelating hoger onderwijs, updating the prior-education requirements (Bijlagen A and B, plus D and E) for university and higher vocational programmes by renaming, adding, removing and reclassifying degree programmes. It is a technical update with staggered entry dates for the tightened requirements.
Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek 7.25, 7.26 en 7.26a

This amending regulation deletes article 77 of the Uitvoeringsregeling visserij, which had restored fishing licences of members who left the PO-IJsselmeer to their 1996 position, and makes several technical corrections to article references. It takes effect the day after publication, departing from the usual fixed change dates because part of it is repair regulation and article 77 must lapse before 1 July.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation grants additional funding, without application, to vocational education institutions where at least 20% of enrolled students lack a prior diploma or have long enrolment durations, to offset the funding cascade for students who take longer to graduate. The funding totals EUR 4 million per year for 2017 and 2018, is distributed pro rata by a formula, and the regulation expires on 1 January 2019.
Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.2.3, tweede lid

This amending regulation sets up the second and final application window of the dairy farm cessation subsidy, with a reduced rate of EUR 730 per GVE and a EUR 5 million budget ceiling. It also changes eligibility rules: export of pregnant dairy cattle for slaughter must go directly from the farm, the reference date becomes the publication date, and the old rules are kept for first-window applications.
Landbouwwet artikel 19, eerste lid; Gedelegeerde Verordening 2016/1613/EU (as cited in preamble)
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation raises the subsidy ceiling for individual homeowner-occupiers under the energy-saving home subsidy scheme from €43,810,000 to €44,275,000. It takes effect the day after publication, deviating from the usual lead time because the ceiling was nearly exhausted.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial subsidy regulation sets rules for granting subsidies to national and supra-regional initiatives that provide in-kind goods and services to children growing up in poverty, for 2017 to 2021. It fixes application windows, budget ceilings, eligibility criteria, grounds for refusal and withdrawal of subsidies.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This amending regulation updates the Uitvoeringsregeling WNT to reflect the renamed Wet normering topinkomens and the Evaluatiewet WNT changes, including new rules on which severance payments count and what remuneration data must be published. It exempts small semi-public institutions with a gross wage bill of up to 160,000 euro from disclosure and audit obligations, and narrows disclosure for low-paid officials.
Wet normering topinkomens 1.1, onderdeel b, onder 6°, 1.9, eerste lid, onderdeel a, 2.6, 3.3, 3.4 en 4.1

This ministerial regulation amends the Voorschrift Vreemdelingen 2000 by adding Brazil and Trinidad and Tobago to the list of safe countries of origin in Annex 13 and provides that certain public holidays and equivalent days count toward asylum procedure deadlines in the land-aanmeldcentra. It also takes effect the day after publication, using an expedited procedure that departs from the fixed amendment moments.
Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 3.105ba, eerste lid, en 3.110, vierde lid

This regulation amends the national Ministry of Economic Affairs subsidy rules to open and modify the subsidy module for vaccination of poultry against salmonella, covering 2017 and changing the per-bird subsidy amounts. It also removes the TSE genotyping subsidy module for sheep and adds the poultry module to the 2017 subsidy opening schedule.

Verordening (EU) nr. 652/2014 van het Europees Parlement en de Raad van 15 mei 2014 volledig (bepalingen betreffende het beheer van de uitgaven in verband met de voedselketen, diergezondheid en dierenwelzijn); Kaderbesluit nationale EZ-subsidies artikelen 2, tweede lid, 4, 5 en 16
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation amends the Regeling zorgverzekering to exclude pembrolizumab for Hodgkin lymphoma from the basic health insurance package, joining the existing exclusion for lung cancer. The exclusion is justified by the expected high cost burden and is intended to remain until financial risks are adequately covered, with the Minister to decide later on inclusion.

This ministerial regulation amends several EU-implementing sanctions regulations (Zimbabwe, Belarus, North Korea, Central African Republic, Ukraine) to align them with new EU Council decisions, adding exemptions and designating competent authorities. It largely updates cross-references and carve-outs for trade in military goods, explosives, sporting equipment and similar items.
Sanctiewet 1977 artikel 2, tweede lid, en artikel 3
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling vaststelling keuzedelen by adding two new annexes (11 and 12) that list new optional course modules (keuzedelen) for secondary vocational education and their linkage to qualifications. It is the sixth such update and applies to students following qualification dossiers established on 14 February 2016.
Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 7.2.4, tweede lid, onderdeel d, en zesde lid; 7.2.7, negende lid; Examen- en kwalificatiebesluit beroepsopleidingen WEB 17d, eerste lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This amending regulation shortens the validity of access means (pass and certificate) for the healthcare citizen service number from three to two years, effective retroactively from 22 March 2017. It accordingly reduces the fee for these access means by one third to match the shorter validity period.
Besluit gebruik burgerservicenummer in de zorg artikel 21, tweede en derde lid, en artikel 24
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation amends the Subsidieregeling schoolmaatschappelijk werk in het mbo by extending its end date from 1 January 2018 to 1 January 2019, so the annual subsidy of EUR 15 million for school social work in mbo institutions continues one more year. It is a purely technical extension to allow the next cabinet to decide on continuation.

The regulation revokes the national bird flu prevention measures on mandatory housing and screening of poultry, the ban on poultry competitions and exhibitions, and the transport restrictions, based on a lowered risk assessment. It keeps only the hygiene protocol requirement for visits to commercial poultry establishments and amends the 2016 prevention regulation accordingly.
Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren 17, eerste lid, 18, 30, eerste en derde lid, en 31; Richtlijn 2005/94/EG niet van toepassing als nationale wet; Europese richtlijn (aviaire influenza)

This ministerial regulation amends the Examenreglement voor luchtvarenden 2004 to assign the theory examinations for the balloon and glider pilot certificates (BPL, SPL, LAPL(B), LAPL(S) and the commercial CPL(FB)) to the Stichting Theorie Examens Ballonvaren en Zweefvliegen (STEBZ) instead of the CBR, with the minister keeping decision and result-assessment powers. It also makes related technical and wording changes and applies retroactively from 1 April 2017.
Besluit bewijzen van bevoegdheid voor de luchtvaart 14, vijfde lid, 16, tweede lid, onderdelen d, f, g, i, j, k, l, m, n en o
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

The regulation amends the Arbeidsomstandighedenregeling to extend the existing exemption from the asbestos end-measurement rule to removal of asbestos-cement pipes, ducts and channels not fully embedded in concrete, and makes technical corrections to annexes on face-fit testing and task categories. It also adjusts the timing of when face-fit tests must be performed by an accredited company, to match market capacity.

This AMvB amends the Uitvoeringsbesluit Meststoffenwet to allow farmers on phosphate-neutral arable land to raise their phosphate application standard when they achieve above-average crop yields for listed crops, under conditions including buyer authorisations, sales evidence, accountant statements and monitoring. The rule applies from 2017 and lapses on 1 January 2019, and a later article allows the provision to be removed by Royal Decree.
Meststoffenwet 11, derde lid, en 40, eerste lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling taakuitoefening en grensoverschrijdende samenwerking financiële toezichthouders Wft to implement Commission Implementing Directive (EU) 2015/2392 on reporting actual or potential market abuse infringements to competent authorities. It adds the directive's procedural requirements (qualified staff, publication of reporting information, communication channels, registration, data protection, evaluation) for the AFM and removes the obsolete 2003 market abuse directive references.
Wet op het financieel toezicht 1:25, vierde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation amends the Implementing Regulation on rental prices for residential space to set the maximum rent limits and permitted rent increase percentages for the period 1 July 2017 to 30 June 2018. It also updates the WOZ-value point amounts in the Besluit huurprijzen woonruimte and adjusts the minister's title.
Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte artikel 10, eerste en tweede lid; Besluit huurprijzen woonruimte artikel 12, eerste en tweede lid, en bijlage I, onderdeel A, rubriek 9
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This temporary decree (2017) designates the bachelor medisch hulpverlener as a profession authorised to perform certain reserved medical acts independently for a period of five years, under Article 36a of the Wet BIG. It also sets the training requirements (240 study points, competencies), the professional expertise area, the list of reserved acts (injections, catheterisation, cardioversion, defibrillation, intubation, etc.) and the conditions under which they may be performed.
Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg 36a
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This AMvB adds chapter 2c to the Besluit Wfsv and amends the Besluit SUWI to create a register of temporary-agency placements so that hours worked by disabled workers placed with an employer (inleenverbanden) can be counted toward that employer's quota shortfall under the banenafspraak. It also defines which workers count, sets the quota-percentage variables, and assigns obligations to temporary agencies and host employers.
Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen 34, lid 5; 38d, leden 9 en 10; 38f, leden 3 en 4; 38g, leden 4 en 5; Wet structuur uitvoeringsorganisatie werk en inkomen 33, lid 11

This ministerial regulation amends the implementing rules on traffic signs (Uitvoeringsvoorschriften BABW) to align them with a simultaneous amendment of the traffic rules RVV 1990, adding application and placement rules for new signs (F11-F22, L20-L21), tightening rules for speed-limit signs and parking-on-pavement signs, and granting a one-year transitional period for existing signage. It is a technical, maintenance-type update with no new burdens on citizens or firms.

This amending regulation eases the avian influenza preventive measures: visits to establishments with commercially kept poultry are now prohibited only subject to exceptions (hygiene protocol and registration), the visitor ban no longer applies to bird housing outside commercial establishments, and mandatory clinical examination for transport of poultry and ducks/turkeys to slaughterhouses is removed. Its legal basis is the Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren, implementing EU Directive 2005/94/EC.

Richtlijn 2005/94/EG van de Raad betreffende communautaire maatregelen ter bestrijding van aviaire influenza Gelet op (EU directive, no articles specified); Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren artikelen 17, eerste lid, 30, eerste lid, en 31

This amending regulation adds two paragraphs to article 5.18.9 of the Vehicles Regulation, requiring that rear-mounted folding aerodynamic devices on commercial vehicles and trailers be locked when stowed and be stowed on roads with a speed limit of 50 km/h or less where pedestrians, cyclists or mopeds must use the carriageway. It implements Directive (EU) 2015/719 on maximum vehicle dimensions and weights, with effect from 7 May 2017.
Richtlijn (EU) 2015/719 van het Europees Parlement en de Raad van 29 april 2015 tot wijziging van Richtlijn 96/53/EG artikel 1, zesde lid; Wegenverkeerswet 1994 artikel 71

This regulation amends the Regeling diervoeders 2012 to cap the gross phosphorus content of compound feed for cattle at 4.3 g per kg, or a phosphorus-to-crude-protein ratio above 2.2, for dairy farms receiving feed between 15 May 2017 and 1 January 2018. Farms that show their 2017 total ration held under 3.5 g gross phosphorus per kg dry matter are exempt, subject to registration and a data authorisation.
Wet dieren 6.2, eerste lid, 6.4, 7.1, 9.1 en 10.1; Besluit diervoeders 2012 2.1, 2.3, 2.4 en 3.8, eerste lid, onderdeel b; Besluit diergeneesmiddelen 8.5

This amending regulation updates the 2017 cost-recovery amounts charged to market parties for ACM supervision, including fees for number allocation and the per-category sector cost shares in Annex 3. It also explains that the amounts follow ACM's 2016 costs and that the regulation takes effect the day after publication, departing from the usual fixed change dates.
Instellingswet Autoriteit Consument en Markt artikel 6a, zevende lid

This ministerial regulation replaces Annex I of the police travel, accommodation and relocation cost decree with a new tariff list of maximum lodging and other cost amounts per country and city, effective from 1 April 2017 with retroactive effect. It updates the rates periodically based on UN Daily Subsistence Allowance schedules, adjusted in consultation with police trade unions.

It is a purely technical amendment that reflects a pending amendment to the Participatiewet.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation, issued by the State Secretary for Education, sets the 2017 programmes of requirements and material maintenance funding for primary, special and secondary special education, and the per-position amount for travelling schools. It also repeals the previous years' equivalent regulations.

Wet op het primair onderwijs 113, eerste, vierde lid, en 118, derde, negende en tiende lid; Wet op de expertisecentra 111, eerste, vierde lid, 113, eerste lid, en 128, zesde lid; Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 89a, tweede en derde lid; Besluit trekkende bevolking WPO B18

This amending decree (twaalfde tranche) adds new development areas and several municipal experiments under the Crisis- en herstelwet, extending time limits and exempting specific projects such as an ice storage structure and dwelling sites from building permit and Bouwbesluit rules. It also allows Nijkerk, Stichtse Vecht, Nederweert, Delft, Peel en Maas and others to deviate from environmental and building rules for set periods, and lets municipalities impose emission and wastewater measures.
Crisis- en herstelwet 2.2, 2.3, zevende lid, en 2.4
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending regulation allows an overbruggingsuitkering (bridging benefit before the AOW age) to be claimed up to one year retroactively, as long as the claim is filed before the claimant reaches the pensioengerechtigde leeftijd. The SVB may depart from the filing deadline in exceptional cases, and the change takes effect on 1 October 2016 to reduce non-take-up of the benefit.
Kaderwet SZW-subsidies 3, eerste lid, juncto artikel 9; Wet structuur uitvoeringsorganisatie werk en inkomen 34a

This regulation amends the NVWA fee regulation so that the hourly rate charged for work performed by KDS on behalf of the NVWA rises from EUR 12.00 to EUR 13.66 per quarter hour, reversing earlier temporary reductions because KDS's agreed capital buffer had fallen below the agreed level. It takes effect on 1 October 2016 and departs from the usual two-month publication lead time for policy reasons.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends Annexes 1 and 2 of the Regeling zorgverzekering to update the monthly list of reimbursable registered medicines, adding, replacing and removing entries and changing a condition for fingolimod. It takes effect on 1 October 2016 with a retroactive clause if published later.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation sets the 2016 adjustment and the 2017 operating-cost funding amounts for secondary schools, including per-school, per-pupil, learning-material and supplementary allocations. It applies the 2016 price-adjustment percentage to existing amounts and fixes the figures for 2017 under articles 86 and 89 of the Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs.
Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 86, vijfde en zesde lid, 89, eerste lid, en 89a1, tweede, derde en vierde lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This amendment to the 2016 subsidy scheme for first-line residential care raises the subsidy ceiling by EUR 53.6 million across Wlz care offices, with region-specific amounts. It also adds a mechanism by which the Zorginstituut redistributes unused subsidy amounts among Wlz executors when final subsidies are set, and it is made retroactive to 1 June 2016.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation sets rules for redistributing leftover funds when 2015 first-line residential care subsidies are finalised below the maximum granted amount, so that surplus is paid to Wlz providers whose realised care exceeded their subsidy. The Zorginstituut Nederland applies the increase ex officio without an application, and the regulation lapses on 1 January 2017 except for subsidies already granted under it.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation implements two EU Commission directives on coding of human tissues and cells and on equivalent quality and safety standards for imported tissues, including traceability codes, product coding systems, expiry dates and split numbers. It also sets recognition and designation conditions for tissue establishments and repeals the earlier Regeling voorschriften erkenning Wvkl, taking effect on 29 April 2017.

Richtlijn 2006/86/EG (Commission Directive, EU) and Richtlijn 2015/566/EU n.v.t.; Wet veiligheid en kwaliteit lichaamsmateriaal artikel 9, vierde lid; Eisenbesluit lichaamsmateriaal 2006 artikelen 3.7, tweede lid, en 7a.8
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation sets the 2015–2016 personnel funding amounts per pupil and for school leadership, small schools, special-needs pupils, disadvantage programmes and salary harmonisation for primary schools in the Caribbean Netherlands. It adjusts the amounts by 3.43% to reflect updated civil-service employment conditions, sets monthly payment percentages, and repeals the earlier 2015–2016 regulation.
Wet primair onderwijs BES 103, eerste lid, 164, vierde lid, en 166; Besluit bekostiging WPO BES 17, 18, 19

This amending regulation corrects omissions and errors in the 1 July 2016 amendment to the Regeling uitvoering GMO groenten en fruit, covering fruit and vegetable producer organisation operational programmes. It adjusts flat-rate expenditure rates, transitional rules for adding activities to older programmes, submission deadlines, and the timing of entry into force.

Verordening (EU) nr. 1308/2013 artikelen 32 tot en met 36; Verordening (EU) nr. 543/2011 artikelen 50 tot en met 90, 96 tot en met 110, 113 tot en met 115, 117 tot en met 127 en 143 tot en met 148; Landbouwwet artikelen 13, eerste lid, onderdeel b, 15 en 19, eerste lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This Regeling amends the 2016–2017 primary education personnel funding regulation to replace the existing supplementary funding for foreign children with a new maatwerk scheme for asylum-seeking children, paid per quarter with reduced amounts where growth funding applies. It also sets the application procedure, documentation requirements, and per-student amounts for first reception of foreign pupils in special primary schools, with a retroactive effective date of 1 August 2016.
Wet op het primair onderwijs 116 en 123
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends the Subsidieregeling publieke gezondheid for 2017: it redefines the cervical cancer screening subsidy calculation (new HPV-test, self-sampling and follow-up categories and tariffs), indexes several subsidy amounts, and extends the regulation's validity to 1 January 2022. It shifts tariff-setting for cervical screening from the NZa to the ministry itself.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This amending regulation sets, for the fourth quarter of 2016 (1 October to 31 December 2016), a new norm interest rate of 2.3% and a norm monthly savings premium of EUR 95.77 used for housing subsidy calculations under the old Wet BEW. It replaces the parameters that applied from 1 July to 30 September 2016.
Wet van 21 december 2006 tot wijziging van de Wet bevordering eigenwoningbezit (verruiming en vereenvoudiging van de werking van de Wet bevordering eigenwoningbezit) (Stb. 734) artikel II, vierde lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation amends the Arbeidsomstandighedenregeling to add a temporary exception to the substitution rule for volatile organic substances, allowing methylmethacrylate floor coatings to be used for repairing and maintaining existing floors in dwellings and buildings when rapid use is necessary within 7 days and suitable alternatives are not feasible. The exception expires on 1 August 2020 and applies retroactively from 1 August 2015.

This regulation amends Annex 1 of the Regeling geurhinder en veehouderij to update odour emission factors for broiler housing systems, raising them after new measurements, and to correct system numbers and redactional errors from earlier amendments. It is a technical update to emission factors and system references with no change to citizens' rights or powers.

This ministerial subsidy regulation sets rules for subsidising collective projects by companies in the BRZO sector that strengthen safety culture, chain responsibility and safe industrial sites or clusters, with a EUR 2 million ceiling per year for 2016 and 2017. It sets eligible costs, subsidy rates capped at EUR 500,000, scoring criteria, grounds for refusal, first-come-first-served allocation, and a horizon to 1 October 2021, operating under the EU general block exemption regulation.
Kaderwet subsidies I en M 3, eerste lid, onderdeel b, 4, eerste en tweede lid, en 5; Kaderbesluit subsidies I en M 2, eerste lid, 4, 6, zesde lid, 7, derde lid, 8, 10, tweede lid en 13

This ministerial regulation sets rules for subsidising collaborative projects by companies in the BRZO sector (industrial activities with hazardous substances) that strengthen environmental safety, covering safety culture, supply-chain responsibility, and safe industrial estates or clusters. It fixes the subsidy ceiling of EUR 2,000,000 for each of 2016 and 2017, allocation on a first-come basis, eligible costs, subsidy caps, assessment criteria, and grounds for refusal.
Kaderwet subsidies I en M 3, eerste lid, onderdeel b, 4, eerste en tweede lid, en 5; Kaderbesluit subsidies I en M 2, eerste lid, 4, 6, zesde lid, 7, derde lid, 8, 10, tweede lid en 13
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling uitvoering Wet arbeid vreemdelingen 2014 to make permanent a relaxed regime under which work permits for qualified Asian-cuisine cooks (levels 4 to 6) are granted without the labour market test on priority candidates, for up to two years. The permits are subject to employer obligations on continued employment, training and pay, and may be refused or withdrawn if these are not met.
Wet arbeid vreemdelingen 8, derde lid, 10, 11, derde lid, en 22
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This regulation amends the Regeling langdurige zorg for 2016, adding bridging care rules, raising the 2016 persoonsgebonden budget ceiling and budget tables, updating regional budget amounts for 2015 and 2016, and revising transitional rules for care recipients moving from the AWBZ to the Wlz. It also sets reporting models for the CAK and changes the budget-revocation grounds.

Wet langdurige zorg 3.1.1, tweede lid, 3.2.1, vijfde lid, 3.3.2, achtste lid, 3.3.3, eerste en zesde lid, 3.3.6, vijfde lid, 4.3.1, derde lid, 4.3.2, tweede lid, 6.2.5, onder d, 6.2.6, eerste en tweede lid, en 11.1.8; Besluit langdurige zorg 3.1.1, vierde lid, 3.6.2, tweede lid, 3.6.3 en 4.2.1, tweede lid; Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg 49e
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

The regulation amends the Regeling Wfsv to abolish the separate calculation rules and sub-sector premiums for the graphic industry, with the sector premium set on a single sector basis from 2017 and the abolition of the sub-sector structure from 2018. It also changes the ratio for the agricultural sector's differentiated premium so that long-term contracts pay at least one-fifth of the short-term premium, aligning it with other sectors.
Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen 95, eerste lid; Besluit Wfsv 2.2, achtste lid, en 2.3, eerste en tweede lid

This ministerial regulation sets the hydraulic boundary conditions (design water levels for return periods of 100, 150, 300 and 1000 years) that the manager, Rijkswaterstaat, must use to assess whether non-primary flood defences along state-managed canals and waterways meet the safety standards in the Waterbesluit. It also fixes the regulation's citation name and entry into force on 1 October 2016.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation sets rules for additional, result-dependent funding paid to mbo (vocational education) institutions for reducing early school leaving, for 2018 and 2019, capped at 36.5 million euros per year. It defines how the number of new early school leavers is calculated per institution and training type, with percentage norms, maximum amounts per institution, and redistribution of unused funds.
Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.2.3, tweede en derde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation sets the rules for the 2017-2020 regional approach to early school leaving, including the conditions for subsidy to contact schools running regional programmes and the reporting duties for regional coordination functions. It also sets the budgets and annual effectiveness reporting for the regional RMC coordination function.

Wet overige OCW-subsidies 2, 4, eerste lid en 5; Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 118i, derde lid; Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 8.3.2, vijfde lid en 8.3.3, derde lid; Wet op de expertisecentra 162c, derde lid; Besluit regionale meld- en coördinatiefunctie voortijdig schoolverlaten 1 en 4, eerste lid, onderdelen a, b, c en d
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation removes the 1 October 2016 reference date from the supplementary funding rules for educating newly arrived migrants in secondary schools, so that schools receive the temporary 'maatwerkbekostiging' instead of additional funding for that date. It also alters the wording of article 14a and makes the change retroactive to 1 July 2016 to avoid overlapping applications.
Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 85a, eerste lid; Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.2.3, derde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation sets the 2015–2016 school-year funding amounts for staff (personele bekostiging) and pupil-support allowances in primary, special and secondary education, based on the statutory funding provisions cited in its preamble. It mainly fixes numerical amounts per school type, pupil and staffing category, with some procedural rules for special-purpose allocations such as schipperskinderen and Roma/Sinti pupils.

Wet op het primair onderwijs 116, 120, vijfde lid, 123, eerste en vierde lid, 124, eerste en tweede lid, 125, eerste lid, 129, eerste lid, 132, eerste en derde lid, 137, vijfde lid, en 180a, tweede lid; Wet op de expertisecentra 113, 114, 117, vierde, vijfde en achtste lid, 120, 124, eerste lid, 131, vierde lid, en 166a, tweede lid; Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 85b, tweede lid; Besluit bekostiging WPO 11a, tweede lid, 19, eerste lid, 22, 26 en 28a, tweede lid; Besluit bekostiging WEC 10b, tweede lid, 30, eerste lid, 31, 33a, eerste en derde lid, en 35; Besluit trekkende bevolking WPO B 16b, B 16g, B 16l, B 21, C 11, eerste en tweede lid, en C 16.1; Regeling prestatiebox primair onderwijs 2015-2020 3, derde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation inserts a new article 1a into the Regeling examenprogramma's voortgezet onderwijs stating that it is also based on article 6 of the Eindexamenbesluit VO BES, thereby giving formal legal grounding to exam programmes already applied in the Caribbean Netherlands. It applies the vwo, havo and vmbo exam programmes to Bonaire and Sint Eustatius with retroactive effect to 1 August 2013.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation establishes a temporary Taskforce on cooperation between education and childcare, with an independent chair and up to ten members, operating from 1 October 2016 until it delivers its final report by 1 April 2017 at the latest. It tasks the taskforce with proposing measures, possibly including regulatory changes, to ease cooperation between education and childcare or playgroup work, and sets rules for appointment, dismissal and archiving.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This amending decree to the Besluit zorgverzekering, effective 30 September 2016 with application for the 2017 equalisation contribution, merges the variable care cost and nursing care macro sub-amounts into one, adds new equalisation criteria (FDG, VGG, GGG, IGG) and revises existing ones such as PPA, AVI, SES and GGZ-MHK. It consists of technical changes to the risk-equalisation model without new obligations or sanctions.
Zorgverzekeringswet artikel 32, tweede lid en artikel 34, derde lid

This omnibus AMvB amends four maritime and rail regulations: it removes the maximum age of 67 for North Sea pilots' certificates, corrects several cross-references, harmonises rules on anchoring and spud poles and life-jacket use in the Binnenvaartpolitiereglement, and redraws the Rotterdam and Scheldemonden approach areas in the territorial sea and Westerschelde regulation. It takes effect on 1 January 2017 and is described as having no significant consequences for citizens or firms.
Loodsenwet artikel 5, eerste lid; Scheepvaartverkeerswet artikel 4, eerste lid, onderdeel a; Spoorwegwet artikel 6

The regulation amends the Regeling genetisch gemodificeerde organismen milieubeheer 2013 by updating lists of host organisms in annex 2 and pathogenic micro-organisms in annex 4, and correcting a sub-section of annex 9 on storage of GMO waste. It is a technical update to keep the risk-assessment lists current, adopted without prior publication because the changes are minor.
Besluit genetisch gemodificeerde organismen milieubeheer 2013 2.2, eerste lid, en 2.10, eerste lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This temporary ministerial regulation distributes a 4.968 million euro budget among vocational education institutions to fund learning materials for minor students in the vocational track whose families cannot afford them. It sets rules on the distribution, spending, accountability and a requirement that institutions publish a transparent application procedure, and it expires on 1 August 2017.
Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.2.3, tweede en derde lid

The regulation amends Article 128 of the Uitvoeringsregeling Meststoffenwet to exempt all farms that filed a request under Article 70a(3) before 1 February 2016 from the dairy phosphate surplus cap of Article 70a(1) for calendar year 2016. It is a retroactive-style repair measure because about 90 farms had been found not to meet the conditions, and land could no longer be acquired in 2016 after 15 May 2016.
Meststoffenwet 38, 43 eerste lid onderdeel c, en 45

This ministerial regulation amends article 16 of the Drinking Water Regulation to repair how exemptions are granted for intake of surface water used for drinking water production. It clarifies that the prohibition on preparing drinking water from non-compliant surface water does not apply where the water is treated adequately, and ties exemptions to drinking water quality exemptions and supervisor discretion.
Drinkwaterwet artikel 22, derde en vierde lid; Drinkwaterbesluit artikel 30, eerste, vierde en vijfde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation replaces the model voter card (stempas) and the model written proxy voucher (schriftelijk volmachtbewijs) in the Kies- en referendumregeling for the 2016 re-division elections of the Meierijstad municipal council. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatscourant, outside the usual fixed change dates, so the municipalities have time to distribute the documents.
Kieswet J 7 en L 11, tweede lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending regulation updates footnote 9 in the annexes of the Woonlandbeginsel regulation and the June 2016 amending regulation so that the residence-country principle for Morocco follows the 4 June 2016 Protocol, effective 1 October 2016. It also corrects article 2a of the regulation to cite the renumbered ANW articles as the legal basis.

Algemene Kinderbijslagwet 12, tweede lid; Algemene nabestaandenwet 17, derde lid, 18, vierde lid, 29, derde lid, 29a, zesde lid, en 67, negende lid; Wet op het kindgebonden budget 2, elfde en twaalfde lid; Wet werk en inkomen naar arbeidsvermogen 62, tweede lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

The regulation raises the subsidy ceiling for museum publieksactiviteiten in the Regeling op het specifiek cultuurbeleid from €58.65 million to €60.791 million. It also adds article 3.4a to the Regeling beheer rijkscollectie en subsidiëring museale instellingen, allowing the minister to add amounts to museum subsidies reflecting price and wage developments, deviating from ceilings if needed.
Wet op het specifiek cultuurbeleid 4a; Besluit op het specifiek cultuurbeleid 4; Erfgoedwet 7.7

This amending decree updates the Besluit aanwijzing hoofdspoorwegen by moving the Blauwkapel – Utrecht Maliebaan line into the designated main railway list and removing the Utrecht Maliebaan – Lunetten section and the Hengelo Zuid stamlijn from it, reflecting track decommissioning approved earlier. It is a technical list update with no new obligations, sanctions or policy choices.

This amendment raises the minimum insured amounts under the Dutch motor vehicle liability insurance decree to match the EU-required indexation: EUR 6,070,000 per event for personal injury, EUR 1,220,000 for property damage, and EUR 10,836,000 for buses over eight passengers. It applies to accidents occurring after entry into force on 1 January 2017.

This decree amends the Implementing Decree of the Patent Act 1995 to transpose Directive 2013/55/EU on recognition of professional qualifications for patent attorneys, including shortening required experience from two years to one, accepting qualifications and foreign traineeships, and refusing recognition for the lowest qualification level. It also corrects references and extends the scope to Switzerland.
Richtlijn 2013/55/EU; Rijksoctrooiwet 1995 artikel 23a, zesde lid, en 23c, zesde lid

A temporary exemption from the Besluit gebruik meststoffen ban and the Uitvoeringsregeling Meststoffenwet sowing deadline lets arable farmers spread manure and sewage sludge on arable land from 1 to 15 September 2016, provided winter oilseed rape or a cover crop is sown by 16 September. The exemption excludes arable land on sand or loess soil with silage maize in 2016, and the regulation expires on 16 September 2016.
Wet bodembescherming artikel 64, tweede en derde lid; Meststoffenwet artikel 38, eerste en derde lid

This ministerial regulation sets the application and auction procedure for two FM-band frequency licences for non-national commercial radio, licences B27 and B31, including eligibility requirements, deposits, scarcity determination, bidding rules and award. It also amends the 2003 commercial radio frequency designation regulation to extend a period and update references to the 2014 National Frequency Plan.

This amending regulation changes the Regeling veiligheidseisen burgerexploitant militaire luchthavens so that civil operators at military airports must meet civil aerodrome safety rules, except that ICAO recommended practices need not be followed where military safety requirements make compliance impossible, and a reduced guide block for military aircraft arrestor gear is exempt from certain rules. It also replaces a cross-reference to specific articles with a reference to the whole certification chapter.
Wet luchtvaart 10.11, eerste lid, in samenhang met 8a.1, eerste lid, en 8a.3, tweede lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This amending decree adds tularemia and Zika virus infection to the list of group C notifiable infectious diseases in the Besluit publieke gezondheid, creating a duty to report them. The duty is limited to mainland Netherlands for tularemia and to pregnancy, congenital cases, and hospitalisation or death for Zika, with those limits set under the Regeling publieke gezondheid.
Wet publieke gezondheid 19; Wet publieke gezondheid 22, vierde lid

This Dutch AMvB (Besluit slachtoffers van strafbare feiten, 2016) implements EU Directive 2012/29 on victims' rights by setting rules on victim support organisations, information to victims at first contact, protective measures, individual assessment of protection needs, special measures for vulnerable and minor victims, and restorative justice safeguards. It fills in delegations in the amended Code of Criminal Procedure (articles 51aa, 51ab, 51h) and allows further detail to be set by ministerial regulation.
Wetboek van Strafvordering 51aa, derde lid, 51ab, tweede lid en 51h, vierde lid

This decree sets the educational requirements for the Hbo training to become a gerechtsdeurwaarder (bailiff) and the conditions for ministerial recognition of such training, including accreditation and a maximum of two kandidaat-gerechtsdeurwaarders per bailiff (three for a transitional period). It also transitions the existing recognition of Hogeschool Utrecht and regulates the reporting of trainee placements to the KBvG.

This decree designates the Raad voor de rechtspraak (Council for the Judiciary) as the body that keeps the central register of debt-rescheduling (schuldsanering) arrangements under the Bankruptcy Act, replacing the legal aid council's LRS register. It also revokes the earlier designation decision for the raad voor rechtsbijstand and takes effect the day after publication.

This ministerial regulation establishes an independent Commission to evaluate the point-allocation system for subsidised legal aid, with a chair, up to five members, and a final report due by 1 June 2017. The Commission must also propose reallocating points without increasing expenditure and advise on removing negative incentives, after which it is dissolved.

This amending regulation rewrites article 20 of the Rpbr so that security organisations from other EU member states can obtain a licence by providing a certificate from an accredited body, including under the EN 50518 standard series supplemented by additional Dutch requirements. It also allows the minister to waive the certificate requirement once for up to six months for new applicants.

This amending decree renames the Herinneringsmedaille Vredesoperaties to Herinneringsmedaille Internationale Missies and replaces the terms 'vredesoperatie', 'vrede' and 'operatiegebied' with 'internationale missie', 'internationale rechtsorde' and 'missiegebied' in the 2001 decree. It also drops the second medal for holders of five or more clasps, and transfers clasp awards to the new decree from 1 July 2016.
Besluit van 23 maart 2001, houdende instelling van de Herinneringsmedaille Vredesoperaties artikel 1 tot en met 15
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation updates Annex XII of the SUWI Regulation so that it points to version 12.0 of the SUWI data register, which describes data processed through the electronic SUWI facilities. It also removes the version reference to 9.0 from article 6.2, first paragraph, since the current version is now stated in the annex.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation updates the Regeling financiën hoger onderwijs, changing the amounts for teaching and research allowances, the lump-sum amounts and distribution percentages for universities and universities of applied sciences, and adjusting data specifications for student registration. It implements budget figures for the 2016 recalculation and the 2017 Ministry of Education budget.

Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek 7.52, tweede lid; Uitvoeringsbesluit WHW 2008 4.11, eerste en tweede lid; 4.21, eerste en tweede lid; 4.23, eerste en tweede lid; 4.24, eerste lid

This ministerial regulation amends several noise-management regulations (Rgm, Rdg, geluidplafondkaart, Reken- en meetvoorschrift) to add efficiency conditions to sanitation measures for road and rail noise, such as minimum lengths and heights of barriers and rail dampers, so that measures with little acoustic effect are no longer considered. It also sets transitional rules keeping earlier rules in force for certain pending programmes and projects.

Wet milieubeheer 11.1, eerste lid, 11.18, eerste lid, 11.22, vijfde lid, en 11.33, zevende lid, onderdelen a en b; Wet geluidhinder 104a, vijfde lid, laatste volzin; Besluit geluid milieubeheer 31, vierde lid; Besluit geluidhinder 3.9 en 4.22
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This AMvB sets the conditions under which landlord and tenant may agree an energy performance fee for very energy-efficient rental dwellings, including maximum warmth demand, minimum on-site renewable generation, and maximum fee amounts per square metre. It also requires annual energy reporting to tenants, individual metering, and a points adjustment in the rent valuation system to avoid double payment.
Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte 10, eerste lid, en 19bis, tweede en derde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation sets the 2016 amounts of fees that provinces, municipalities, public bodies, water boards and joint arrangements pay to the National Ombudsman for handling complaints about their administrative bodies. It adjusts the amounts in the Vergoedingenbesluit Wet Nationale ombudsman 2006 by a factor of 0.985 under the annual price-index mechanism, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2016 and expiry on 1 January 2017.
Vergoedingenbesluit Wet Nationale ombudsman 2006 4, tweede lid, en 6

This amending regulation adds simplified vehicle authorisation requirements for rail vehicles operating on the HSL-Zuid high-speed line and the Venlo–German border section, adds automatic train registration and other technical changes to the rolling-stock regulation, and sets a reduced fee for such applications. It is issued under the Spoorwegwet and the Besluit spoorverkeer.
Spoorwegwet 36, derde lid, onder e, en 91; Besluit spoorverkeer 42, tweede lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling studiefinanciering 2000 so that a student's whole loan switches from the higher-education to the vocational-education repayment regime at the start of the repayment phase, and it updates the tuition-fee regulation to set 2017–2018 lesgeld and cursusgeld tariffs, which are unchanged from 2016–2017 after indexation. It also restructures the tuition regulation into a base regulation to be amended yearly.
Wet studiefinanciering 2000 12.14, zesde lid; Les- en cursusgeldwet 5, tweede en derde lid; Uitvoeringsbesluit Les- en cursusgeldwet 2000 15, tweede en derde lid

This Ministerial Regulation amends the Vrijstellingsregeling Wft to exempt professional court-appointed administrators (bewindvoerders) and curators from the licensing requirement for brokering, and from Wft conduct rules in part 4 of the Wft, when acting in their professional capacity. It also corrects a duplicated article numbering and widens the earlier exemption, which had covered only the opening of payment and savings accounts, to all brokering activities for their clients.
Wet op het financieel toezicht 2:85, tweede lid, en 4:7, eerste lid

The Secretary of State for Economic Affairs temporarily bans the veterinary medicine Velactis (cabergoline) for use on, administration to, or near animals in the Netherlands, with immediate effect. Veterinarians must promptly inform those to whom they prescribed or supplied the product of the ban.
Verordening (EG) nr. 726/2004 artikel 45; Wet dieren artikelen 5.2 en 5.11

The decree amends the Activiteitenbesluit milieubeheer to remove obsolete R- and S-risk phrases from article 2.30 in line with the EU CLP regulation, and repeals spent transitional rules. It adds two new articles letting the competent authority, via a site-specific maatwerkvoorschrift, relax NOx limits for existing gas turbines and CxHy limits for existing gas engines where cost-effective measures are not feasible.
Verordening (EG) nr. 1272/2008 61, vierde lid, en 62, tweede alinea; Wet milieubeheer 8.40 en 8.42

This AMvB adds a new section to the Waterbesluit setting safety standards (overschrijdingskansen such as 1:100, 1:150, 1:300, 1:1000) for segmented non-primary flood defences managed by the Rijk, including specific dike sections and their boundaries in attached annexes. It also makes minor technical amendments and adds the Noordervaart canal dikes to the list of Rijk-managed defences.
Waterwet 2.4, 3.1, eerste tot en met derde lid, en 6.6
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

The regulation adds a new Article 18a to the Regeling Pensioenwet BES allowing a pension fund with a running short-term recovery plan to extend that plan by up to two years, provided it submits a revised plan at least four months before expiry. It sets out required measures, cut timing rules, annual evaluation by De Nederlandsche Bank-approved criteria, and permitted spreading of final reductions over up to three years.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation amends the Dismissal Regulation after the abolition of the VAR declaration, tightening the conditions under which work outsourced to self-employed persons can justify dismissal and under which dismissal protection and redeployment apply. This ministerial regulation replaces the annex to the 2012 Regulation on the country-of-residence principle in social security, updating the residence-country factors (percentages of Dutch cost levels) used to scale benefits paid abroad. This ministerial regulation amends the Binnenvaartregeling, the Regeling voorkoming verontreiniging door schepen and the Regeling nucleaire drukapparatuur, mainly to update crebo training codes, correct cross-references and boat licence models, and tighten the sulphur limit for fuel on Dutch inland waters. This ministerial regulation sets out under the Bailiffs Act which events a bailiff must report to the Financial Supervision Office (Bureau Financieel Toezicht) and which additional events and quarterly figures may be reported. It also specifies that reports can be filed digitally or in writing and that data must be submitted electronically within the deadline set by the Bureau.

The regulation amends the Regeling erkenning bedrijfsvoorraad so that dealers in mopeds may include end-of-life mopeds in their stock for a single four-week period, allowing them to collect such mopeds for dismantling by an approved demolition company. It is intended to channel discarded mopeds to licensed dismantlers, given their limited geographic spread.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This decree amends several civil service regulations (ARAR, ARSG, RDBZ, BBRA 1984 and others) to align working-time terminology and weekly rest norms with the Working Time Act, and introduces a uniform Rijksbrede performance conversation cycle with a written report, excluding the Staten-Generaal staff who keep their own rules. It also corrects salary amounts and a technical omission from a previous decree with retroactive effect.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending decree changes the premium calculation for the WGA disability insurance, so that large and medium-sized employers who return to public insurance from self-insurance have their total historical WGA costs, public and private, taken into account from 1 January 2017. It also removes the technical distinction between WGA-vast and WGA-flex premiums and transfers staart-costs of formerly self-insured employers to the Werkhervattingskas reserve.

This amending decree tightens the generic qualification requirements for career and citizenship (loopbaan en burgerschap) in senior secondary vocational education (mbo) by making critical thinking skills and knowledge of human rights mandatory parts of every qualification, effective 1 August 2016 for new entrants. It also adds a transitional provision exempting students who began before that date.
Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 7.2.4, vijfde lid

This amending regulation changes several fiscal and benefits implementing regulations: it narrows the duty to report changes to the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen (partnership start and end, certain income and wealth increases, hours worked for childcare allowance), splits a payroll-data field on disability wage discounts into three, drops two payroll data fields, and lets the Belastingdienst support private taxpayers and intermediary organisations in filing returns. It also sets electronic reporting standards for country-by-country reports under the Vpb Act.

This ministerial regulation implements the Wet precursoren voor explosieven by setting rules for licence applications to the ILT (including a VOG and proof of use), a ground for refusal where security or public order is at stake, and obligations for market operators selling restricted precursors (labelling, staff instruction, ID and KvK checks, sales records, and data provision to the ILT on request). It also sets the procedure for reporting suspicious transactions to the Meldpunt Verdachte Transacties Chemicaliën.

verordening (EU) nr. 98/2013 van het Europees Parlement en de Raad van 15 januari 2013 over het op de markt brengen en het gebruik van precursoren voor explosieven Hoofdstuk-independent reference; regulation as a whole; Wet precursoren voor explosieven artikel 4, zesde lid; artikel 5, tweede en derde lid; artikel 6, tweede lid; artikel 8, tweede lid; artikel 9, derde lid

This regulation amends the 2008 asylum seekers' own-contribution regulation to extend its application to permit holders housed under the Gemeentelijk Versnellingsarrangement and updates the economic value of benefits, the income exemption amount (from 183 to 196 euro) and the list of income types, including child benefit (zorgtoeslag) and study finance. Wet Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers artikel 3, derde lid

This ministerial regulation raises the maximum expense reimbursement that volunteers may receive for passenger car transport from EUR 181.51 to EUR 1,500 per volunteer per year, and removes the cap for volunteer organisations. It thereby widens the space in which volunteer transport falls outside the Wp2000 taxi rules, and it is to be evaluated after two years.

This ministerial regulation adds articles 44a and 44b to the Dutch ship safety regulation, setting out a calculation method for the verified gross mass of loaded containers under the SOLAS convention and a permitted tolerance margin between calculated and actual mass. It takes effect on 1 July 2016 and implements an international IMO requirement without new enforcement powers.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation replaces the examination programme for culturele en kunstzinnige vorming (CKV) for havo and vwo with a new version organised in four domains (exploring, broadening, deepening, connecting). It sets transitional rules so the old programme is phased out in 2018-2019 (havo) and 2019-2020 (vwo), with the new one first examined in 2017-2018.

This amending regulation updates the Regeling geluidwerende voorzieningen 1997 to add noise-insulation programmes for Rotterdam and Lelystad airports and removes the obsolete Schiphol provisions, LAeq bedroom insulation, and outdated references. It also replaces the technical annex on noise insulation of external building envelopes and the noise-contour maps.

This amending regulation updates the Rva 2005 on reception benefits for asylum seekers to align with the Gemeentelijk Versnellingsarrangement (municipal acceleration arrangement) for housing refugees with residence permits. It extends benefit eligibility, transfer powers, cost-recovery from residence permit holders with means, and termination of benefits for false statements, and fixes several technical references.
Wet Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers artikel 3, derde lid

This omnibus amending regulation makes several corrections and changes to aviation regulations: radio equipment requirements for 8.33 kHz channel spacing, altimeter use on Schiphol parallel approaches, ceremonial flyovers at national commemorations, exemptions for police and coast guard public-interest flights, and fee tariffs. It also restores historic aviation flight-operation rules that had been removed in error.
