Wet overige OCW-subsidies artikel 2, eerste lid, juncto artikel 4, tweede lid

This amendment to the Regeling wapens en munitie creates a 'small license holder' category for firms whose only activities are engraving, bluing or other surface treatment of weapons, exempting them from the mandatory examination. It also grants these small license holders an exemption from the prohibition on possessing airsoft devices.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This AMvB amends the annex to the Besluit modellen artikel 9 Wet op de lijkbezorging, which sets the model report that doctors must file after euthanasia or assisted suicide. It replaces the term verpleeghuisarts with specialist ouderengeneeskunde, requires doctors to give an email address, and revises the euthanasia execution section so regional review committees can assess care more consistently with the 2012 KNMG/KNMP guideline.
Wet op de lijkbezorging artikel 9, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Dutch implementing regulation on direct payments under the EU Common Agricultural Policy, clarifying definitions such as light soil cultivation, minimum activity for ecological focus areas, set-aside rights from the national reserve, the deadline for reporting transfers of payment entitlements, and rules on landscape elements, catch crops and fertiliser use. It is a technical update implementing EU regulations and is largely procedural and administrative in nature.

Verordening (EU) nr. 1307/2013 van het Europees Parlement en de Raad 4, eerste lid, onderdeel c; 30, vierde lid; 34; 45; 46, tweede lid; Verordening (EU) nr. 639/2014 van de Europese Commissie 45; Verordening (EU) nr. 809/2014 van de Europese Commissie 14, vierde lid; Landbouwwet 15, 19 en 24

This ministerial regulation amends the regulations on recognition of EU professional qualifications for sworn translators and interpreters and for candidate civil-law notaries, mainly replacing 'EG' with 'EU' and extending mandate provisions to the Raad voor rechtsbijstand. It also revokes two regulations (candidate bailiffs and judicial professions) that fall outside the implementing Act after transposing Directive 2013/55/EU.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This Regeling amends the Warenwetregeling retributies levensmiddelen 2008 to update NVWA inspection and control fees for food and animal-origin products, including a 22.5% reduction for New Zealand imports and new administrative-cost surcharges based on inspection time. It also introduces transit-inspection tariffs for fish and poultry consignments and takes effect on 1 April 2016.

Uitvoeringsbesluit (EU) 2015/1084 van de Commissie Bijlagen II, V, VII en VIII bij de Overeenkomst tussen de Europese Gemeenschap en Nieuw-Zeeland inzake sanitaire maatregelen (PbEU 2015, L 175); Warenwetbesluit retributies levensmiddelen artikel 11
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation fixes the list of policy indicators (across eight policy fields, such as safety, education, social domain and housing) that municipalities must use to explain the societal effects of their programmes in budgets and annual reports. It also provides that where the source holder cannot supply the data, municipalities state that the data are not available.
Besluit begroting en verantwoording provincies en gemeenten 8, derde lid, onderdeel a, en 25, tweede lid, onderdeel a
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation replaces the table of financial ratios (kengetallen) that provinces and municipalities must include in their budget, so that it also shows projected values for the three years after the budget year. It enters into force together with the 2016 amendment of the BBV budgeting decree that introduces the projected opening and closing balance sheet.
Besluit begroting en verantwoording provincies en gemeenten artikel 11, derde lid

This amending AMvB extends the delegation basis in the Besluit dierlijke producten so that ministerial rules can cover the direct supply of meat, including defining 'small quantities' under EU regulation 853/2004. It also adds a new article 2.8c allowing ministerial rules on housing and animal husbandry practices for organic breeding hens.

Verordening (EG) 853/2004 (EU food hygiene regulation) artikel 1, vierde lid; Verordening (EG) nr. 834/2007 (EU organic production regulation) artikel 42; Wet dieren artikel 2.7, tweede lid, en artikel 3.1, tweede lid, onderdeel k

This decree designates the International Residual Mechanism for Criminal Tribunals and the Residual Mechanism for the Special Court for Sierra Leone as residual mechanisms to which the Implementation Act for residual criminal tribunal mechanisms applies. It enters into force on 1 April 2016, outside the usual fixed amendment dates, to allow the mechanisms to exercise their judicial tasks in the Netherlands.

This regulation amends Annex 1 of the Regeling geurhinder en veehouderij to correct several drafting errors from the June 2015 amendment, including restoring the 'smaller than or equal' sign for low-ammonia piggery housing, correcting an odour reduction category for stud boars, and restoring the 19-day brooding period for broilers. It also raises the odour emission factor for low-ammonia fattening pig housing from 1.5 to 1.6 kg ammonia to align with the Rav and Besluit emissiearme huisvesting.

This amending regulation updates Annexes 1, 2 and 3 of the Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij by revising version numbers, adding new housing systems and additional techniques, and correcting errors such as a formula and footnotes. It is a technical update of ammonia emission factors and reduction measures used under the Wet ammoniak en veehouderij and related environmental laws.
Wet ammoniak en veehouderij artikel 1, eerste lid

This ministerial regulation amends the catalogue of public-law restrictions on land in the Uitvoeringsregeling Wkpb by adding a new code 'EW' for archaeological access obligations (gedoogplicht archeologisch onderzoek) arising under the Erfgoedwet. It enables municipalities and the Kadaster to register these restrictions, with effect aligned to the entry into force of the Besluit Erfgoedwet Archeologie.
Uitvoeringsbesluit Wet kenbaarheid publiekrechtelijke beperkingen onroerende zaken artikel 8
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

Amends the Regeling zorgverzekering to add conditionally admitted dendritical cell vaccination for stage IIIB and IIIC melanoma patients to the basic health insurance package from 1 April 2016 to 1 August 2021, limited to patients participating in the accompanying research. It implements a conditional admission decision based on Zorginstituut advice and a convenant between the involved parties, with a budget cap of about EUR 19.9 million.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling zorgverzekering to conditionally admit the drug Fampyra (for MS patients with limited walking ability) into the basic health insurance package from 1 April 2016, and makes monthly updates to the lists of reimbursed medicines in annexes 1 and 2. It also removes a previously planned article 2.5a and adds conditions for evolocumab and 6-thioguanine.

This ministerial regulation sets detailed rules for calculating compensation owed when the offshore grid is unavailable, specifying how wind speed, wind direction, power output profiles, data sufficiency and lost electricity production are measured and computed. It operationalises the Besluit schadevergoeding net op zee under the Elektriciteitswet 1998 and was drafted to implement earlier Elektriciteits- en gaswet provisions.
Besluit schadevergoeding net op zee 4, zesde lid

This regulation amends the Regeling dienstkleding Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen by removing the one-year duration clause from article 9, so that the uniform regulation applies indefinitely from 1 April 2016. The explanatory note states that a 2015 evaluation found the objectives met and that the regulation needs no substantive change.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending regulation reopens the subsidy scheme for combating poverty and debt for application windows in 2016 and 2017, each with a EUR 4,000,000 ceiling, and sets lottery as tiebreak for simultaneous applications. It also narrows priority groups for national-scale activities in 2016-2017, raises required co-financing to 25% for those windows, extends the evaluation deadline to 2020, and removes an existing mandate article.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends the Subsidieregeling vaccinatie stageplaatsen zorg, which subsidises vaccination of students in care training. It replaces the two annexes: it adds dossier-qualification CREBO codes, corrects two programme names, adds two older codes, and removes the Toegepaste Gerontologie programme because the risk of Hepatitis B exposure no longer applies.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This temporary amendment to the Scholingsregeling WW lets the UWV allow training longer than one year, up to two years, when a new employer guarantees a job of at least six months and the worker works at least eight hours a week for that employer during the training. It was introduced to extend the brug-WW beyond the sectorplannen and expires on 1 April 2018, with transitional rules for applications filed before then.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

The regulation amends the travel allowance schedule (Annex I) of the Reisregeling buitenland, updating daily lodging and other cost amounts for foreign travel of civil servants per 1 April 2016 based on UN DSA lists. It also inserts a new article 11a into the Verplaatsingskostenregeling 1989 granting a one-off €50 allowance to eligible civil servants for the loss of private transport benefits linked to public transport subscriptions, retroactive to 1 November 2015.
Reisbesluit buitenland artikel 10, tweede lid, en artikel 12; Verplaatsingskostenbesluit 1989 artikel 12bb
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation inserts annual subsidy ceilings for 29 museum institutions into the Regeling beheer rijkscollectie en subsidiëring museale instellingen, replacing the reserved article 3.4. The ceilings are calculated from institutions' own 2013–2016 budgets for collection management and housing costs, increased by 10%.

This ministerial regulation updates the annex to the Regeling omgevingsrecht by replacing references to two best-available-techniques information documents on water quality: the 2000 Algemene BeoordelingsMethodiek is replaced by the 2016 version, and the Handboek Immissietoets is replaced by its 2016 edition. The changes take effect on 1 July 2016 and operationalise the policy on very worrying substances (ZZS) in wastewater.

This ministerial regulation amends Annex 2 of the Regeling verkeersregelaars 2009 to allow road inspectors employed by road managers (with the IM incident management training) to wear a new high-visibility jacket design instead of the previous standard, with detailed specifications for colours, retroreflective bands and logo placement. It takes effect on 1 April 2016 and imposes no new obligations, as use of the new clothing is optional for road managers other than Rijkswaterstaat.
Besluit administratieve bepalingen inzake het wegverkeer artikel 58, onder i

This amending decree inserts into the Waterbesluit a new article 4.5a requiring a maritime spatial plan for the Dutch marine waters (territorial sea and EEZ), made part of the National Water Plan, and sets a deadline of 31 March 2021 for its inclusion. It implements EU Directive 2014/89/EU on maritime spatial planning by adding definitions and procedural content requirements.
Richtlijn 2014/89/EU (kaderrichtlijn maritieme ruimtelijke planning) artikel 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13 (as referenced); Waterwet artikel 4.3

This decree sets rules under the Veiligheidswet BES for designating businesses that must maintain a company fire brigade and for requiring disaster-response plans for designated installations and airfields on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. It also sets information-provision duties for disaster and crisis management and the procedure for designations, including reports from installation operators and public information obligations.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This amending decree (Besluit van 5 maart 2016) modifies the BBV, the regulation governing budgets and accounts for provinces and municipalities. It introduces uniform policy areas (taakvelden) for operational information, adds indicators, overhead cost reporting, corporate tax lines, and changes to balance sheet, depreciation and EMU-balance reporting.
Provinciewet 190, eerste lid; Gemeentewet 186, eerste lid

This decree implements EU Regulation 1143/2014 on invasive alien species in the Netherlands, prohibiting listed handlings (with a permit system for others) and making the Minister of Economic Affairs responsible for emergency measures, eradication and permit decisions. It also sets criminal penalties under the Economic Offences Act, removes the national designation of certain species under the Flora- and faunawet, and extends ministerial access powers to designated land.
Flora- en faunawet 14, tweede en derde lid, en 18, eerste lid; Verordening (EU) nr. 1143/2014 preamble reference only (EU regulation, not a statutory basis in the Dutch sense)

This regulation amends article 1, paragraph 2 of the Sanctieregeling Belarus 2006 by changing a cross-reference to article 2 paragraph 6 so that it conforms to amended EU Regulation 765/2006. It implements the EU decision that financial sanctions on certain persons and entities, suspended until 29 February 2016, lapse.
Verordening (EU) nr. 2016/277 van de Raad van 25 februari 2016 tot wijziging van Verordening (EG) nr. 765/2006; Sanctiewet 1977 artikel 2, tweede lid, en artikel 3
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling zorgverzekering to set the monthly bestuursrechtelijke premium amounts from 1 July 2016 for defaulting policyholders (EUR 127.91) and for uninsured persons (EUR 122.33). It also removes the year limitation on the 23 percent remittance to the state treasury and deletes an obsolete transitional provision.
Zorgverzekeringswet 18d, eerste en zesde lid, 18e, tweede en derde lid, en 18g, vierde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation sets the 2016–2017 per-pupil and per-school funding amounts for staff (personele bekostiging) and pupil support in primary and secondary special education, based on the Wet op het primair onderwijs, Wet op de expertisecentra and related decrees. It also fixes special grant rules for specific pupil groups such as schipperskinderen, Roma and Sinti pupils and children from 'Blijf van mijn lijf huizen'.

Wet op het primair onderwijs 116, 120, vijfde lid, 123, eerste en vierde lid, 124, eerste en tweede lid, 125, eerste lid, 129, eerste lid, 132, eerste en derde lid, 137, vijfde lid, en 180a, tweede lid; Wet op de expertisecentra 113, 114, 117, vierde, vijfde en achtste lid, 120, 124, eerste lid, 131, vierde lid, en 166a, tweede lid; Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 85b, tweede lid; Besluit bekostiging WPO 3a, 11a, tweede lid, 17, derde lid, 19, eerste lid, 22, 26, 28a, tweede lid, en 31; Besluit bekostiging WEC 3a, 10b, tweede lid, 30, eerste lid, 31, 33a eerste en derde lid en 35; Besluit trekkende bevolking WPO B 16b, B 16g, B 16l, B 21, C 11, eerste en tweede lid, en C 16.1; Regeling prestatiebox primair onderwijs 2015–2020 3, derde lid

This amending decree (Wijzigingsbesluit financiële markten 2016) amends several financial-markets regulations, including the Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, to add a licensing regime for crowdfunding intermediaries, a commission ban exemption for crowdfunding platforms, changes to permanent education and EVC procedures, a ban on insurer commissions from fund managers, and updated fine categories and terrorism-financing references. It also contains technical adjustments for Caribbean Netherlands rules.

Wet op het financieel toezicht 1:80, tweede lid, 1:81, 2:3.0d, derde lid, 2:3.0i, derde lid, 2:3.0m, derde lid, 2:3b, tweede lid, 2:3c, eerste lid, 2:5, tweede lid, 2:7, tweede lid, 2:10b, tweede lid, 2:10c, eerste lid, 2:12, vierde lid, 2:17, tweede lid, 2:21, tweede lid, 2:26b, derde lid, 2:26e, tweede lid, 2:26f, tweede lid, 2:31, derde lid, 2:37, tweede lid, 2:41, tweede lid, 2:45, tweede lid, 2:49, tweede lid, 2:51, tweede lid, 2:54b, derde lid, 2:54e, tweede lid, 2:54h, derde lid, 2:54j, tweede lid, 2:54m, tweede lid, 2:58, tweede lid, 2:63, tweede lid, 2:69d, vierde lid, 2:78, tweede lid, 2:83, tweede lid, 2:89, tweede lid, 2:94, tweede lid, 2:97, achtste lid, 2:99, derde lid, 2:115, tweede lid, 2:120, tweede lid, 2:121, tweede lid, 3:5, vierde lid, 3:9, derde lid, 4:3, vierde lid, 4:9, 4:10, derde lid, 4:25a, 4:37o, 4:37p; Wet financiële markten BES 3:5
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This amending regulation adjusts several VWS subsidy regulations so that the new Kaderregeling subsidies OCW, SZW en VWS either does not apply or applies only to specified articles, with some specific thresholds and reserve rules for palliative care network subsidies. It is a technical alignment of existing subsidy schemes with the new framework, effective 1 April 2016.

This amending regulation removes the fixed 1 April 2016 deadline for developing and certifying taxi on-board computer software from the one-off subsidy scheme and moves that date into the individual subsidy decision instead. It also deletes a cross-reference in article 8 of the subsidy scheme, and the change is made because the original deadline was no longer realistic.
Kaderwet subsidies I en M artikel 5, onderdeel c

This ministerial regulation amends the fee schedule under the Flora- and faunawet to add a €45 charge for issuing a music instrument certificate under EU implementing regulation 865/2006, which allows non-commercial cross-border movement of instruments containing protected species products. It also updates references to the EU regulation, the competent minister, and the cross-references to article numbers.
Verordening (EG) nr. 865/2006 van de Commissie artikel 44 nonies; Flora- en faunawet artikel 78

The regulation amends the Regeling statistieken goederenverkeer by lowering the statistical thresholds for intra-EU trade reporting (Intrastat) to €1,000,000 for arrivals and €1,200,000 for dispatches for 2016 and 2017, and allows firms to file annual instead of monthly reports when the CBS permits. It also sets retroactive effect to 1 January 2016, deviating from the usual policy on fixed change moments.
Wet op het Centraal Bureau voor de statistiek artikel 38c, eerste en derde lid

This decree amends four Dutch financial-supervision AMvBs (Bgfo, prudential rules, market access, administrative fines) to implement the 2014 UCITS amending directive on depositary tasks, depositary delegation and liability, remuneration disclosure, and depositary minimum capital. It also adds administrative fine categories for the newly listed provisions.

Wet op het financieel toezicht 2:3i, tweede lid; 3:53, derde lid; 4:62m, derde en vierde lid; 4:62o, vijfde lid; 4:62p, zesde lid; 4:62q, tweede lid; 4:62r, vierde lid; 4:62v, tweede lid; 4:62w, vierde lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Aruba naturalisation test regulation so that the director of the Directie Onderwijs in Aruba, rather than the head of the Examenbureau Aruba, is the official authorised to issue naturalisation test certificates. It is given retroactive effect to 1 January 2011 to validate certificates already issued in practice.
Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap 23; Besluit naturalisatietoets 6

This ministerial regulation amends the examination requirements for the theory and practical driving tests for the T-category (agricultural/forestry tractors and low-speed motor vehicles) licence, adjusting wording on vehicle documents, seatbelt use, dashboard operation, and parking/securing the vehicle. It is a minor, technical update effective 1 July 2016.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling aanwijzing buitenlandse diploma's volksgezondheid to adjust recognition rules for foreign medical, nursing and midwifery diplomas, implementing EU Directive 2013/55/EU. It also makes technical changes to the Regeling erkenning EG-beroepskwalificaties, including renaming the act and widening the register-based scope of prior checks.
Algemene wet erkenning EG beroepskwalificaties 33; Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg 46

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling nationale EZ-subsidies and the Regeling openstelling EZ-subsidies 2016 to open 2016 subsidy rounds for SME innovation (MIT) projects, Eurostars, ITEA3, PENTA and the Groeifaciliteit. It also adjusts rejection grounds, the knowledge-voucher procedure, the application dates for submitted requests, and the budget ceilings.
Kaderbesluit nationale EZ-subsidies 2, tweede lid, 4, aanhef en onderdeel e, 5, 16, 19 en 25

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling nationale EZ-subsidies, title 4.8, on subsidies for energy-efficiency plans of small and medium enterprises in the MJA3 covenant. It corrects drafting errors, clarifies that subsidies are paid per establishment, tightens a refusal ground, and adds paper and cardboard industry to a list of sectors.
Kaderbesluit nationale EZ-subsidies 2, tweede lid, 4, 19, 25 en 34
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation amends the 2015–2016 code tables for school and study years by adding and removing subject codes in Annexes III and IV, including new Rekentoets codes, Latin and Greek culture codes, new maritime VMBO subject codes, Technologie & Toepassing, and a Rekenen 3ER code for MBO. It is a purely technical data-coding change, made retroactive to 1 August 2015 so that it applies to the current school year.
Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 103b, derde lid; Wet op de expertisecentra 164a, derde lid; Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.3.6a, derde lid, en 2.5.5a, derde lid

This ministerial regulation designates the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment as the competent authority under the EU Ship Recycling Regulation, with the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) issuing and withdrawing recognition of ship recycling facilities. It also makes breach of the operator duties in Article 13(2) of the Regulation a prohibited act, enforced by the ILT through administrative orders and penalty payments.
Verordening (EU) nr. 1257/2013 inzake scheepsrecycling preamble (Gelet op); Wet milieubeheer 9.5.2 and 21.6, sixth paragraph
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This amendment to the Besluit decentralisatie- en integratie-uitkeringen adds and changes annual 2014 grant allocations to provinces and municipalities for many policy areas, and removes four earlier grant provisions. It also sets 2012 allocations for certain municipal grants and backdates its effect to 1 January 2014 (or 2012 for some articles).

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling genetisch gemodificeerde organismen milieubeheer 2013 by correcting naming errors, duplicates and alphabetical ordering in Annexes 2, 4 and 7, and by adding newly classified micro-organisms and plants to those lists. It also reclassifies certain viruses as strictly animal-pathogenic and adds plant-pathogenic bacteria and fungi to the classification tables, and takes effect 1 April 2016.
Besluit genetisch gemodificeerde organismen milieubeheer 2013 2.2, eerste lid, en 2.10, eerste lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation adds a results-dependent budget (resultaatafhankelijk budget) to the Regeling kwaliteitsafspraken mbo, rewarding vocational schools for placing students in diplomas at a higher level than their prior education predicts, with rules on study value, baseline and threshold values, distribution key and payment. It also makes related technical renumbering and terminology changes, with the new budget applying from 2016.
Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.2.3, tweede lid, en 2.7

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden to add exceptions to the ban on pesticide use outside agriculture, covering safety-necessary sites, invasive plant control on paved surfaces, and certain sports and recreation terrains. It also removes a prior article and replaces an enforcement offence in the annex with a new one for unpermitted pesticide use.
Besluit gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden 27b, tweede lid, en 33a, eerste lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This regulation sets out the policy rules (beleidsregels) that the State Secretary of Social Affairs will apply when assessing applications for public assistance (onderstand) under the Besluit onderstand BES in the Caribbean Netherlands, and when attaching conditions to such assistance. It repeals the 2015 policy rules and makes the new rules effective retroactively from 1 January 2016.
Besluit onderstand BES 5, 6, 10, 12, eerste lid, 20, en 33

This ministerial regulation sets up the 2016 agricultural census and combined return, requiring farmers to submit farm, livestock and parcel data electronically by 15 May 2016 (CO2 data by 1 July 2016). It also determines eligibility for animal health fund payments and the electronic-submission exemptions.

Verordening (EU) nr. 1305/2013 28 en 36, eerste lid, onderdeel a; Verordening (EU) nr. 1306/2013 72, eerste, derde en vierde lid; Verordening (EU) nr. 1307/2013 12, 24, 30, 32 en 33; Landbouwwet 24 en 25; Uitvoeringsbesluit Meststoffenwet 26; Besluit heffing preventie dierziekten 12a; Besluit kostenverevening reductie CO 2 -emissies glastuinbouw 4
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This regulation amends the Besluit on the fees of the chair and members of the Toetsingscommissie vangnet Participatiewet, renaming the commission and lowering the labour-time factor from 0.08 to 0.05 to reflect a reduced workload after the 2015 introduction of the safety-net benefit. It also updates the citation title and sets the reduced factor indefinitely, with the minister to reconsider once workload estimates are available.
Wet vergoedingen adviescolleges en commissies artikel 2, eerste lid

This temporary ministerial regulation grants exemptions from the runway-use rules of the Schiphol airport traffic decree (LVB) so that air traffic can be handled differently during major maintenance on the Buitenveldertbaan and the Zwanenburgbaan (ALCMS works) in 2016. It sets no replacement noise limits yet; those are to be added later by amendment, and the regulation expires on 1 November 2016.

This regulation implements EU directive 2014/91/EU on UCITS depositary tasks, remuneration and sanctions in the Dutch financial supervision regulations, adding publication of sanctions, supervisory cooperation and information-exchange rules, and renumbering or correcting cross-references. It also creates an exemption from the licensing requirement allowing certain entities to act as alternative depositaries for closed-ended funds meeting specified conditions.
Wet op het financieel toezicht 1:24, vierde lid, 1:25, vierde lid, 1:51e, 1:69, derde lid, 1:105, tweede lid, en 2:3h

This amending regulation corrects the Regeling risicoindicatoren for the deposit guarantee scheme under the Wft: it clarifies that the test date (t) values are used, converts cumulative quarterly net income into actual quarterly figures, and replaces the normalisation table and risk category score table. It also states that DNB will only start levying contributions after entry into force, using 31 December 2015 as the test date.
Besluit bijzondere prudentiële maatregelen, beleggerscompensatie en depositogarantie Wft artikel 29.12, vierde lid

This regulation, issued by the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Environment, sets detailed rules implementing the Besluit risico's zware ongevallen 2015 under the Seveso III Directive. It specifies information exchange, hazardous substance lists, safety report contents, risk calculation, review procedures, incident reporting and amendments to related regulations.
Besluit risico's zware ongevallen 2015 4(5), 6(8), 7(7), 8(5), 10(13), 11(7), 12(3), 13(18), 14; Besluit omgevingsrecht 4.4(1); Besluit externe veiligheid inrichtingen 14(2)
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

The regulation amends the Regeling modellen diploma's VO to add new diploma, transcript and certificate models, including versions for candidates who receive the judicium cum laude, and a revised model for students with severe arithmetic problems who take an adapted maths test. It also updates references to the Eindexamenbesluit, Staatsexamenbesluit and the College voor toetsen en examens, with effect from 1 April 2016.
Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 29, derde lid; Staatsexamenbesluit VO 30, vijfde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation amends two data-delivery regulations so that schools report the grade and type (2F, 3F, 2ER, 3ER) of the arithmetic test, including the new remedial test for serious arithmetic problems, and reduces reporting to the final or highest result. It also adds the Wet op de expertisecentra as a legal basis so special secondary schools can deliver examination data, effective 1 april 2016.
Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs artikel 103b, derde lid; Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs artikel 2.3.6a, derde lid

This decree amends the Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 and the Besluit uitvoering Wet arbeid vreemdelingen, mainly by merging and extending the job-search year for foreign graduates and researchers into a single residence permit condition in article 3.42, alongside many technical corrections and cross-reference fixes. It also revokes ten older decrees and sets an effective date of 1 March 2016, with one provision backdated to 9 July 2015.
Vreemdelingenwet 2000 14, derde en vierde lid, 37, eerste lid, onder b, 50, eerste lid, 52, eerste lid, 54, eerste lid, 66b, tweede lid, en 112; Wet arbeid vreemdelingen 3 en 4, tweede lid, onder c

This amending decree to the Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 creates a fast-track asylum procedure for applications likely to be declared inadmissible or manifestly unfounded, and a separate 'procedure bij voorzienbare inwilliging' allowing quick granting for nationality or group-based applications when the minister decides so. This internal ministerial regulation organises the Directorate for Legislation, Administrative and Legal Affairs of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment into departments and sets out which tasks each head handles. It grants internal mandates and powers of attorney to department heads and staff for signing documents, court representation, freedom-of-information decisions, and small contracts.
Organisatie-, mandaat- en volmachtbesluit secretaris-generaal SZW 2009 3, eerste lid, onderdeel k, en 11

This regulation fixes the 2015-2016 Christmas holiday and the 2016 summer holiday for schools on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, with options for schools to extend or deviate from these periods. Wet primair onderwijs BES artikel 20, tweede lid; Wet voortgezet onderwijs BES artikel 47, tweede lid

It adds an opt-out for diagnosis information in youth mental health care and is intended to be superseded by a definitive regulation once the Veegwet VWS 2015 takes effect.
Jeugdwet 7.3.11, vijfde lid; Burgerlijk Wetboek 7:457, eerste lid

This Besluit amends several financial-market regulations, including the Besluit prudentiële regels Wft, to implement the Solvency II directive and regulation for insurers. It introduces a new category of 'verzekeraar met beperkte risico-omvang' with simplified prudential rules on governance, capital, technical provisions and investment.

This decree designates the international organisations, legal persons and private categories from which De Nederlandsche Bank may request data for financial stability and statistics, and sets the response period (at least three weeks) and cost reimbursement rules. It also fixes the base amount of the administrative fine at EUR 5,000 for late provision of requested information, adjustable by up to 100 percent downward or 50 percent upward.
Bankwet 1998 9d, eerste lid, aanhef en onderdeel b, tweede, derde en vierde lid, en 9g, tweede lid

The regulation revokes the Tijdelijke regeling vervoersverbod bijen Berg en Terblijt 2015, a temporary ban on moving bees within and out of Berg en Terblijt imposed after an outbreak of American foulbrood. It takes effect immediately because screening showed the disease was no longer present in the municipality.
Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren 30, eerste lid, en 31

The regulation amends the STEP and FEH energy-saving subsidy schemes for rental housing to require additional verifications with subsidy applications: declarations that energy indices were determined per BRL 9500, proof of physical inspection dated within six months, and a list of planned energy-saving measures. It also adds transitional rules allowing landlords to withdraw and resubmit earlier applications, and mandates an evaluation within six months.
Kaderwet overige BZK-subsidies artikel 4, eerste lid, onderdelen d en e; Kaderbesluit BZK-subsidies artikel 11, derde lid

Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

Wet arbeid vreemdelingen 3, eerste lid, onder c, 4, tweede lid, onder c, en 19d, tweede lid

It also obliges banks, on request, to hand over bank statements showing rent or childcare payments and the identity details of third parties with access to accounts used for benefit payments, for up to five years, to detect benefit fraud.

This decree amends the Arbeidstijdenbesluit vervoer to align it with EU Regulation 165/2014 on smart tachographs, replacing references to the old 1985 regulation and reassigning competent authorities. It also adds a Warenwet rule banning devices designed to manipulate tachographs, with a fine of €525.

This AMvB amends the Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 and the Besluit vergoedingen rechtsbijstand 2000 to implement EU Directives 2013/32/EU (asylum procedures) and 2013/33/EU (reception standards). It rewrites rules on suspension of removal during asylum applications, safe countries of origin, registration, accelerated and border procedures, medical examinations, detention grounds, and legal protections for unaccompanied minors and applicants.

It also adjusts rules on packaging, protective equipment, labelling, carcinogen/mutagen definitions and youth/pregnancy restrictions, with a transitional period for mixture labelling until 31 May 2017.

This amendment to the Reglement voor de binnenvisserij 1985 extends the IJsselmeer definition to include the Markermeer and IJmeer, and lets the minister set by ministeriële regeling a minimum mesh size for staand net fishing in specific periods. It also obliges fishers to keep records of fishing effort and report them periodically or on request, to help protect fish stocks.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

It also indexes maximum rent limits by -3.8% and requires the minister to report to the Staten-Generaal two years after entry into force.
Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte artikel 10, eerste lid; Wet waardering onroerende zaken artikel 37h

This AMvB revokes the Rechtspositiebesluit WPO/WEC, the remaining regulation on appeal committees (commissies van beroep) in primary and special education, effective 1 August 2015. The revocation follows the Wet werk en zekerheid, which removed the statutory basis for requiring such committees, and transitional rules keep the old regime for decisions taken before entry into force.
Wet op het primair onderwijs (WPO) artikel 33, tweede lid; Wet op de expertisecentra (WEC) artikel 33, tweede lid; Wet werk en zekerheid artikelen XXIb en XXId

This amendment to the Besluit inburgering raises the maximum integration loan from €5,000 to €10,000 and allows alphabetisation courses to be financed with it. It also extends debt forgiveness on the loan to family members of asylum holders and EU long-term residents with international protection annotation, retroactively from 1 January 2013.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This Staatssecretaris regulation amends the Regeling langdurige zorg, adding transitional rules for the move from the AWBZ to the Wet langdurige zorg, raising the persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) amounts for 2015 per region, and allowing transport costs to be reimbursed directly to the PGB holder. It also adds new conversion profiles (zorgprofielen) and grounds for refusing a PGB where the helper poses a risk.
Wet langdurige zorg 3.1.1, tweede lid, 3.1.3, tweede en lid, 3.3.2, achtste lid, 3.3.3, eerste en zesde lid, en 11.1.8; Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg 49e, eerste lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation amends the ESF 2014–2020 subsidy scheme, mainly clarifying chapter V on sustainable employability of workers, defining that term, extending maximum project duration from ten to twelve months, and opening new application windows in chapters III and V. It also raises the ESF 2007–2013 subsidy ceiling in chapter II, Action A, from €30 million to €36 million.
Kaderwet SZW-subsidies 3, eerste en vierde lid, 5 en 8, eerste lid

It shifts detention and inadmissibility decisions toward immigration officials and sets out fairly detailed criteria for when a subsequent asylum claim counts as aimed at delaying removal.
Vreemdelingenwet 2000 artikel 6, vijfde lid, 59, 59a en 59b; Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 artikelen 3.1, vijfde lid, 3.106a, vierde lid, 3.106b, tweede lid, 3.113, negende lid, 3.121 en 5.5

The regulation amends the Regeling invoer, uitvoer en verkeer van planten to implement EU Implementing Decision 2015/789 against Xylella fastidiosa, adding article 12r on import bans, inspection, movement restrictions from demarcated zones, record-keeping and notification duties for professional operators, and a ban on coffee plants from Costa Rica and Honduras. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatscourant.

The regulation adds a new subsidy title (3.3) to the European EZ subsidy scheme, enabling fisheries organisations to receive up to 75-85 percent subsidy for innovation projects that help fishers comply with the landing obligation by improving selectivity or survival of fish species. It also adds procurement rules (three quotes for contracts above 25,000 euro), an advisory committee, and an hourly rate for own labour, and opens the subsidy windows for 2015.
Verordening (EU) nr. 1303/2013 not specified; Verordening (EU) nr. 508/2014 not specified; Kaderwet EZ-subsidies artikel 3

This policy rule amends the Uitvoeringsregeling rechtstreekse betalingen GLB to set out how the early warning system applies to certain cross-compliance breaches, giving farmers one warning per condition within three years before a 1 percent reduction applies. It also defines the criteria for assessing intent in non-compliance with cross-compliance conditions and sets escalating percentages for repeat breaches.

This ministerial regulation amends the normering (scoring rules) of the Regeling standaarden examenkwaliteit mbo 2012, so that the Inspectie van het onderwijs rates exam quality per standard (two-point scale) and derives the programme's overall rating from the three standards, instead of letting a single insufficient indicator drive the overall verdict. It also reserves the 'slecht' rating for programmes failing all three standards and applies retroactively from 1 January 2015.

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling erkenningen luchtwaardigheid 2008 to restore an accidentally deleted provision allowing acceptance inspections for remotely piloted aircraft (RPA) to obtain a special certificate of airworthiness. It also rewrites article 30 to renumber its paragraphs and update a cross-reference to the amended article 29a.

This regulation amends the Regeling doorberekening kosten ACM so that the 0676 number range, used for broadband internet access in rural areas under a temporary decree, is classified as subcategory B rather than A for ACM cost recovery purposes. It carves 06761 to 06769 out of the general 067 category and assigns them the subcategory B fee treatment.
Instellingswet Autoriteit Consument en Markt artikel 6a, zevende lid; Besluit doorberekening kosten ACM artikel 10, derde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation amends the normering (scoring rules) of the Regeling standaarden examenkwaliteit mbo 2012 so that the Inspectie van het onderwijs judges exam quality in two steps (per standard, then overall) instead of three. It changes the overall grade so that 'onvoldoende' applies when one or two standards are unmet and 'slecht' only when none are met, and it takes effect retroactively from 1 January 2015.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

It applies the General Administrative Law Act's subsidy and consent provisions and lets the minister reduce subsequent subsidies if transferred funds exceed what is needed.

This amending regulation changes article 57 of the Regeling handel in emissierechten so that the Dutch emissions authority can suspend crediting of allocated emission allowances when a notification or the carbon-leakage list threatens timely allocation. It also clarifies that the suspension is a formal decision by the emissieautoriteit, open to objection and appeal, which the national administrator then implements.
Richtlijn 2003/87/EG (ETS-richtlijn) artikel 11, tweede lid; Wet milieubeheer artikelen 16.29 en 16.45

This temporary ministerial regulation implements the energy-audit and cost-benefit analysis provisions of Articles 8 and 14 of the EU Energy Efficiency Directive for Dutch enterprises and industrial installations. It requires large enterprises to undergo energy audits by 5 December 2015 and repeated every four years, and requires cost-benefit analyses for certain new or renovated large combustion and waste-heat installations, with supervision by the competent authority and RvO.
Wet milieubeheer 21.6, zesde lid, jo. 8.40, eerste lid

Legesbesluit akten burgerlijke stand artikel 1, tweede lid

This temporary ministerial regulation, implementing Article 92 of MiFID II, exempts managers of investment institutions based in other EU member states from the Wft licensing requirement for certain investment services in the Netherlands, subject to a notification procedure. It also exempts such cross-border branch operators from most conduct-of-business rules except listed articles, and requires the AFM to notify foreign supervisors of Dutch managers' cross-border plans.
richtlijn 2014/65/EU (MiFID II) artikel 92; Wet op het financieel toezicht artikel 1:25, vierde lid, 2:104, eerste lid, en 4:7, eerste lid

It enters into force the day after publication, and the explanatory note states that the change extends the permitted variety lists without altering regulatory burden.

This regulation amends the Regeling diergeneesmiddelen to add a new exemption allowing the veterinary vaccine Coxevac to be administered to sheep against Q fever, despite the general prohibition in the Wet dieren. The exemption runs indefinitely, is conditional on administration by a veterinarian with Dutch-language labelling, and is made retroactive to 1 January 2015 to fill a gap after the earlier exemption lapsed.

The regulation amends the Besluit gemeentelijke parkeerbelastingen by raising the maximum amount of the post-payment charge (naheffingsaanslag) for unpaid parking levies from EUR 59 to EUR 60 from 1 January 2016, in line with the annual consumer price index adjustment provided in the decree. The explanatory note sets out the price index calculation and confirms the rounding and publication rules.
Besluit gemeentelijke parkeerbelastingen artikel 3, tweede lid

This regulation amends the Regeling verstrekkingen asielzoekers 2005 to implement EU Reception Directive 2013/33/EU, redefining family members and minors, expanding information duties, allowing temporary exclusion from reception in emergencies, and restating grounds for withdrawing benefits. It adds new provisions on vulnerable persons and on transfers between reception facilities, with safeguards for proportionality and family unity.
Wet Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers 3, derde lid

The regulation adds Opdivo (nivolumab), when provided for the treatment of lung cancer, to the list of care excluded from the basic health insurance package in the Regeling zorgverzekering. The exclusion is a temporary 'sluis' pending price negotiations and an assessment by the Zorginstituut, because the expected budget impact exceeds €200 million per year.

Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

It attaches calculation tables (annex 1) and reporting tables (annex 2) and states that the regulation covers only the method of calculation and reporting, not how the ratios are to be assessed.

It restates the annex table mapping HBO and WO bachelor programmes to teaching qualifications (leraar vo 2e graads), including corrections to specific entries such as the omgangskunde cell.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

It also withdraws the obsolete policy rule on kopopleidingen in hbo and sets entry into force at 1 September 2015.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

Arbeidsomstandighedenwet 24, eerste en tweede lid, en 28a

It imposes notification, prevention policy, safety report, internal emergency plan and inspection obligations on operators and competent authorities.

It is a narrow technical change to eligibility criteria that broadens the pool of qualifying candidates.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

Article 3 takes effect retroactively from 1 August 2015 and the amendments are technical updates to competence descriptions.
Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 7.2.4, tweede lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

The regulation amends the Remigratieregeling to add Nigeria as a destination country in category E, correcting an earlier error that wrongly used Laos, with retroactive effect to 1 July 2014. It also fixes the indexation percentages (cao wages, consumer prices) used to update those amounts and the repayment offset caps.

Wet luchtvaart 1.5, 1.6, 2.8, onderdeel b, 2.10, eerste lid; Algemene Wet erkenning EG-beroepskwalificaties 33; Besluit bewijzen van bevoegdheid voor de luchtvaart 5, 8, eerste lid, 9, 10, tweede lid, 12, 13, eerste lid, 14, derde en vierde lid, 15, tweede en derde lid, 16, 24a, tweede lid, 24c, eerste en tweede lid, 28, eerste lid, 30, tweede lid, 31, vierde lid, 32, 33, 34, tweede lid

This subsidy regulation lets the Minister grant subsidies to Dutch NGOs for activities supporting voluntary departure of deportable foreigners, with a EUR 1,000,000 annual ceiling, first-come-first-served allocation and a 13-week decision period. It sets eligibility criteria, including a EUR 25,000-300,000 request range per 12 months, required municipal support, a EUR 1,500 per-person in-kind limit, exclusions for certain foreigners, and cooperation terms with the Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek; it expires five years after entry into force.
Kaderwet overige BZK-subsidies 2, eerste lid, onderdeel g, 3 en 4; Kaderbesluit BZK-subsidies 8 en 11, derde lid

This amending regulation changes the MIT innovation subsidy rules for SMEs in the top sectors for 2014: it lowers maximum subsidy percentages by ten points, moves R&D cooperation projects from first-come allocation to a ranked tender with five criteria including a regional co-funding bonus, and sets the 2014 opening periods and subsidy ceilings per sector. It also tightens the rule that an SME may apply only once per calendar year and updates definitions and enforcement terms.
Kaderbesluit EZ-subsidies 4, 5, tweede lid, 16, 17, eerste en vierde lid, 19, eerste lid, 25 en 50, vierde lid

The regulation adds a new paragraph to the LNV subsidies scheme allowing subsidies for shrimp fishing vessel owners to install selective fishing gear, individual cooling systems, or sorting systems, at 40% of eligible costs with fixed caps. It also opens an application window (1–30 April 2014) and sets a 1.2 million euro subsidy ceiling in the temporary opening regulation.

This regulation amends the Openstellingsbesluit LNV-subsidies 2013 by raising the subsidy ceiling in article 34f from EUR 3,000,000 to EUR 4,500,000 for projects supporting the introduction of the landing obligation in fisheries. The increase is financed from funds returned from the European Fisheries Fund and takes effect the day after publication.

A temporary ministerial regulation sets replacement noise limits for Schiphol airport for 2014 and exempts Schiphol's runway-use and route rules during the Nuclear Security Summit and the subsequent major maintenance of the Polderbaan runway. It allows night use of other runways and suspends several LVB operating rules for the security period.
Wet luchtvaart 8.23, eerste en vijfde lid

This ministerial regulation amends the transitional provision (artikel II, eerste lid) of the 123rd amendment to the Voorschrift Vreemdelingen 2000, which concerns first residence permit applications under the 2013 streamlining of admission procedures. It limits the non-application of articles 3.6a, 3.115 and 6.1e of the Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 to applications submitted before the entry into force date and matching the ministry's intended refusal timelines, and it sets entry into force on 1 April 2014.
Besluit van 17 december 2013 tot wijziging van het Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 (stroomlijning toelatingsprocedures) (Stb. 2013, 580) artikel II, tweede lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This temporary ministerial regulation sets detailed rules for municipal experiments with a centralised vote count, covering transport and storage of ballot boxes and minutes, the working of the municipal counting board, and suspension of its session. It also prescribes model minutes for polling boards and the municipal board.

Tijdelijke experimentenwet stembiljetten en centrale stemopneming 2, derde lid, en 3, tweede lid; Tijdelijk experimentenbesluit stembiljetten en centrale stemopneming 29, tweede lid, 41, tweede lid, en 46

The regulation updates the income norm amounts and standard housing costs used in creditworthiness assessments for consumer credit in Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba), indexing them to consumer price changes in 2013. The amended table takes effect on 1 April 2014.
Besluit financiële markten BES 7:17, zesde lid

This ministerial regulation amends the driver fitness standards annex (Regeling eisen geschiktheid 2000) by replacing the old provisions on syncope and loss of consciousness of unknown origin with a new chapter 11 that sets out shorter, more differentiated disqualification periods and fitness conditions for drivers of groups 1 and 2. It also removes the old paragraph 6.9 and the general text of paragraph 7.3, which now covers only sleep disorders.

This regulation amends the Regeling tarieven Plantenziektenwet to adjust the phytosanitary inspection fees charged by the NAK seed-certification body, including a corrected starting fee, a 2% indexation of sampling fees, a higher minimum sampling fee, and new separate fees for electronically versus non-electronically requested inspections. The new fees take effect on 1 May 2014 to match the growing season.

Temporarily adds security risk areas in The Hague, Noordwijk, Amsterdam, Hilversum and around Schiphol to the annex of the Besluit opsporing terroristische misdrijven for the Nuclear Security Summit 2014, enabling police to search objects, vehicles and clothing there without prior prosecutor order. The additions apply from 1 March 2014 and lapse on 1 April 2014.
Wetboek van Strafvordering 126zq, vierde lid, 126zr, derde lid, en 126zs, vierde lid

This amending decree adapts the Besluit gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden to Regulation (EU) 528/2012 on biocides, which took effect on 1 September 2013, mainly by deleting provisions now governed directly by the EU regulation. It also makes technical changes such as updated ministry names, a distributor duty to supply biocides only to authorised users, a revised fine-category structure, and new assessment methods listed in Annex 1.

Verordening (EU) nr. 528/2012 van het Europees Parlement en de Raad van 22 mei 2012 betreffende het op de markt aanbieden en het gebruik van biociden; Wet gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden artikelen 28, derde lid, 29, derde lid, 44, onderdeel b, 46, eerste en derde lid, 71, tweede lid, 75, eerste lid, en 97, eerste lid

This amending regulation adds a temporary section to the Regeling tijdelijke maatregelen dierziekten that sets a restriction zone around a poultry farm in Swifterbant hit by low-pathogenic avian influenza. Within the zone it bans transport of poultry, eggs, manure and litter, bars animal-feed and raw-milk movements except under a hygiene protocol, and requires separation of poultry from mammals and bird-contact measures.

Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren 17, 18, eerste en tweede lid, 30, eerste en derde lid, 31 en 107; Richtlijn nr. 90/425/EEG 10, eerste lid; Richtlijn nr. 2005/94/EG aanhef (no specific article cited in preamble)

This amending regulation changes the exemption clause in article 1(2) of the Iran Sanctions Regulation 2012, so that the sanctions ban no longer applies where listed articles of EU Regulation 267/2012 apply, implementing the EU's temporary suspension of several Iran sanctions under the Joint Plan of Action. The suspension lasts six months and the regulation is adopted to comply with an international obligation.

Verordening (EU) nr. 42/2014 van 20 januari 2014 tot wijziging van Verordening (EU) nr. 267/2012 betreffende beperkende maatregelen ten aanzien van Iran not specified; Sanctiewet 1977 artikel 2, tweede lid, en artikel 3
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends the Warenwetregeling retribution tariffs for food-safety inspection work by the NVWA, raising most tariffs substantially to implement a revised, cost-recovering retribution system. It also restructures tariff categories, removes a staffel for certain certificates and an article paragraph, and adjusts starting and quarter-hour rates.

This regulation removes Article 3.49 of the Voorschrift Vreemdelingen 2000, which had exempted asylum applications handled at the Schiphol reception centre from the six-day rest and preparation period. It formalises existing practice, since such applicants already receive that period since 1 January 2013, and drops the option to refer cases to the extended asylum procedure without a further hearing.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This rectification corrects two errors in a 2014 ministerial regulation amending exam programmes for mathematics A (havo and vwo) and mathematics C (vwo). It changes a school year reference in article II, paragraph 4 from 2016–2017 to 2017–2018, and a year in the explanatory note from 2016 to 2017.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation replaces the examination programmes for mathematics A havo and vwo and mathematics C vwo in the Regeling examenprogramma's voortgezet onderwijs, and corrects the subdomain A3 wording in the mathematics B and D programmes. It sets transitional rules on when pupils may sit the old and new examinations, effective 1 August 2015.
Eindexamenbesluit v.w.o.- h.a.v.o.- m.a.v.o.- v.b.o. artikel 7, eerste lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation extends the end date of the Instellingsbesluit Commissie dienstverlening aan huis from 1 March 2014 to 30 April 2014, in two provisions (articles 2(2) and 8(2)). The extension is made because the commission's work is running over.

This regulation amends the Uitvoeringsregeling Meststoffenwet, re-enacting articles 70 to 72f and annex F part B with retroactive effect to 1 January 2014, mainly on processing percentages, exemptions for certain farmers and buyers, and manure transfer rules. It also makes technical wording changes and adds a condition in article 72c that transferred manure must be applied directly to agricultural land, reflecting the statute's intent.

Meststoffenwet 1, eerste lid, onderdeel dd, onder 1°; 33a, tweede lid, onderdeel b, onder 2° en 3°, onderdeel c en onderdeel e, en zevende lid; 33b, tweede lid, onderdeel c; 33c, eerste en derde lid; Uitvoeringsbesluit Meststoffenwet 57, 58 en 60

This regulation amends the Voorschrift Vreemdelingen 2000 to implement the expanded use of biometric data in the immigration chain, setting rules on destruction and removal of fingerprints and facial images, designating the Basisvoorziening vreemdelingen as the storage register, and specifying re-enrolment of fingerprints for persons whose fingers are not permanently damaged. It also designates the documents on which biometrics are placed and the officials authorised to access and verify biometric data.
Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 8.29, eerste lid, 8.30, tweede lid, 8.32, eerste lid, 8.34, eerste en derde lid en 8.36, onderdeel d en e

This ministerial regulation amends the annex to the Regeling maximumprijzen geneesmiddelen, replacing the list of maximum pharmacy purchase prices for medicines with an updated list (the 34th actualisation) effective 1 April 2014. The prices are set as averages of reference-country prices under the Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This decree amends several general administrative measures to implement the abolition of the product and industry boards (productschappen and bedrijfschappen) by transferring or repealing their warenwet-based powers, including refrigeration rules, bread dry-matter rules, retributions, and labelling rules. It also adds an enforcement link for cosmetics claims under EU Regulation 655/2013 and updates competent-authority designations for food establishment approvals.
Warenwet 4, eerste lid, 6, 8, eerste lid, onder c, 13, 14, 32b en 33

This AMvB amends the Besluit bovenwettelijke uitkeringen bij werkloosheid van rechterlijke ambtenaren to align unemployment top-up benefits for judicial officials with the 2006 WW reforms and the civil-servant regime, changing duration, garantie age (55 to 57) and replacement rate (70%). It also amends the Besluit rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren to allow a one-year extension of the redeployment period and extends the compensation scheme for officials under 35% incapacity until 31 December 2013, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2011.

This ministerial regulation sets the fees (retributies) that businesses and other applicants owe the NVWA for inspections, certificates, laboratory work, permits and registrations, including starting rates, per-quarter-hour rates and surcharges for work outside opening hours. It is adopted under the Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren, the Wet dieren and the Plantenziektenwet and implements EU food and animal health control rules.

Verordening (EG) nr. 882/2004 (general reference, no article specified); Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren 10, eerste en tweede lid, onderdeel c, 94, 94a en 94b; Wet dieren 9.1; Plantenziektenwet 6a

This regulation repeals the plant-health provisions of the Regeling bestrijding maïswortelkever, boktor en kastanjegalwesp on the western corn rootworm, following EU Implementing Decision 2014/62/EU, and removes the chestnut gall wasp infected, core and buffer zones and their transport ban in Boskoop. It also renames the regulation to Regeling bestrijding boktor and updates the minister's title.
Uitvoeringsbesluit 2014/62/EU van de Commissie van 6 februari 2014 niet gespecificeerd; Besluit bestrijding schadelijke organismen artikel 17
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation designates Dutch production areas for live bivalve molluscs with their species and classification, and designates purification areas. It also lets NVWA temporarily adjust or close areas, and transfers the former Productschap Vis registration and area-setting functions to the state.
Verordening (EG) nr. 854/2004 (bijlage II, hoofdstuk II) bijlage II, hoofdstuk II; Warenwetbesluit hygiëne van levensmiddelen artikel 10

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling erkenning bedrijfsvoorraad so that businesses dismantling mopeds and light mopeds (snorfietsen) may deregister them online with the RDW, alongside scrapped cars and motorcycles. It takes effect on 1 March 2014 to coincide with the related change to the Activiteitenbesluit milieubeheer, and the explanatory note estimates a reduction in administrative burden.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation sets the conditions under which the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment applies for and administers money from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for 2014–2020, covering application timing, eligible costs, project duration, advances, record-keeping, reporting, final settlement and recovery. It implements Regulation (EU) No 1309/2013 and runs until 1 January 2021.

Verordening (EU) nr. 1309/2013 van het Europees Parlement en de Raad van 17 december 2013 betreffende het Europees fonds voor aanpassing aan de globalisering (2014–2020) artikel 21, eerste en tweede lid; Kaderwet SZW-subsidies artikel 3, eerste lid

This decree amends the Besluit justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens to oblige the Justitiële Informatiedienst to provide judicial data on child sexual offences to another EU member state's central authority when that state screens people for jobs involving regular contact with children. It implements article 10(3) of Directive 2011/93/EU and extends the provision beyond final convictions to include some out-of-court disposals.
Richtlijn 2011/93/EU van het Europees Parlement en de Raad ter bestrijding van seksueel misbruik en seksuele uitbuiting van kinderen en kinderpornografie artikel 10, derde lid

The regulation extends the existing cleaning and disinfection obligation for livestock transport vehicles returning empty from Lithuania to also cover vehicles coming from Poland, following an African swine fever case in wild boar there. It takes effect the same day, 18 February 2014, to limit the risk of disease introduction into the Netherlands.

richtlijn 2002/60/EG van de Raad van 27 juni 2002 houdende vaststelling van specifieke bepalingen voor de bestrijding van Afrikaanse varkenspest artikel 10, eerste en vierde lid; Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren artikelen 17 en 31

This ministerial regulation amends several ministerial regulations to align them with EU Regulations 715/2007 (Euro 5/6 light vehicles) and 595/2009 (Euro VI heavy vehicles), removing obsolete provisions and repealing nine ministerial regulations whose underlying EU directives have been revoked. It also terminates two subsidy programmes for emission-reducing retrofits and makes a transitional arrangement for LPG/CNG retrofit installations until 1 January 2015.

Wegenverkeerswet 1994 34, derde en vierde lid, 71, 71a, 99, tweede lid, en 101, eerste en tweede lid; Wet milieubeheer 9.5.1, zesde lid, en 15.13, eerste en tweede lid; Wet pleziervaartuigen 15, derde lid, onderdeel b; Besluit etikettering energiegebruik personenauto's 6a

This regulation raises the 2013 subsidy ceiling for noise sanitation of road traffic noise from EUR 15,859,000 to EUR 19,859,000 to fund the A2 Maastricht noise sanitation project. It takes effect the day after publication and is retroactive to 1 January 2013.

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling dierlijke producten's cheese section to align the compositional standards for Goudse, Edammer and Commissiekaas (Mimolette) with Codex Alimentarius standards, adjusting fat and moisture thresholds and shape and colour criteria. It is a technical update entering into force on 1 April 2014, with no new obligations or sanctions.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This Regeling amends the Ontslagbesluit so that employees who have reached the AOW (state pension) age are placed first in line for dismissal in collective business-economic redundancies, and removes the upper age limit from the 55+ protection group for other employees. It also makes technical corrections (renaming the Arbeidsinspectie, removing an obsolete article) and transitional rules for pending requests.
Buitengewoon Besluit Arbeidsverhoudingen 1945 artikel 6, derde en vierde lid

This temporary ministerial regulation exempts dairy farms meeting specified conditions from the prohibition in the Besluit gebruik meststoffen on surface application of cattle slurry, allowing emission-reducing grassland application on their own farm. It applies only in 2014, requires prior notification to RVO.nl and record-keeping, and was adopted following a parliamentary motion though not fully aligned with it.

This amending decree adapts the Dutch type-approval regulation for air-pollution emissions from engines for non-road mobile machinery to implement Directive 2012/46/EU and to correct earlier transpositions of Directives 97/68/EC and 2000/25/EC. It removes provisions on agricultural tractors now covered by the Regeling voertuigen, updates approval, marking and reporting duties, and sets the entry-into-force date.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation sets the content and layout rules for the annual accounts of the national public broadcasting institutions and Ster, adopting a new financial reporting handbook (Handboek) effective from 1 April 2014. It revokes the earlier reporting regulation, keeping it in force only for the 2013 financial year.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This regulation amends the Remigratiewet payment amounts regulation to add the United Arab Emirates as a destination country in several annexes and to update the annual gross remigration benefit table by a 0.5% indexation for 2014. It also updates the title of Annex 4 to reflect the 2014 date and applies retroactively to 1 January 2014 except for the table B change.
Besluit voorzieningen Remigratiewet 8, eerste lid, en 10, eerste lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation sets the 2014 per-pupil amounts for the regional care budget and the rebound facility supplement for the period 1 January to 1 August 2014, and adjusts the deduction for unspent RVC subsidy to use 2012 rather than 2011 accounts. It implements the annual amounts already provided for in the Besluit RVC's en regionaal zorgbudget.

Besluit RVC's en regionaal zorgbudget artikel 5, eerste lid, en artikel 6; Regeling regionaal zorgbudget, subsidie regionale verwijzingscommissies voortgezet onderwijs en reboundvoorzieningen artikel 5

This regulation introduces a one-time registration fee (inschrijfvergoeding) for businesses and legal persons applying for first entry in the Trade Register, with the amount set by ministerial regulation. It also sets fees for consulting and obtaining extracts from the register and payment deadlines, and repeals the previous Financial Decree on the Trade Register.
Handelsregisterwet 2007 49, eerste, tweede en vijfde lid, en 50, eerste en vierde lid

The regulation amends the Aanwijzingsregeling verplichtingen=kas rijksoverheid 2010 so that multi-year facility-type contracts settled through periodic payments can be treated as obligation=cash without requiring a notice period in the contract. It also clarifies that the scheme applies to facility contracts in the business-operations sphere and to certain internal obligations toward agencies, and is made retroactive to 1 January 2013.
Comptabiliteitswet 2001 artikel 3, derde lid, aanhef en onder d

This ministerial regulation updates the annual and monthly amounts of the general expense allowance for judicial officials by 1.2 percent indexation for 2014. It takes effect retroactively from 1 January 2014.
Besluit rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren artikel 7, zesde lid; Regeling algemene onkostenvergoeding rechterlijke ambtenaren artikel 1
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This amendment to the Besluit maatschappelijke ondersteuning adds Chapter IB requiring municipalities, when awarding contracts for individual support provisions, to consider a provider's commitment to continuity of the client-caregiver relationship, to require providers contractually to consult prior providers on staff takeover, and to award contracts at least three months before they take effect. It is designed to reduce uncertainty for clients and care workers during contract transitions.

This amending regulation updates the Mijnbouwregeling (mining regulation) on well design and drilling documentation, including switching the reference system to ETRS89, adding chemical-safety compliance requirements for drilling and well repair, and adjusting integrity testing, fees and reporting rules. It also amends annexes on maritime safety zones and lists of anchorage and shipping areas.

Mijnbouwwet 123, tweede lid; Mijnbouwbesluit 16, eerste lid; 17, eerste lid; 18, eerste lid; 20; 45, eerste lid; 52, achtste lid; 73, onderdelen a en b; 77; 80, tweede lid, onderdeel a; 81, derde lid; 83, derde lid; 108, onderdeel a

This ministerial regulation amends a 2002 designation regulation to appoint Kustwacht Nederland (Netherlands Coastguard) officials as supervisors for compliance with the Mining Act, and designates the Kustwacht director as competent authority for permitting visual exploration from survey vessels. It is aimed at combining offshore mining supervision with maritime safety.

This ministerial regulation amends the Financiële regeling handelsregister 2014 by inserting an article 4a that sets the one-off registration fee for first registration in the trade register at € 50,00, effective 15 February 2014. It fixes a uniform, cost-covering fee for all businesses and legal persons, as foreseen by the Handelsregisterwet 2007 following a parliamentary motion.
Financieel besluit handelsregister 2014 artikel 1, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Syria Sanctions Regulation 2012 to implement EU Regulation 1332/2013 and Council Decision 2013/760/CFSP, adjusting cross-references to exemptions from the asset freeze and arms embargo. It adds an exemption allowing imports or transport of chemical weapons materials carried out in line with UN Resolution 2118 and OPCW decisions.

Verordening (EU) nr. 1332/2013 van de Raad van de Europese Unie van 13 december 2013 not specified; Besluit 2013/760/GBVB van de Raad van de Europese Unie van 13 december 2013 not specified; Sanctiewet 1977 artikel 2, tweede lid, en artikel 3
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This decree adds dengue to the list of notifiable infectious diseases in group C of the Public Health Act regulation, creating a reporting obligation for Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, St. Eustatius, Saba) where dengue is endemic. For continental Netherlands the obligation is limited out, since dengue is only imported there and the vectors are absent.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation changes the year reference in article 3 of the Prestatiebox Voortgezet Onderwijs regulation so that the per-pupil amounts for 2014 match those of 2013. The explanatory note sets out the budget components and per-pupil amounts (146 euro per pupil, 100 euro per upper-grade vwo pupil) and notes the regulation takes effect retroactively from 1 January 2014.
Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 85a, eerste lid; Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.2.3, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling invoer, uitvoer en verkeer van planten to implement two EU implementing decisions allowing kiln-dried US hardwood lumber without a phytosanitary certificate under a Kiln Drying certificate, until 30 November 2016. It also updates the Dutch rules on Phytophthora ramorum by revising lists of sensitive plants and wood and related plant passport obligations.
Plantenziektenwet artikel 2, eerste lid; Besluit bestrijding schadelijke organismen artikel 14, aanhef en onderdeel d

Amends article 10 of the Regeling gebruik boordcomputer en boordcomputerkaarten so that a taxi driver's chauffeurskaart is withdrawn unconditionally, rather than at the minister's discretion, when the driver fails to provide a required VOG or medical certificate on request. It also adds a further withdrawal ground and renumbers paragraphs, and is justified as urgent rule-enforcement measure following court rulings that the discretionary wording undermined continuous screening.
Besluit personenvervoer 2000 83, achtste lid, onderdeel d

The regulation amends the Regeling selectie, plaatsing en overplaatsing van gedetineerden to introduce a system of promotion to a plusprogramma and demotion for good or bad behaviour, with a detention and re-integration plan and decisions by the prison director. It also makes promotion a condition for placement in limited-security regimes and sets rules on objection and appeal against demotion.
Penitentiaire beginselenwet 13, derde lid, en 15, zesde lid

This ministerial regulation amends the General implementing regulation on stimulating sustainable energy production (SDE+). It adds mandatory feasibility study and geological survey requirements for subsidy applications, harmonises the sustainability certification rules for liquid biomass, and updates agency names and forms after the Agentschap NL and Dienst Regelingen merger.
Besluit stimulering duurzame energieproductie 56, tweede en derde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation replaces Annex III to the Besluit beheer sociale-huursector, setting the 2013 audit protocol that accountants of housing associations must follow for the annual accounts, the sale of housing, tendering of social property, derivatives rules, and the dVi allocation report. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatscourant.
Besluit beheer sociale-huursector 29, derde lid, en 39a, tweede lid

The regulation adds an exception to the one-bank-account rule so that tax refunds and benefit payments may be paid into a bank account of a third party (non-NVVK, non-municipal) that holds a municipal subsidy or care-insurance contract, provided it meets NEN-ISO 9001 and the payments are part of a debt-settlement or budget-management agreement under the relevant codes. It amends the Uitvoeringsregeling Invorderingswet 1990 and the Uitvoeringsregeling Awir and applies retroactively from 1 December 2013.

This ministerial regulation makes technical corrections and updates to the Regeling uitvoering Besluit typekeuring luchtverontreiniging motoren voor mobiele machines and related regulations, aligning them with EU Directives 97/68/EG and 2000/25/EG on engine emissions. It sets temporary exemptions from the sales ban and type-approval refusal for certain engine categories and replenishment engines, and removes provisions duplicated in the Regeling voertuigen.
Richtlijn 97/68/EG; Richtlijn 2000/25/EG; Besluit typekeuring luchtverontreiniging motoren voor mobiele machines artikelen 4, derde lid, 5, derde en vierde lid, en 6, derde lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This amending regulation clarifies the Zvw-revenue definition in the subsidy scheme for hospital staff quality, requires a statement of an accountant as the attachment, and allows the application to deviate from the annual accounts with an explanation. It also extends the decision period for applications from six to ten weeks.

The regulation amends the Dutch fee schedule under the Schepenwet by reintroducing two ILT fees: EUR 98 for approving combined loading of dangerous substances in one loading unit, and EUR 456 for approval under the IMDG Code, both inflation-adjusted by 2.25%. It takes effect the day after publication, deviating from the usual two-month advance publication rule to avoid financial harm to the ILT.

This AMvB amends the Besluit algemene rechtspositie politie and Besluit bezoldiging politie to implement the 2012–2014 police labour agreement and the reorganisation accompanying the Politiewet 2012. It sets new rules on OVW points, Sunday leave, working-time modalities, smartengeld indexation, redeployment candidates, pay scales, and periodic pay increases for staff in reorganisation.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This decree removes three provisions from existing general administrative regulations that depended on the power of municipalities to establish sub-municipalities (deelgemeenten), which was abolished by the 2013 amendment to the Municipal Act. It takes effect when that statute enters into force and is purely technical.

This decree amends the Besluit rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren to require that life-appointed judicial officers have regular performance conversations (at least once a year) with their functional authority, documented in a written report on which the judge may comment. It leaves the judge's independence in deciding cases intact, with the board of the court (excluding the non-judicial member) carrying out the conversations.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This Besluit amends the Bouwbesluit 2012 with technical corrections and simplifications, including fire-safety rules for businesses keeping livestock, updated tables on compartmentation, ventilation, accessibility and alarm systems. It is mainly technical, adjusting definitions, cross-references and performance tables.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling financiën hoger onderwijs for 2014, updating amounts and percentages for education and research funding to universities and universities of applied sciences to reflect the 2014 budget and price adjustments. It also sets rules for using the personal number (persoonsgebonden nummer) in higher education, specifying what data institutions must supply to DUO and the Inspectie, and within what deadlines.
Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek 7.52, derde lid, en 7.52b, vierde lid; Uitvoeringsbesluit WHW 2008 4.11, 4.23, 4.24 en 4.27

This AMvB designates the cases in which the Dutch criminal law applies extraterritorially because UN, Council of Europe and EU instruments require Dutch jurisdiction under article 6 of the Penal Code.
