This ministerial regulation makes it an offence to trade in breach of EU Regulation 692/2014, which restricts imports of goods from Crimea and Sevastopol and related financing, insurance and reinsurance. It names the Minister of Finance and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation as competent authorities for notifications under the EU regulation.
Verordening (EG) nr. 692/2014 van de Raad van de Europese Unie van 23 juni 2014 artikel 2, artikel 3, artikel 4; Sanctiewet 1977 artikel 2, tweede lid, en artikel 3
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling bijzondere uitkering integrale projecten 2013 for the public bodies of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba by extending the period in which special grant funds may be spent from 2014 to 2015, with unspent amounts to be reclaimed in 2016. It takes effect the day after publication and applies directly to existing grant decisions without requiring their amendment.
Wet financiën openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba artikel 92, vijfde lid

This amending regulation adds a new cap of EUR 35,000 for victim compensation claims that cover both financial and non-financial harm under the Victim Compensation Fund for violent crimes. It supports a shift to all-in compensation amounts that simplifies claims and gives victims a clearer estimate of their payment.
Wet schadefonds geweldsmisdrijven artikel 4, tweede lid

This amending regulation raises the 2014 subsidy ceiling of the Subsidieregeling internationaal ondernemen 2014 to EUR 2.16 million. It also tightens eligibility: export advisory firms must have export advice and support for SMEs as a core task, and must employ staff with at least higher vocational level and three years' experience in that work.
Subsidiebesluit Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken artikel 2

This rectification corrects the annex map of the temporary airspace closure and restriction regulation for the NSS 2014 (Nuclear Security Summit) in The Hague. It clarifies explanatory notes on which airspace areas fall within the NSS Den Haag 50 zone and the Eindhoven air traffic control areas.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation amends the sectoral remuneration norm for health insurers' top officials by inserting Article 3a, which sets the 2015 maxima at 220,000, 260,000 and 300,000 euro by insured population class, the same as in 2014. The explanatory note says indexation is withheld for 2015 pending the WNT2 bill and talks with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland.
Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector 3.3 en 3.4

This ministerial subsidy scheme lets SMEs that meet export-quota or new-market conditions request a voucher of up to EUR 1,500 to cover part of the participation fees for collective trade missions or trade fair stands abroad. The voucher is redeemed by the organiser via RVO.nl, subject to a 600-voucher ceiling for 2014, de minimis rules and a three-month redemption window.
Subsidiebesluit Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken artikel 2

This amending regulation adds a condition to the 2014 Schiphol night-flight deviation scheme: during major maintenance on the Polderbaan from 1 to 21 April 2014, use of the Aalsmeerbaan is permitted only if the Kaagbaan is unusable, due to forecast wind limits being exceeded or other meteorological conditions. It also corrects a cross-reference in article 4 and sets entry into force retroactively from 1 April 2014 if publication is late.
Wet luchtvaart 8.23, eerste en vijfde lid

This amending regulation changes the Subsidy Scheme for International Excellence by revising the conditions in article 5.3 on co-financing timing, the 65/35 financing ratio, pari passu treatment and documentation deadlines. It also updates a cross-reference in article 5.5 and clarifies that a Groeifaciliteit guarantee can be combined with the subsidy.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation clarifies which pay components count as remuneration under the WNT (Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen) for top officials in the public and semi-public sector, listing included and excluded components. It also sets guidance on attributing pay components to calendar years and applies retroactively from 1 January 2014, with a transitional note on 2013.
Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector 1.9
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends Annexes 1 and 2 of the Regeling zorgverzekering, adding, replacing and removing entries for registered medicines in the monthly list of drugs covered by basic health insurance, and changing eligibility conditions for some drugs (e.g. rivaroxaban, apixaban, dabigatran, teriflunomide, leuproreline). It takes effect on 1 July 2014, with retroactive effect if published after 30 June 2014.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation sets rules for the 2015-2018 quality-improvement subsidy for mbo (vocational education) institutions, which must submit a quality plan and sign an implementation agreement to receive an investment budget for themes such as professionalisation, language and numeracy, dropout reduction, workplace training and excellence. It also sets deadlines for progress reports, evaluations, approval of the excellence component, and transitional rules, and revokes the earlier language and numeracy regulation.
Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.2.3, tweede lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This temporary subsidy scheme lets the Zorginstituut grant subsidies to Wlz-uitvoerders (zorgkantoren) for extramural treatment and medically necessary transport for insured persons not eligible for Wlz care, for 2015. It sets eligibility rules (including CIZ determinations), per-regio maximum amounts totalling about €85 million, hourly and daily rates, application, advance payment, administrative obligations and final settlement.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial subsidy scheme sets rules for subsidising training places for psychiatrists, health psychologists, psychotherapists and clinical psychologists in child and youth mental health institutions for 2015–2017, after these institutions lost their basis under the WMG with the Jeugdwet. It fixes subsidy amounts per fte training place, allocation and advance payment rules, and reporting duties for subsidy recipients.

This rectification corrects an amount in article 4 of an earlier amending regulation to the Subsidieregeling internationaal ondernemen 2014, changing the budget figure to 2.44 million euro. It is a purely technical correction of a clerical error with no change in policy.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation sets the national average personnel cost per staffing position for secondary education for 2015, separately for school-type groups and for management, teachers and support staff, and amends the 2014 per-pupil support amounts for lwoo and pro. It also revokes the earlier 2013 and 2014 cost regulation and takes effect the day after publication.
Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 85, derde lid, en 85a, eerste lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

Amends the Subsidieregeling publieke gezondheid to replace separate subsidies for sexual health care and STI testing with a single capped institutional subsidy for coordinating GGD bodies from 2015, with new target groups and a fixed maximum per GGD. It also updates GGD names, the STI testing requirements and the reporting and settlement procedure.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation sets salary maxima for top officials in the health and welfare sector for 2015, in ten pay classes from €85,590 to €228,719, and renames the 2014 maxima article. It takes effect on 1 January 2015 if the WNT2 bill lowering the statutory maximum to 100% of a minister's salary enters into force, and otherwise keeps the 2014 amounts with class J lowered to the new statutory maximum.
Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector 2.7
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation amends the Subsidieregeling overgang integrale tarieven medisch specialistische zorg by removing the requirement that specialists remain employed as medical specialists for at least twenty hours a week until 31 May 2019, and by deleting the related exception rule for early retirees. It aims to make the switch from self-employment to employment by hospitals a realistic option.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

The regulation sets rules for a one-off subsidy to landlords (housing corporations and other landlords) for energy-label improvements of at least three label steps in social rental homes below the rent-subsidy threshold, with a €395 million ceiling allocated first-come-first-served and a waiting list. It also sets subsidy amounts per home, application and verification requirements, the obligation to keep tenants' total housing costs from rising, and state-aid compliance conditions.

Kaderwet overige BZK-subsidies 2, eerste lid, onderdeel e, en 4, eerste lid, onderdelen d en e; Kaderbesluit BZK-subsidies 4, derde lid, 6, vierde lid, 8, eerste en tweede lid, 11, 20 en 23, vierde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation sets out how the Inspectorate measures and assesses primary schools' learning outcomes in Dutch language and arithmetic for the annual assessment under article 10a of the Wet op het primair onderwijs. It specifies which tests count, the norms and score thresholds per test and school group, corrections for pupil characteristics, handling of missing data, and the rules for judging results as sufficient or insufficient, with effect from 1 January 2015.
Besluit bekostiging WPO 34.4, 34.5 second paragraph, 34.6; Wet op het primair onderwijs 10a third paragraph (referenced as the statutory basis for the assessment; 9b referenced in annex A)
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation designates the Zorginstituut Nederland as the body to which healthcare providers must deliver quality-of-care information under article 66d(3) of the Zorgverzekeringswet, effective 1 April 2014. It is a short technical designation supporting patient choice and inspectorate oversight.

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling erkenning bedrijfsvoorraad so that a natural-person applicant for vehicle registration no longer needs to be physically present when the recognised company submits the signed wilsverklaring, provided the company has verified identity against an ID document. It is a deregulatory simplification intended to reduce administrative burden for citizens and firms.
Kentekenreglement 25a, tweede lid, en 28a, tweede lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation designates the special medical procedures that require a licence from the Minister of Health under the Wet op bijzondere medische verrichtingen, carrying over the list of the expiring 2007 decree unchanged except that the licence requirement for radiotherapy is narrowed to proton and other particle therapy. It also grandfathers existing licences and withdraws the Planningsbesluit radiotherapie 2009, taking effect together with the 2014 amendment to the Act.
Wet op bijzondere medische verrichtingen 2, eerste lid, 5, en 6, tweede lid

This regulation sets out the technical approval marks that child restraint systems must carry to be lawful under the Road Traffic Rules, aligning Dutch law with EU Implementing Directive 2014/37/EU and UN Regulation 129. It also recognises equivalent standards and approvals from other EU or EEA states and withdraws the 1997 child safety regulation.
Uitvoeringsrichtlijn 2014/37/EU; Wegenverkeerswet 1994 artikel 22, eerste en vijfde lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation replaces Annex 4 of the Regeling zorgverzekering, setting the 2015 country residence factors (woonlandfactoren) used to calculate contributions for treaty-entitled persons living abroad. It also corrects the 2012 France factor from 0.7685 to 0.7659 and provides for restitution of overpaid contributions.
Zorgverzekeringswet artikel 69, tweede lid; Wet op de zorgtoeslag artikel 3, tweede lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends Annexes 1 and 2 of the Regeling zorgverzekering, adding, replacing and removing listed registered medicines in the monthly reimbursement list for health insurance. It also adds or changes reimbursement conditions for apixaban, rivaroxaban, dabigatran, canagliflozin, empagliflozin and dolutegravir, effective 1 October 2014.

This ministerial regulation imposes specific transport bans, visitor restrictions, registration duties, event bans, hunting bans and housing requirements in a protection zone and surveillance zone around Kamperveen to combat highly pathogenic avian influenza. It sets the detailed rules and area delineations that build on the Regioregeling and the animal health statute.

Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren 17, 18, 30, eerste en derde lid, 31 en 32; Richtlijn 2005/94/EG (aviaire influenza) 1, tweede lid, 10, tweede lid, en 32, eerste lid; Richtlijn 89/662/EEG 9; Richtlijn 90/425/EEG 10, eerste lid

This rectification corrects the explanatory note to the 2 October 2014 amendment of the Sanctieregeling territoriale integriteit Oekraïne 2014. It replaces a passage so that deliveries under contracts concluded before 12 September 2014 are exempt, and services needed for safety after serious incidents are also exempt.

This rectification corrects a publication error in a 2014 Ministry of Economic Affairs regulation amending the national EZ subsidy rules: the transitional article is renumbered from 3.10.3a to 3.10.13a in both the regulation text and the explanatory note. It changes no substantive rights or obligations.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This rectification corrects a cross-reference error in the Regeling of 27 October 2014 that amends the statutory salary maximum for 2015 under the Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen. Article I, parts a and b, wrongly pointed to parts b and c of article 2.3(1) and should refer to parts a and b instead.
Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector 2.3, eerste lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling beleidsinformatie jeugdzorg 2011 to replace references to the municipal basic administration (GBA) with the basisregistratie personen, following the entry into force of the Wbrp. The changes are purely terminological and are made retroactive to 6 January 2014.
Wet op de jeugdzorg artikel 46, eerste lid; Besluit beleidsinformatie jeugdzorg 2011 artikelen 21, 22 en 23
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This amending regulation extends the supervisory competence of designated officials under the Drank- en Horecawet to cover the ban on alcohol for minors in publicly accessible places (article 45), giving them the Awb Title 5.2 powers including entry of places without prior suspicion. It also removes the transitional phrase requiring supervisors to be appointed within one year, so that examination passage becomes a precondition for appointment from 1 October 2014.

This temporary regulation closes Dutch airspace zones (Coepelduynen, Den Haag 50, Eindhoven, Den Haag 9, Valkenburg) to civil air traffic during the Nuclear Security Summit 2014, with a list of exemptions such as police, medical, search-and-rescue and government flights, and designates the zones as special airspace areas. It applies only for a short period from March 16 to March 29, 2014, and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment may lift restrictions earlier via NOTAM.
Wet luchtvaart 5.5, derde lid, en 5.10, eerste lid; Luchtverkeersreglement 1a, derde lid, 8 en 41, derde lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends Annexes 1 and 2 of the Regeling zorgverzekering, adding, replacing and removing entries for reimbursable registered medicines and changing the reimbursement conditions for empagliflozin and dapagliflozin/canagliflozin. It takes effect on 1 December 2014 and 1 January 2015 for the parts indicated.

This ministerial regulation implements EU Regulation 224/2014 and Council Decision 2013/798/CFSP on sanctions against the Central African Republic in Dutch law, prohibiting violations of the EU's asset freezes, financial and technical assistance restrictions, and mercenary supply. It adds a Dutch ban on exporting listed military goods to the Central African Republic, with exceptions for peacekeeping, protective equipment and certain UN-approved transfers, and designates the Ministers of Finance and Foreign Trade as competent authorities for granting exemptions.

Verordening 224/2014 van de Raad van de Europese Unie van 10 maart 2014 betreffende beperkende maatregelen ten aanzien van de Centraal-Afrikaanse Republiek -; Besluit 2013/798/GBVB van de Raad van 23 december 2013 betreffende beperkende maatregelen ten aanzien van de Centraal-Afrikaanse Republiek -; Sanctiewet 1977 artikel 2, tweede lid, en artikel 3

This Besluit amends several existing implementing decrees in the tax and benefits field, including the income tax, wage tax, inheritance, VAT, motor vehicle, excise, and environmental tax decrees. It updates cross-references, pension scheme rules, tax tables, thresholds and exemptions, and adds technical provisions on bonded warehouses and cooperative electricity tariffs.

Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001 1.7, 3.18, 3.54, 3.127, 5.20, 6.1 en 10.8; Wet op de loonbelasting 1964 18a, 31a, 32bd, 33 en 34; Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969 15; Successiewet 1956 21; Wet op de omzetbelasting 1968 11; Wet op de belasting van personenauto's en motorrijwielen 1992 14; Wet op de motorrijtuigenbelasting 1994 23a, 72, 73 en 84; Wet op de accijns 69a, 71i, 82 en 85; Wet op de verbruiksbelasting van alcoholvrije dranken 3, 28 en 32; 37 in samenhang met artikel 85 van de Wet op de accijns; Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen 38 en 70; Invorderingswet 1990 36; Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag 22, 27, 59 en 59a; Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen 38a; Wet op de internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen 8 en 11; Douane- en Accijnswet BES 4.34; Wet geldstelsel BES 14

This omnibus regulation amends numerous fiscal implementing regulations for 2014, including income tax, wage tax, premiums, excise, customs and environmental taxes, mostly updating amounts, citizen service numbers and technical procedures. It also adds new rules such as a definition of starter loans, conditions for deeds of gift and a temporary premium calculation for the Arbeidsongeschiktheidsfonds.

This ministerial regulation updates the specific and ad valorem excise rates on cigarettes and fine-cut tobacco in the Wet op de accijns, based on new weighted average retail prices effective 1 April 2014. It also adjusts the forfaitaire excise percentages for cigarettes and tobacco in article 7:17 of the Algemene douaneregeling to match.
Wet op de accijns 36, eerste lid, en 63, eerste lid

This amending regulation changes the Energy investment deduction regulation 2001 so that eligibility for certain energy investments depends on holding an SDE-beschikking 2013 or earlier, or on not having an SDE-beschikking 2014, and it adjusts the evidence requirements (omgevingsvergunning versus SDE-beschikking). It also replaces Annex 1 with a new list of qualifying energy-saving investments and renames the ministry in the Aruba/Curaçao/Sint Maarten/BES investment deduction regulation.

This decree designates the Raad voor de rechtspraak (Council for the Judiciary) as the body that keeps the public register of guardianship and administration orders under Book 1 of the Civil Code, effective 1 January 2014. It also repeals the earlier Besluit curateleregister.

This amending decree to the Uitvoeringsbesluit Meststoffenwet implements the manure processing obligation (mestverwerkingsplicht) introduced in 2014, adding rules on the registration of intermediaries and processors, including refusal, striking off and suspension of registration for unpaid fines. It also sets administrative duties for farmers, intermediaries and processors and excludes certain transfers of the processing obligation between poultry and other livestock farms.
Meststoffenwet 1, eerste lid, onderdeel cc, onder 2°, 2, eerste lid, 4, 15, vijfde lid, 33a, zesde lid, 33d, tweede en derde lid, 34, 35 en 62, tweede lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This decree sets detailed rules on which renovation works count as large-scale or small-scale renovation of rental dwellings for the landlord levy reduction under the Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 II, including investment thresholds. It also provides a basis for annually adjusting income limits in the Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte by ministerial regulation.
Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 II 1.11, vijfde lid; Grondwet 89, eerste lid

This decree amends the Besluit vergoedingen rechtsbijstand 2000 so that lawyers receive a reduced fee (2 points) for second or subsequent residence-permit applications (asylum and regular) that end in rejection, while full fees apply if the foreigner wins. It sets point values for objection, appeal and higher-appeal stages of such applications and fixes the entry-into-force dates.
Wet op de rechtsbijstand 37, vijfde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This amending decree modifies the Besluit begroting en verantwoording provincies en gemeenten to add new balance-sheet items for loans between public bodies and for deposits in the Dutch treasury (verplicht schatkistbankieren), and makes the EMU-enquête subject to the Iv3 sanction regime. It also raises the accountant's threshold for specific-grant sampling from EUR 100,000 to EUR 125,000.
Provinciewet artikel 190, eerste en tweede lid; Gemeentewet artikel 186, eerste en tweede lid

This Besluit amends the Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 to implement the Dublin Regulation: it moves the formal lodging of an asylum application earlier, before the rest-and-preparation period, and replaces the presumption that Dublin claimants may be detained with an individual, two-ground test for detention. It also makes related technical amendments and sets transitional rules and an entry-into-force date of 1 January 2014.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This AMvB amends the Pensioenwet and Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling implementing rules to make the new pension fund governance code (Code Pensioenfondsen) the reference standard and to add safeguards for omgekeerd gemengd bestuur. It also gives the supervisory board power to suspend or dismiss pension fund board members for malfunctioning and to block candidates not meeting the profile, and extends the waardeoverdracht information request period to three months.

Pensioenwet 33, tweede lid, 71, zevende lid, 76, negende lid, 101a, negende lid, 104, tiende lid, 106, achtste lid, 106a, 114, tweede lid en 179, eerste lid; Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling 42, tweede lid, 82, zevende lid, 110a, tiende lid, 110c, achtste lid, 110ca, 113a, tweede lid en 174, eerste lid; Handelsregisterwet 2007 17, eerste lid

This amending regulation updates the Dutch Uitvoeringsregeling zeevisserij to align definitions and cross-references with the new EU Common Fisheries Policy basic regulation, the GMO regulation and the 2014 fishing opportunities regulation, replacing references to repealed EU regulations. It also adds new provisions on producer organisation recognition, production and marketing programmes and withdrawal prices, updates annexes on catch bans, quotas, effort limits and reference prices, and withdraws the separate work programme regulation.

Verordening (EU) nr. 227/2013 van het Europees Parlement en de Raad van 13 maart 2013 not specified; Verordening van het Europees Parlement en de Raad van 11 december 2013 inzake het gemeenschappelijk visserijbeleid not specified; Verordening van het Europees Parlement en de Raad van 11 december 2013 houdende een gemeenschappelijke marktordening voor visserijproducten en aquacultuurproducten not specified; Verordening van de Raad van 17 december 2013 tot vaststelling, voor 2014, van de vangstmogelijkheden not specified; Landbouwwet artikelen 17 en 19; Reglement zee- en kustvisserij 1977 artikelen 3 en 4
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending decree to the Mediabesluit 2008 sets the fixed percentage split of the regional public broadcasters' budget among thirteen regional broadcasters, and reduces the subtitling obligation for the national public broadcaster's thematic channels from 95% to 50% for 2014. It also makes various technical and renumbering changes following the modernisation of the national public broadcaster and the financing shift from provinces to central government.
Mediawet 2008 2.21a, tweede lid, 2.35, tweede lid, 2.123, eerste lid, 2.136, eerste lid, 2.170, vijfde lid, 2.188, eerste lid, 3.25 en 6.27

This Besluit amends the Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 to streamline residence permit procedures, adding new articles on ex officio granting of temporary residence permits in cases such as Article 8 ECHR, trafficking victims and medical treatment, and tightening application notification and deadlines. It also changes notification modes, document delivery, and the handling of repeat applications and related legal aid classifications.
Vreemdelingenwet 2000 14, tweede lid, 16, tweede lid, 24, eerste lid, 31, derde lid, 32, tweede lid, 37, 39, derde lid, en 66
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The Minister of Health amends annexes 1 and 2 of the Regeling zorgverzekering, adding, replacing and removing listed registered medicines in the monthly reimbursement list and inserting a new conditional entry for mercaptopurine suspension in annex 2. The changes take effect on 1 January 2014, with one removal effective 1 February 2014.

The regulation amends the Somalia 2003 and North Korea 2007 sanctions regulations, adding an exception to the Somalia arms embargo for UN, AU, EU-training and other specified deliveries and a new ban on transferring proliferation-sensitive knowledge to North Korea that requires a ministerial exemption for listed university research fields. It also obliges higher-education institutions to report relevant changes in their teaching and research.
Sanctiewet 1977 artikel 2, tweede lid, en artikel 3

This decree revokes three national environmental regulations on wood preservatives (arsenic-treated wood), chlorinated paraffins and PAH-containing coatings and products, because EU REACH law no longer permits stricter national rules after the derogations expired on 1 June 2013. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, and the Council of State's advice is not published.
Verordening (EG) nr. 1907/2006 (REACH) artikel 67, derde lid; Wet milieubeheer artikelen 9.2.2.1 en 9.2.3.2
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This decree implements the Algemene pensioenwet politieke ambtsdragers, setting out the rules for building up, indexing, reducing and paying pensions of political office holders, including the deduction of contributions from salaries and benefits from 2014 onward. It also revokes earlier decrees and sets transitional rules for pre-2014 accruals and deductions.

This AMvB sets rules for training and qualifying registerloodsen, noordzeeloodsen and VTS-operators, together with their powers and duties, including accreditation, certification, medical fitness, examination requirements, and operational rules for remote pilotage. It also defines the scope of the noordzeeloods certificate and the authority of VTS-operators and police officers to give traffic instructions.

Loodsenwet 2, derde lid, 5, eerste lid, 9, tweede lid, 24, eerste lid, onderdeel e, en 47, eerste lid; Scheepvaartverkeerswet 9; Wet zeevarenden 19, eerste lid, onderdeel a; Aanpassingswet zbo's IenM aan de Kaderwet zbo's XVIII

This decree amends the Besluit bewijzen van bevoegdheid voor de luchtvaart and the Besluit luchtvaartuigen 2008 to implement EU Regulation 216/2008 (EASA basic regulation) and related implementing regulations on aviation safety, crew licensing, air traffic controllers and airworthiness. It removes national rules now covered by the EU regulations, keeping national competence mainly for defence, emergency services and Annex II aircraft.

Wet luchtvaart 1.2, tweede en derde lid, 1.5, 2.2, derde lid, 2.3, tweede, vijfde en zesde lid, 2.4, tweede, derde en vierde lid, 2.7, vierde lid, 2.9, eerste lid, tweede en vierde lid, 3.7, 3.13 eerste en vijfde lid, 3.15, eerste lid, 3.19a, derde lid, 3.22, eerste lid, 3.23, 3.25, 3.26, 3.29, 3.30, 3.31, 5.11 en 5.16
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending decree to the Besluit Wfsv sets how WGA benefit costs for flexible employment relationships that arose before 2016 are financed, shifting them to the sectoral funds or the public-sector fund rather than to employers who become risk-bearers from 2016. It also adjusts premium calculation rules for 2014 and makes several technical and renumbering changes, with most provisions entering into force on 1 January 2014 and the key financing provisions on 1 January 2016.
Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen 28, eerste en tweede lid, 38, vijfde lid, 104, vijfde en zesde, 108, derde lid, en 117b, zesde lid; Wet werk en inkomen naar arbeidsvermogen 84, achtste lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This amending decree implements parts of EU Directive 2010/31/EU on energy performance of buildings by redefining energy performance and energy performance certificates, extending the validity of certificates to ten years, and requiring owners of large publicly visited buildings to display a certificate in a visible place. The regulation sets the maximum amounts available under the life insurer rescue scheme for 2014, at EUR 277,044,170 overall and EUR 138,522,085 for per-situation and at-risk amounts. It takes effect on 1 January 2014 and applies the annual indexation provided for in the Wft.
Wet op het financieel toezicht 3:156, tweede lid

The regulation amends the Regeling vakbekwaamheid bestuurders 2012 to restate and clarify the exemptions from basic qualification theory tests for drivers holding older diplomas and certificates, replacing references to repealed regulations with direct descriptions. It also corrects a faulty cross-reference in the Regeling vakbekwaamheid beroepspersonenvervoer and takes effect on 1 October 2013.
Besluit personenvervoer 2000 28, eerste lid, onder a; Reglement rijbewijzen 156o en 156q, tweede en zevende lid

This regulation merges the former Regeling slepen and Regeling reclamesleepvliegen into one rule set on towing aircraft and objects, including advertising banner towing. It sets VFR, minimum altitude and decoupling requirements for towing flights, bans advertising towing with non-towing aircraft or noisy aircraft, restricts advertising flights by time, duration and formation size, and makes violations punishable under the noise decree.

Luchtverkeersreglement artikel 14, tweede lid; Besluit luchtvaartuigen 2008 artikel 21; Besluit van 21 mei 1981, houdende vaststelling van enige regels ter beperking van de geluidhinder door luchtvaartuigen artikel 2

The regulation amends the Tijdelijke regeling subsidie boordcomputer taxi so that the subsidy scheme's expiry date is set to 1 July 2014, matching the postponed mandatory date for taxi on-board computers. It takes effect on 1 October 2013 and departs from the usual fixed effective dates because beneficiaries would otherwise face serious disadvantages.
Kaderwet subsidies Verkeer en Waterstaat 2, aanhef en onderdeel a, en 3, tweede lid, onderdeel h

This regulation formally revokes the Regeling register voor handel in NOx-emissierechten, the ministerial rule on the registry for trading nitrogen oxide emission rights, effective 1 January 2014. It accompanies the statutory and decree-level abolition of the NOx emissions trading system, and notes that register data must still be retained until 2025.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This amending decree changes the Besluit financiële verhouding 2001 by revising the threshold for a significant and structural municipal deficit, deleting and redefining several allocation criteria (verdeelmaatstaven) for provinces and municipalities, and adjusting a one-off compensation amount for abolishing the user part of the property tax for homes over 2010 to 2013. It takes effect retroactively for several provisions, as set out in Article III.
Financiële-verhoudingswet 8, derde lid, en 22, onderdeel b
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This technical amendment corrects outdated statutory references and harmonises provisions across several education-sector implementing decrees (WPO, WVO, WEC, WEB, and others). It also modifies the ministerial audit and correction powers in the funding decrees, removing references to sector-law provisions now covered by the Comptabiliteitswet, and sets a minimum of ten pupils for school spin-off funding rules.

This decree corrects technical defects in the Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, mainly clarifying which diplomas remain valid for financial advisers. It also adds transitional rules for providers of life-insurance and premium-pension services and inserts a new Annex B setting out competence end-terms for financial advisers.
Wet op het financieel toezicht 4:9, derde lid

This amending decree (AMvB) revises the Besluit vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen to align it with the new route-regulation system in the Wvgs following the basisnet amendment. It rewrites article 5 on the content of exemption applications and the conditions attachable to exemptions from ministerial routing decisions, and deletes a definition in article 1.
Wet vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen 27, zevende lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation opens a single application window from 1 October to 31 December 2013 for co-financing of sector plans under the Regeling cofinanciering sectorplannen. It sets a subsidy ceiling of 200 million euro for that application window.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation amends the WWB, IOAW and IOAZ regulation and the Participation Budget regulation to update allocation weights and reference dates for 2014, remove references to the withdrawn Wet investeren in jongeren, and end use of the Digitaal Verantwoordingssysteem. It also sets a 0% deficit threshold for 2013 for multi-year supplementary payments and ties the eligibility assessment to municipal annual accounts.
Besluit WWB 2007 8, derde lid, 10 en 10a; Besluit participatiebudget 2, derde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation makes a technical correction to Annex 4 of the Regeling financiën hoger onderwijs, replacing the list of percentage education surcharges (onderwijsopslag) for universities of applied sciences, including the agriculture and natural environment programmes. It takes effect on 1 January 2014 and is needed because of a data inaccuracy in the calculation used to make the abolition of the residence requirement budget-neutral.

This ministerial regulation amends the Subsidy Scheme for low-emission taxis and vans and the Subsidy Scheme for emission-reducing vehicle measures. It ties subsidy eligibility to registration in the vehicle registry, extends eligibility to legal entities and zero-tariff N1 vehicles or taxis, narrows the Utrecht-type municipal supplement to vehicles registered to a legal person established there, and sets the 2013-2014 subsidy ceiling at 32 million euros.
Wet milieubeheer 15.13, eerste tot en met derde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

The regulation amends the Paspoortuitvoeringsregeling Caribische landen to change how passport offices back up data from the travel document station: daily backups are kept on five rotating storage media, with the two oldest kept at the issuing location and the three most recent stored elsewhere. It takes effect on 1 October 2013 and caps the number of storage media in use at five.

This regulation sets rules for a one-off special grant of up to $9.8 million to the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba for nature-conservation projects, including an advisory committee, application requirements, project approval criteria, advance payments and recovery rules. It makes the minister the decision-maker on which projects receive funds, with the advisory committee and reporting duties as checks.
Wet financiën openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba artikel 92, vijfde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

The regulation abolishes the requirement for municipalities and the Caribbean public bodies to commission an external audit of passport security measures every three years, and deletes the accompanying protocol in Annex K. It also fixes a new backup system for the passport issuance station: five storage media per station, daily backups, and the three most recent copies kept off-site.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending regulation changes the Subsidieregeling scholing jonggehandicapten met ernstige scholingsbelemmeringen following an evaluation, limiting eligibility to the most severe group (former class 3) and dropping the class distinctions. It also tightens applicant requirements, adds refusal grounds, changes the subsidy fixing method and advance payment, and removes the transitional supplementary subsidy provision.
Wet werk en arbeidsondersteuning jonggehandicapten 2:29, eerste en tweede lid, en 3:49, eerste en tweede lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This regulation sets the total subsidy ceiling of €53.2 million for schooling institutions under the subsidy scheme for young disabled people with serious schooling barriers, covering 1 January 2014 to 31 July 2020. It divides that ceiling equally into four cohort periods of €13.3 million each.
Subsidieregeling scholing jonggehandicapten met ernstige scholingsbelemmeringen artikel 3

This regulation requires export licences for dual-use goods listed in Annexes I and II when destined for Syria, and for Annex II goods destined for Egypt, and requires licences for brokering services for Annex I goods to Syria. It sets application requirements, permitted licence conditions and restrictions, a duty to return unused licences, grounds for revocation, and repeals the earlier Syria-only regulation.
Wet strategische diensten 4 tot en met 6; Besluit strategische goederen 4
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation amends the regional division of special-education cooperation bodies for primary and secondary schools, mainly to reflect municipal mergers and renamed municipalities without changing the regional boundaries. It also moves Renkum entirely into one primary-education cooperation body after consultation with the region.
Wet op het primair onderwijs 18a, derde lid; Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 17a, derde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This decree amends the General Civil Service Regulations, the Foreign Service Regulations and the transitional decree for FLO functions to change the employment rules for substantially burdensome (SB) functions. It removes the rule barring appointment to SB functions within five years of the earliest dismissal date, lets officials continue working past the SB-entitlement age on medical grounds, and denies the SB benefit to those who used the transitional scheme to move out of an SB function.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation amends the Temporary bridging benefit AOW regulation to correct omissions: it adds a reference to article 2:5 of the general income decree, extends income and asset conditions to include a spouse, widens the excluded-income list (new stamrecht and wachtgeld provisions), and reclassifies information duties under the Maatregelenbesluit socialezekerheidswetten. It also adjusts a 2013 transitional wording on health insurance contributions and takes effect 1 October 2013 with retroactive effect to 1 January 2013.
Kaderwet SZW-subsidies 3, eerste lid, juncto artikel 9
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation amends the Regeling financiën hoger onderwijs to update university and university-of-applied-sciences funding amounts and percentages for 2013 and 2014, sets the statutory collegegeld for 2014-2015, and withdraws the Subsidieregeling tweede graden hbo en wo from 1 January 2014. It is an annual technical budget-implementation instrument with no new policy choices.
Uitvoeringsbesluit WHW 2008 2.2, 4.11, 4.23, 4.24 en 4.27; Wet overige OCW-subsidies 3, eerste lid

The regulation amends the subsidy ceiling table of the 2013 subsidy opening regulation by raising the budget for regular geothermal projects (aardwarmteprojecten) from EUR 30.6 million to EUR 43.35 million. It does so by transferring the unused EUR 12.75 million reserved for deep geothermal projects to the regular geothermal budget, since no successful deep-project application was submitted.

This ministerial regulation sets the reference values (fixed costs, variable costs, boiler and heat exchanger prices and lifespans, efficiency and loss factors) used to calculate the maximum heat price under the Warmtebesluit. It also fills in rules on compensation for prolonged supply outages and on when suppliers may disconnect customers for non-payment, including protections for vulnerable consumers.
Warmtewet 3, vierde lid, en 4, derde lid; Warmtebesluit 3, tweede lid, 4, vierde lid, en 10, tweede lid

This regulation amends the Regeling vervoer over de binnenwateren van gevaarlijke stoffen to let examination candidates with language-related disabilities, such as dyslexia, sit the ADN inland-waterway hazardous goods exams in an adapted form, including up to 30 extra minutes. Eligible candidates must submit a specialist's medical statement or a dyslexia certificate, and the CBR sets the procedure in its examination regulations.
Besluit vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen artikel 2, eerste lid, onder b
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation sets the 2013–2014 amounts for personnel funding in primary education and for the leerlinggebonden budget in secondary special education, updating salary cost norms, per-pupil and per-school amounts across basisscholen, speciale basisscholen, and (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs. It also fixes funding for visually impaired pupil institutions and related special allowances.

Wet op het primair onderwijs 116, 120, zesde lid, 123, eerste en vierde lid, 124, eerste en tweede lid, 125, eerste lid, 129, eerste lid, 132, derde en vierde lid, 137, vijfde lid, en 180a, tweede lid; Wet op de expertisecentra 113, 117, vierde en tiende lid, 120, 124, eerste lid, 131, vierde lid, en 166a, tweede lid; Wet van 16 juli 2005 tot wijziging van ondermeer de Wet op het primair onderwijs, de Wet op de expertisecentra en de Wet medezeggenschap onderwijs 1992 in verband met de invoering van lumpsumbekostiging in het primair onderwijs (Stb. 423) IX; Besluit bekostiging WPO 11a, tweede lid, 17, derde lid, 19, eerste lid, 22, 26 en 28a, tweede lid; Besluit bekostiging WEC 3a, 10b, tweede lid, 30, eerste lid, 31, 35, tweede lid, en 56a, derde lid; Besluit trekkende bevolking WPO B16b, B16g, B16l, B21, C11, eerste en tweede lid, en C16.1; Bekostigingsbesluit WVO 8a, tweede lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation changes two OCW subsidy schemes for teacher training school partnerships: it raises the subsidy ceiling and benefit tiers, requires NVAO assessment details and a reapplication deadline, and sets a 2017 expiry for the reimbursement scheme. It also adds a mbo (vocational) aspirant-partnership project to the 2013-2016 collaboration scheme and adjusts its allocation rules.
Wet overige OCW-subsidies artikel 2, eerste lid, onder a, juncto artikel 4, tweede lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This decree amends the Uitvoeringsbesluit WHW 2008 to reverse the 2012 changes tied to the residence requirement and the long-study-student measure, which were abolished. It also adjusts tuition amounts for 2013–2014, expands the list of programmes exempt from the statutory tuition condition, and makes several technical changes to funding rules.
Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek artikel 2.6, eerste, tweede en vijfde lid, artikel 7.45, eerste, tweede en vijfde lid, en artikel 7.45a, derde lid

This ministerial regulation sets out implementing procedures for police officers who are fully or partly incapacitated for work and receive WAO or WIA benefits, letting them choose leave, payout, or waiver of life-course contributions (levensloopbijdragen) under article 12f of the Bbp. It fixes the notification deadlines, the calculation of leave hours with a fiscal maximum, and the choice rules.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends Annexes 1 and 2 of the Regeling zorgverzekering to update the list of reimbursable registered medicines, adding, replacing and removing entries and revising the dementia treatment condition for galantamine and donepezil. It takes effect on 1 September 2013 and makes routine monthly list changes to reimbursement entitlements.
Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit

This ministerial regulation amends the 2013 opening and subsidy ceilings for the MIT innovation subsidy for SMEs in the top sectors, replacing the schedule in article 3a with reallocated budgets and reopening windows from 25 September to 3 October. It also replaces Annex 3 (Logistiek) of the Subsidieregeling sterktes in Innovatie with a new set of thematic calls for synchromodal transport, international trade facilitation, cross-chain control centres, service logistics and supply chain finance.

This ministerial regulation corrects a clerical error in the Subsidieregeling energie en innovatie by reducing the mandatory company contribution percentage from 50% to 40% for BBE KEW projects in the Biobased Economy cost-reduction tender. It applies retroactively from 3 July 2013, as no applications had yet been submitted in the relevant tender.

This amending regulation removes the statutory placement obligation requiring first-time self-surrender prisoners to be placed in a limited-security institution, deleting the self-surrender category from the selection regulation. It also adjusts the wording of the placement article to reflect the renumbering, and takes effect the day after publication, with a transitional clause keeping already-placed prisoners in place.
Penitentiaire beginselenwet artikel 15, zesde lid, en artikel 19, derde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

The regulation amends the model voter card (model J 7) in the Modellenregeling Kieswet en Kiesbesluit 2010 so that it covers the 2013 by-elections for municipal councils in De Friese Meren, Heerenveen, Leeuwarden and Alphen aan den Rijn held on 13 November 2013. It is a technical update to the model form, entering into force the day after publication in the Staatscourant.

The regulation sets out the method and formula for calculating the individual inhaaltoelage bezwarende functie (iTBF), a supplementary life-course allowance for police officers who lost Afup guarantee years, so they can reach a 76% of middle salary early retirement target at age 60. It also specifies that the ABP computes the percentage, the competent authority adopts it after ABP advice, and the affected officer is notified in writing.
Besluit bezoldiging politie 12d, vierde en vijfde lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling aanwijzing administratief-technische functies so that the old reference to the opbouw of the specific part of the opbouwreglement is replaced by the entitlement to the toeslag bezwarende functie. It also abolishes the AFUP-garantieregeling, implementing the 2005–2007 police collective labour agreement arrangements on early retirement, pre-pension and life-course saving.
Besluit algemene rechtspositie politie 10, derde lid, 88a, vijfde lid, en 88b, tweede lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This regulation replaces Annex 2 of the 2013 statistics regulation for WWB, IOAW and IOAZ, effective 1 January 2014. It adds the participation ladder to the municipal re-integration statistics, replaces re-integration position codes with it, and clarifies the codes for reason for ending a provision.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

The regulation updates two civil-registry fee amounts in the Legesbesluit akten burgerlijke stand from 1 January 2014, raising the copy/extract fee from €12.10 to €12.50 and the marriage capacity declaration fee from €21.70 to €22.30. The adjustment follows the consumer price index formula set out in the Besluit itself.
Legesbesluit akten burgerlijke stand artikel 1, tweede lid

This amending regulation updates the Syria dual-use goods regulation to align with EU Regulation 697/2013: most chemical and material listings are removed because they now fall under EU Regulation 36/2012, while medical laboratory equipment and internal-repression goods are kept or newly subjected to licensing via a new annex II. It also removes CAS-number references and makes a cross-reference correction.
Wet strategische diensten 4 tot en met 6; Besluit strategische goederen 4
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation fixes, for school year 2014–2015, the list of screening and test instruments that may be used for the indication of leerwegondersteunend onderwijs (LWOO) and praktijkonderwijs (PrO) placement by the regional referral committees (RVC-VO). It repeals the 2013–2014 regulation and sets validity periods and category rules for the instruments.
Besluit RVC's en regionaal zorgbudget artikel 3, vierde lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling schorsing geldigheid kentekenbewijs by adding an article stating that a suspension of a vehicle registration certificate ends after one year. It implements a delegation from the amended Wegenverkeerswet, moving the suspension term from the statute to ministerial regulation while keeping the length unchanged.

This ministerial regulation amends the Binnenvaartregeling to recognise two Croatian inland navigation skipper certificates (type A and type B) for navigation on Dutch rivers, canals and lakes following Croatia's EU accession. It implements Council Directive 2013/22/EU and is given retroactive effect to 1 July 2013.
Binnenvaartbesluit artikel 17, vierde lid, onderdeel a

This ministerial regulation amends the Syria Sanctions Regulation 2012 to implement EU Council Decision 2013/255/CFSP and Regulation 697/2013, updating the exemption cross-references and the competent authority, and extending the ban on military goods originating in Syria. It is a technical implementation of EU sanctions adopted under the Sanctiewet 1977.
Sanctiewet 1977 artikel 2, tweede lid, en artikel 3

This regulation fixes the physical and visual features of the insurance plate for non-registered motor vehicles, including size, shape, letter and digit format, and a fixed rotation of colour, text order and placement of the year designation. It takes effect on 1 January 2014 and repeals the earlier 2013 plate regulation and several moped plate regulations.

Besluit van 16 september 1965, houdende vaststelling van het bewijs van verzekering voor de niet-kentekenplichtige motorrijtuigen en enkele regelen met betrekking tot het bewijs van vrijstelling (Stb. 1965, 414) artikel 3, derde lid

This regulation lifts the temporary restricted zone around a poultry farm in Tzum (Friesland) that was set up after low-pathogenic avian influenza was found there, effective 27 August 2013. It removes the relevant section and annex from the Regeling tijdelijke maatregelen dierziekten, as permitted 21 days after the first cleaning and disinfection of the farm.

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling subsidieplafond StAB 2012-2013 by adding a 2014 subsidy ceiling of €5,377,000 for the Stichting Advisering Bestuursrechtspraak voor Milieu en Ruimtelijke ordening and renaming the regulation to Regeling subsidieplafond StAB. It takes effect on 1 October 2013 and reflects a reduction of €23,000 compared with the 2012 and 2013 ceilings as part of government spending cuts.
Besluit subsidiëring stichting advisering bestuursrechtspraak milieu en ruimtelijke ordening artikel 3

This amending regulation updates the Dutch aviation examination rules after CBR took over written theory examinations from 1 January 2013 and EU Regulation 1178/2011 applied from 8 April 2013. It changes examination procedures, admission, fees references, review deadlines and allows use of EASA licences for Annex II aircraft.
verordening (EU) nr. 1178/2011 n.v.t.; Besluit bewijzen van bevoegdheid voor de luchtvaart 5, 8, eerste en derde lid, 9, 10, tweede lid, 13, tweede lid, 14, vierde lid, 15, 16 en 30, derde lid

The regulation amends the Regeling beoordeling reinigbaarheid grond 2006 to add cold immobilisation of contaminated soil as a treatment alternative to cleaning, including criteria for when soil counts as immobilisable and the minister's statement on which techniques apply. Wet bodembescherming 28a; Besluit stortplaatsen en stortverboden afvalstoffen 1, eerste lid, onderdelen 17, onder a en b, 30 en 31

This amending regulation adds a new subsection to the Subsidieregeling energie en innovatie creating a subsidy tender for Dunne Film PV projects, covering subsidy rates, consortium requirements, ranking criteria and refusal grounds, plus a Programme line annex with priority themes. It also adds the tender to the subsidy-opening table in the Regeling openstelling en subsidieplafonds EZ 2013.

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling waterschapsverkiezingen 2008 by updating a ministry name and a statutory cross-reference, and replaces Annex 1 with neutral model ballot-return forms for postal voting in water board elections. The neutral models remove logos and data specific to the merged Vechtstromen water board so they can be reused in future elections.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends Annexes 1 and 2 of the Regeling zorgverzekering, updating which registered medicines are covered under basic health insurance, with entries added, replaced and removed. It also changes reimbursement conditions for fingolimod and adds a new lixisenatide condition, effective 1 August 2013.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation sets out rules for subsidising personnel costs of higher-vocational teacher-training partnerships that design educational minors in bachelor programmes for 2013–2016, with two application rounds and a cap of EUR 150,000 per recipient. It defines eligible activities, application requirements, deadlines, payment and recipient obligations such as cooperating with monitoring research.
Wet overige OCW-subsidies artikel 2, eerste lid, onder a, juncto artikel 4, tweede lid

This amendment reopens a 2013 subsidy window for Dutch participants in the CATRENE nano-electronics innovation projects, changing the application period to 6 to 20 September with a budget of EUR 8.6 million. It is a technical update to the subsidy ceilings regulation, with the entry into force deviating from the usual fixed change moments.

This ministerial policy rule sets the procedure for appointing an adviser or advisory committee to assess planning-damage compensation claims arising from energy infrastructure projects, including challenge (wraking) rights and hearing and advice timelines. It does not create binding general rules but provides a practical procedural framework under Article 4:81 Awb.

The regulation amends the Regeling tarieven Plantenziektenwet to align minimum phytosanitary inspection frequencies with a June 2013 EU amendment, raises the inspection rate for Chinese wooden packaging carrying natural stone from 15% to 50%, and introduces a new fee for inspection requests not filed through the electronic CLIENT Import system. It also removes the Ugandan rose entry from the annex and sets fees per tonne for Chinese wooden packaging inspections.

This temporary Regeling exempts farmers from the statutory ban on applying slurry to arable land from 1 to 15 September 2013, due to an unusually wet and cold spring. The exemption applies only if a green manure crop is sown by 16 September or bulbs are planted, and it sets sowing and ploughing conditions for green manure nitrogen norms.
Wet Bodembescherming 64, tweede en derde lid; Meststoffenwet 38, eerste en derde lid

This amending regulation to the fisheries implementing regulation allows eel-trap fishers, under the autumn eel closure, to fit a 60 mm, maximum 30 cm PVC escape pipe at the rear of the trap so that eels can escape while fishing for mitten crab. It also shifts the closed Molenrak area in the Wadden Sea 600 metres westward to avoid a gas pipeline, without changing its size.
Reglement zee- en kustvisserij 1977 3 en 4; Reglement voor de binnenvisserij 1985 6

This amending regulation adds a transitional rule allowing antimicrobials to be dispensed by a veterinarian or pharmacist on prescription until 1 March 2014, and then restricts them to veterinarian-administered use under UDD (strictest) channelling. It also creates Annex 9, which lets livestock keepers above certain herd thresholds administer antibiotics themselves only if they meet conditions on a written vet agreement, regular farm visits, a herd file and quantity limits.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

It is a technical-to-substantive implementing rule under the Kaderwet SZW-subsidies, giving the minister discretion to reject applications and to set conditions.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

It also sets time-commitment norms (full-time equivalent weights) limiting how many board and supervisory positions a person may hold at pension funds.
