The regulation amends the Subsidieregeling stageplaatsen zorg II by adding several missing Crebo codes for care and pedagogical training courses to annexes 1 and 2, correcting an omission in the code lists. It takes effect the day after publication and is made retroactive to 1 August 2012 to match the start of the 2012–2013 study year.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This temporary decree (Tijdelijk Besluit Saba Comprehensive School BES) sets aside several provisions of the Wet voortgezet onderwijs BES for the only secondary school on Saba, allowing English-language instruction and examinations (CXC/CSEC and TVET1) and simplified teacher, admission and holiday rules. It is a transitional arrangement that will lapse on a date set by royal decree.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This decree sets minimum requirements that every mandatory meldcode (reporting code) for domestic violence and child abuse must contain, including a step-by-step plan and assigned responsibilities. It also amends the childcare and playgroup quality decree and the Reclassering regulation to require such a code, and limits disclosure of the source of reports to protect reporters.

Beginselenwet justitiële jeugdinrichtingen 5a, vijfde lid; Beginselenwet verpleging ter beschikking gestelden 7b, vijfde lid; Penitentiaire beginselenwet 5b, vijfde lid; Wet Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers 9a, vijfde lid; Wetboek van Strafrecht 16; Leerplichtwet 1969 16, negende lid; Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 1.3.9, vijfde lid; Wet op de expertisecentra 5, vijfde lid; Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek 1.21, vijfde lid; Wet op het primair onderwijs 4b, vijfde lid; Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 3a, vijfde lid; Wet kinderopvang en kwaliteitseisen peuterspeelzalen 1.51a, vijfde lid en 2.9a, vijfde lid; Kwaliteitswet zorginstellingen 3a, vijfde lid; Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 10b, tweede lid en 21f, vierde lid; Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg 40a; Wet op de jeugdzorg 13b, derde lid en 25a, derde lid; Wet publieke gezondheid 15a, vijfde lid

This regulation amends the Regeling wapens en munitie to exempt licensed dealers (erkenninghouders) from the Wet wapens en munitie prohibitions on manufacturing, transforming, repairing for third parties, transferring and possessing airsoft devices, and adds transport to and from the border to the exemptions for airsoft practitioners. It also adds airsoft devices to the list of items excluded from the continuous register requirement for licensed dealers.
Wet wapens en munitie 4, eerste lid, onderdeel e

This decree implements articles 5:3:3 and 5:3:10 of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, designating electronic monitoring as an obligation enforceable in the Netherlands under mutual recognition of supervision measures as an alternative to pre-trial detention. It also fixes the list of 32 offences for which dual criminality is not required, following the EU framework decision 2009/829/JHA.
Wetboek van Strafvordering 5:3:3, tweede lid, en 5:3:10, derde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This experimental decree allows participating Dutch higher-education institutions, for 2013 to 2019, to issue binding study advice (bindend studieadvies) earlier in the first year and later in bachelor programmes, including rejection of students and shortened exam validity. It sets conditions such as support facilities, evaluation and reporting duties, and allows the minister to end the experiment.
Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek 1.7a, eerste en tweede lid

This AMvB amends the Besluit algemene rechtspositie politie and the Besluit bezoldiging politie to replace the old AFUP early-retirement scheme with a general life-course contribution, a PartnerPlusPensioen, and occupational-hazard allowances for police officers. It also restricts early leave and dismissal options, sets transitional rules for affected officers, and makes the changes retroactive to 1 January 2006 with some provisions effective 2016.

This AMvB sets a new fee structure for trustees (bewindvoerders) in the Dutch debt-restructuring scheme for natural persons, combining a looptime-independent and a monthly looptime-dependent amount paid as court-set salary from the estate, topped up by subsidy when the estate is insufficient. It indexes the amounts annually by ministerial regulation, sets an advance of 800 euro per case, and revokes two earlier decrees with transitional rules.
Faillissementswet 320, zesde lid; Wet Justitie-subsidies 48d, eerste lid

This amending regulation waives court filing fees (griffierecht) in civil cases when a special guardian (bijzondere curator) represents a minor in court, following a recommendation by the Children's Ombudsman. It removes the financial barrier to a minor's access to court with effect from 1 October 2013.

Wet griffierechten burgerlijke zaken 4, derde lid, en 21, tweede lid; Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering 28, vijfde lid, en 838; Besluit griffierechten burgerlijke zaken 1; Besluit tarieven in strafzaken 12, vijfde lid

This regulation replaces Annex 8a of the Voorschrift Vreemdelingen 2000, the point system used to assess applications by foreign self-employed entrepreneurs for residence in the Netherlands, with a revised version effective 1 August 2013. The revision makes the scoring of the business plan criterion better suited to knowledge-intensive, innovative freelancers and starters with low initial investment.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This AMvB consolidates the remuneration and allowance rules for elected and appointed political office holders (gezaghebbers, eilandgedeputeerden, eilandsraadsleden and committee members) in the Caribbean Netherlands into one regulation. It introduces a classification system that allows an island public body to be placed in a higher remuneration class for a limited period due to special circumstances, with the Minister deciding after hearing the island council.
Wet openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba 56, eerste, tweede en zevende lid, 78, eerste, tweede en zevende lid, 87, 92, 120, vierde lid, en 121

This Besluit amends several Wft implementing decrees (conduct supervision, market access, prudential rules) to implement the AIFMD (Directive 2011/61/EU) for managers of alternative investment funds and UCITS, mainly by replacing older fund terminology and inserting detailed rules on managers, depositaries, delegation, conflicts of interest, valuation, reporting and marketing to non-professional investors. The text is cut off before its final articles.

Wet op het financieel toezicht 2:66, eerste lid; 2:67b, eerste, tweede en negende lid; 2:69a, vierde en achtste lid; 2:121c, negende lid; 2:121d, negende lid; 2:121e, eerste lid; 2:121g, eerste lid; 3:17, tweede lid, aanhef en onderdeel c; 3:53, derde lid; 3:57, tweede en zesde lid; 3:63, tweede lid; 3:67, vierde lid, onderdeel a; 3:72, vijfde lid; 3:74c; 4:11, derde en vierde lid; 4:14, tweede lid; 4:16, derde lid; 4:25, eerste lid; 4:26, negende lid; 4:37c, negende lid; 4:37e, derde lid; 4:37f, derde lid; 4:37g, tweede lid; 4:37h, tweede lid; 4:37i, derde lid; 4:37k, tweede, derde en zesde lid; 4:37l, vierde lid; 4:37m, tweede lid; 4:37n; 4:37o, zesde lid; 4:37p; 4:37t, eerste lid; 5:19a en 5:25c

This amendment to the Besluit uitvoering EU-verordeningen financiële markten adds EU regulations 345/2013 (European venture capital funds) and 346/2013 (European social entrepreneurship funds) to its scope. It designates the Autoriteit Financiële Markten as supervisor and sets which articles can be enforced by penalty payments or administrative fines, with fine categories.
Wet op het financieel toezicht 1:25, derde lid, 1:79, eerste lid, onderdeel b, 1:80, eerste lid, onderdeel b, en 1:81

This ministerial regulation corrects a clerical error in the 2013 indexation regulation for the expense allowance under the Besluit rechtspositie leden gerechtsbesturen en Raad voor de rechtspraak, changing the amount from €4.861 to €4.801 in the first sentence. It applies retroactively from 1 January 2013 because the correct amount was already used in practice.
Besluit rechtspositie leden gerechtsbesturen en Raad voor de rechtspraak 9b
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This Regeling of the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport amends the Regeling tegemoetkoming chronisch zieken en gehandicapten and the Regeling zorgverzekering, updating annexes listing aids and medicines and setting the 2012 general allowance per insurer and the 2013 own-risk compensation. It also provides that earlier annex versions continue to apply to benefits for which they were in force.

Wet tegemoetkoming chronisch zieken en gehandicapten artikel 5, negende lid, onderdeel c; Zorgverzekeringswet artikel 75, derde lid, onderdeel e; Besluit tegemoetkoming chronisch zieken en gehandicapten artikel 2, eerste lid, onderdelen a, b, c, e, f en g, en artikel 2, tweede lid, onderdeel a; Besluit zorgverzekering artikel 3a.1, eerste lid, onderdelen a en b

The regulation amends the LNV subsidy rules and the 2013 opening decree to open the Groen en Doen volunteer subsidy for applications from 1 October to 15 November 2013 with a 750,000 euro ceiling. It removes the project-completion and reporting obligations from the subsidy rules and replaces lottery ranking for same-day applications with ranking by exact time of receipt.

This amending regulation changes the Regeling financieel beheer politie so that self-developed police software is expensed through the operating account instead of being capitalised as tangible fixed assets. It also raises the ICT reserve ceiling in article 23 from €326 million to €365.6 million, in connection with the opening balance of the national police.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation instructs the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit to set a vereffeningbedrag (clawback amount) under the Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg, to reconcile regional ambulance providers' declared revenues with their budgets from 2014. It also introduces a new budgeting system for ambulance care, shifting funding toward availability of ambulances and including transitional and budget-neutral arrangements.
Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg artikel 7, artikel 8, artikel 56b

This ministerial regulation amends the LNV subsidy regulation and the 2013 subsidy opening decision to open subsidies for collective projects preparing the introduction of the EU landing obligation, and for sustainable development of fisheries areas. It sets eligibility, ranking criteria, subsidy ceilings, application windows and project deadlines, with the landing obligation text from the EU fisheries policy annexed.
Verordening (EG) nr. 1198/2006 inzake het Europees Visserijfonds 37; Kaderwet LNV-subsidies 2, 4 en 7
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation sets the rules for the annual subsidy the Minister of Interior Affairs grants to the Stichting CAOP, covering secretarial support for advisory bodies, research and facilitation tasks, with a maximum amount set in the budget. It replaces the earlier subsidy regulation after the legal basis changed, includes an equalisation reserve rule, and expires on 1 February 2015.
Kaderwet overige BZK-subsidies 3, eerste lid, en 4, eerste lid, onderdeel d; Kaderbesluit BZK-subsidies 6, vijfde lid, onderdeel b, 11, tweede lid, 18, eerste lid, en 22, vierde lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amendment to the Regeling inburgering sets fixed fees that integration-obligated persons must pay for a medical examination advice (EUR 240.79) and for applications for exemption from the integration obligation (EUR 90 and EUR 150), including transitional-law cases. It also updates the residence-purpose terminology in Annex 1, replacing 'gezinshereniging of gezinsvorming' and deleting 'familiebezoek'.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

The regulation re-establishes the Commissie UFR, an advisory committee of six experts tasked with reviewing the Ultimate Forward Rate method for pension fund discount rates and recommending a realism-monitoring method, running until 1 September 2013. It is re-adopted with retroactive effect from 1 July 2013 because the earlier identical instrument lapsed before the committee finished its work.
Wet vergoedingen adviescolleges en commissies artikel 2
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This regulation amends the policy rules on financial derivatives for Dutch housing associations: it introduces a 'basisrentelening' (basic interest loan) exempt from derivative treatment, restricts housing associations to approved derivative types, requires counterparties to treat them as non-professional investors, and makes the ISDA-based model master agreement, schedule and credit support annex mandatory. It also removes a prior article and substitutes new annexes, which are largely contractual templates protecting supervisory oversight.

The regulation amends the Uitvoeringsregeling AWR 1994 to require charities with ANBI status to publish specified information about their governance, finances, policy and activities on the internet from 1 January 2014. It sets transitional rules for financial statements of earlier years and a later compliance date of 2016 for church groupings.

This regulation amends the Vrijstellingsregeling Wft to exempt bewindvoerders (court-appointed administrators under Book 1 BW) from the licensing requirement for intermediary activities when opening payment or savings accounts for the persons they administer, including linked payment and e-money facilities. It is made retroactive to 26 February 2013, justified by existing court supervision of bewindvoerders and forthcoming quality requirements.
Wet op het financieel toezicht 2:85, eerste lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation sets out when employers are exempt from the statutory ban on reducing working hours during frost, ice or snowfall and during other exceptional non-economic circumstances, and when employees can then claim WW unemployment benefit. It also specifies notification duties to UWV, the conditions under which the exemption lapses, and the procedure for benefit payment.
Buitengewoon Besluit Arbeidsverhoudingen 1945 artikel 8, tweede lid; Werkloosheidswet artikel 18, eerste lid

This amending regulation adds the verhuurderheffing (landlord levy) to the list in article 20(2) of the Uitvoeringsregeling AWR 1994, making electronic filing mandatory for that levy. It follows from the introduction of the Wet verhuurderheffing and applies from the day after publication in the Staatscourant.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This AMvB amends the transitional rules of the 2012 examination decree so that in the first two years of the arithmetic test (rekentoets) candidates must only sit the test to pass secondary school final exams, rather than achieve at least a 5. It replaces a result obligation with an effort obligation for those years and removes the extra resit, with effect from 31 July 2013.
Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 29, vijfde lid

The regulation continues the experiment with strict noise-preferential runway use at Schiphol for the 2013 operating year, which is pursuant to Article 8.23a of the Aviation Act. It sets replacement noise limits (Lden and Lnight) for enforcement points 32 and 33 and others to accommodate the experiment without enforcement action.
Wet luchtvaart 8.23a, eerste lid; 8.27, derde lid; 8.28, vierde lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

The regulation adds the Nederlands Rode Kruis certificate 'Eerste Hulp aan Baby's en Kinderen' to the list of accepted first-aid proof for childminders under the Wet kinderopvang. It also deletes articles 3 and 16 of the Regeling kwaliteit 2012, moving child-abuse reporting code duties into the Besluit kwaliteit in line with the new mandatory reporting code law.
Besluit kwaliteit kinderopvang en peuterspeelzalen 13, derde lid

The regulation raises the fee municipalities pay to the Dienst Wegverkeer for issuing driving licences: from €9.50 to €9.70 for a standard application and from €43.00 to €43.80 for an urgent one. It applies retroactively from 1 January 2013.

This AMvB amends the Besluit uitvoering Crisis- en herstelwet to add a Platform 31 experiment with flexible zoning plans in six municipalities, allowing deviation from listed Wro and Bro articles, a 20-year plan term, a 10-year temporary zoning period, and a three-year planschade foreseeability rule. It also extends the Chw Bijlage I project categories (renewable energy, sustainable mobility, office transformation) and adds two Schiphol-area projects to Bijlage II.
Crisis- en herstelwet 1.2 en 2.4, eerste lid

The regulation amends the 2013 subsidy opening and ceiling regulation to reopen the Eurostars innovation project tender from 18 to 30 July 2013 with a budget of EUR 6,560,000, replacing the earlier January window and budget of EUR 4,560,000. It takes effect the day after publication and leaves information obligations unchanged.

This AMvB amends the Reglement rijbewijzen to raise the age at which older drivers must undergo medical fitness checks from 70 to 75, with corresponding adjustments to licence age limits and validity rules. It is a technical implementing amendment effective 1 January 2014, following the move of these age rules from the Wegenverkeerswet into the Reglement.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending decree changes the Implementing Decree on the Tuition and Course Fees Act 2000 so that the annual course fee rate is fixed before 1 October rather than by 31 March, and makes lesson-fee instalments six equal payments of 16.67% instead of unequal 25%/12.5% amounts. It also replaces the paper giro payment card with a payment request containing the payment details.
Les- en cursusgeldwet artikel 5, vierde lid, en artikel 6, vierde lid

This ministerial regulation implements the EU AIFM Directive on cross-border cooperation and information exchange between financial supervisors, and amends the Vrijstellingsregeling Wft and Uitvoeringsregeling Wft to remove exemptions no longer allowed under the directive. It also makes technical renumbering and terminology changes tied to the Wft amendment act of 25 June 2013.
Wet op het financieel toezicht 1:51e, 1:65, zesde lid, 1:69, derde lid, 1:105, 2:66a, 3:3, 3:7, 4:7, 5:68, 5:81 en 5:87

This ministerial regulation amends the Uitvoeringsregeling zeevisserij to update references to the 2013 EU fishing-opportunity regulations (Regulations 39/2013 and 40/2013, as amended by 297/2013) and replaces annexes 4 to 6, 8 and 9 with the revised catch bans, national and EU quotas, discard percentages and landing allowances. It is a technical annual update that implements EU quota decisions without changing policy choices.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation amends the Arbeidsomstandighedenregeling and the Warenwetregeling drukapparatuur to correct certification details, update certification scheme references, and rename inspectorates to Inspectie SZW and Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport. It also adds transitional recognition for certain asbestos supervisor and remover certificates and clarifies crane operator qualification rules.

Algemene wet erkenning EG-beroepskwalificaties 33, eerste lid; Arbeidsomstandighedenwet 24; Arbeidsomstandighedenbesluit 1.5f, tweede lid; 1.5h; 2.9, tweede lid; 3.5h, derde lid; 6.14a, vierde lid; 7.32, eerste lid; 9.9b, eerste lid, onderdeel j; Warenwetbesluit drukapparatuur 19a, vijfde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This Regeling by the Minister of Interior Affairs amends the SiSa information regulation to set new annexes for accountability on specific grants (specifieke uitkeringen) by provinces and municipalities, and revokes the earlier regulation on that subject. It also adds definitions, shifts the publication of annexes to inspection at the ministry, and sets retroactive effect dates.
Financiële-verhoudingswet 17a, derde lid; Besluit begroting en verantwoording provincies en gemeenten 58a, tweede lid

This amendment requires the registry of matrimonial property to record not only the date but also the exact time of receipt or registration of divorce, separation or dissolution petitions and related agreements. This makes the moment of dissolution of the community of property, and when it can be asserted against third parties, precisely determinable.

This ministerial regulation amends the 2013 Economic Affairs regulation on subsidy openings and ceilings. It lowers the Borgstelling MKB-kredieten bank-guarantee ceiling from EUR 1 billion to EUR 680 million, creates a new 15 July to 31 December opening for bank guarantees, and opens a second tender for seed capital for technostarters.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation amends the Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet so that pharmacists receive abnormal kidney function values from any practitioner who orders further kidney testing, and so that the list of medicines whose prescribing reason must appear on the prescription is revised (23 substances, with several replaced or added). It also replaces 'de arts' with 'beroepsbeoefenaar' so physician assistants, nurse specialists and midwives are covered.
Geneesmiddelenwet 66a, tweede lid, en 68, tweede lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

A temporary ministerial regulation from the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment that gives musicians and artists whose unemployment (WW) or WIA benefit eligibility lapsed on 1 June 2013 a tegemoetkoming equal to the benefit they would have received under the old rules, valid until 31 December 2013. It sets the eligibility and benefit calculation, UWV administration, financing from the national budget, and a retroactive effective date.
Kaderwet SZW-subsidies 3, eerste lid, en 9; Wet structuur uitvoeringsorganisatie werk en inkomen 32d

This amending regulation updates the Regeling diervoeders 2012 to implement EU Regulation 56/2013 on TSE rules (streamlining Annex IV and removing rules for aquaculture feed) and Implementing Regulation 91/2013 on special conditions for imports of groundnuts, okra, curry leaves and watermelon seeds. It adds notification and prior-notice duties for consignments, restricts entry points for certain imports, and makes violations of listed articles of Regulation 91/2013 punishable.

Verordening (EG) nr. 999/2001 (as amended by Verordening (EU) nr. 56/2013) bijlagen I en IV; Uitvoeringsverordening (EU) nr. 91/2013 gehele verordening; Verordening (EG) nr. 882/2004 officiële controles; Wet dieren 6.2, eerste lid, 6.4, 7.1 en 9.1; Besluit diervoeders 2012 2.1, 2.3 en 2.4
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This amending regulation introduces a fee of 357 euro for a pass and 522 euro for a certificate, valid for three years, replacing the earlier promise of free access tokens for the healthcare BSN system. It also sets a no-refund rule except where the minister finds the circumstances not attributable to the holder, with fees possibly indexed periodically.
Besluit gebruik burgerservicenummer in de zorg artikel 21, tweede en derde lid

This AMvB implements Dutch rules on the reliability (betrouwbaarheid) of road transport operators and transport managers under EU regulation 1071/2009, setting a minimum number of convictions before loss of reliability can be deemed disproportionate, with NIWO deciding and the Minister approving certain decisions. It also amends the Besluit personenvervoer 2000, the Besluit justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens, and makes certain violations economic offences.

Wet wegvervoer goederen 2.1, vijfde lid en 2.8a, zevende lid; Wet personenvervoer 2000 4, vierde en vijfde lid, 5a, vijfde lid, 5b, vierde lid, 76d, 83 en 104; Wet justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens 2, tweede lid, 9, eerste lid, en 13, eerste lid

This AMvB implements the Wet toezicht en geschillenbeslechting collectieve beheersorganisaties auteurs- en naburige rechten by setting a 15% threshold for management costs (comply-or-explain, valid until 1 January 2015), a CPI-based indexation for tariff increases that avoids prior approval by the College van Toezicht, and removing three organisations from the supervised list while fixing a 1 million euro turnover threshold. It is mostly technical, with the cost-threshold clause sunsetting in 2015.
Wet toezicht en geschillenbeslechting collectieve beheersorganisaties auteurs- en naburige rechten artikel 2, tweede lid, onderdeel h, artikel 3, eerste lid, onderdeel c, en artikel 17

This Besluit amends the Besluit markttoezicht registerloodsen to replace the pilotage tariff components (Z- and B-tariffs) with a new structure of a start tariff (S-tarief), a route tariff (T-tarief), and an additional services tariff (A-tarief), effective 1 July 2013. It also sets transitional rules and renumbers provisions, while the ACM retains the power to set the detailed tariff tables and frequency discounts.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This decree amends the Besluit begroting en verantwoording provincies en gemeenten (BBV) to strengthen the soundness and transparency of provincial and municipal budgets and multi-year forecasts, including new requirements on risk management, a list of affiliated parties, incidental income and expenditure, and reserve movements. It also reconstitutes the BBV advisory commission with expanded tasks and membership.
Provinciewet 190, eerste en tweede lid; Gemeentewet 186, eerste en tweede lid

This amending decree adds an article to the Besluit tariefstelling certificaat for sea ships, setting the fee the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport charges for issuing or endorsing a passenger-liability insurance certificate at €129, effective 1 July 2013. The fee is set to recover the cost of the inspection work, and the note explains the immediate entry into force was chosen to avoid the agency being left without fee revenue.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This decree reduces the annual net amount of the AO-tegemoetkoming (disability allowance under the chronic illness and disability compensation act) from €350 to €342 with effect from 1 July 2013. The reduction offsets the cost of paying the allowance retroactively to recipients living abroad in the EU/EEA, Switzerland and treaty countries.
Wet tegemoetkoming chronisch zieken en gehandicapten artikel 10, derde lid

This Royal Decree sets 1 July 2013 as the entry-into-force date of the 2013 amendment act to the Road Tunnel Safety Additional Rules Act, which introduces a safety standard and rules on standardised equipment. If the Staatsblad publishing the decree appears after 30 June 2013, the act takes effect the day after publication.
Wet van 12 juni 2013 tot wijziging van de Wet aanvullende regels veiligheid wegtunnels artikel IV
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This temporary decree adds article 1k to the Besluit uitvoering Wet arbeid vreemdelingen, exempting Dutch companies with at least 50 million euro turnover from the work-permit requirement for foreign employees of a foreign buyer who inspect, certify or are trained on goods being delivered, for projects worth at least 5 million euro and without recent labour-law violations. The exemption lapses automatically on violations or loss of eligibility, is a pilot of about two years from 1 July 2013, and is to be evaluated.
Wet arbeid vreemdelingen artikel 3, eerste lid, onder c
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This AMvB amends the Bouwbesluit 2012 to implement EU Directive 2010/31/EU on energy performance of buildings: it adds definitions for technical building systems, extends the energy requirements to deep renovations (over 25% of the building envelope), and introduces a new section 6.13 setting system efficiency requirements for renovated heating, hot water, cooling and ventilation systems. It takes effect on 1 July 2013 and is a technical implementation of EU requirements.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending decree adjusts the Schattingsbesluit arbeidsongeschiktheidswetten so that the new Ziektewet earnings-capacity test after 52 weeks of sickness can be applied, and aligns the daily-wage and holiday-allowance rules with the new Dagloonbesluit. It also excludes lifecourse savings withdrawn outside unpaid leave from the wage concept, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2013.

This Ministry of Economic Affairs regulation amends the Subsidieregeling energie en innovatie by adding a new section on Topsector energy projects, setting subsidy rules, percentages, caps, and ranking criteria for several programme lines (biobased economy, STEM, green gas, upstream gas, LNG). It also amends the Regeling openstelling en subsidieplafonds EZ 2013.

The regulation temporarily extends willekeurige afschrijving (discretionary first-year depreciation) to investments committed or made between 1 July and 31 December 2013, capped at 50% of cost, and tightens the CO2 threshold for very efficient cars for that period. It also updates the clawback rules and in-use deadlines (now 1 January 2016) for such assets.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation updates the Regeling structurele gegevenslevering WPO/WEC, the programme of requirements for pupil and staff data that schools supply to DUO's BRON system. It changes technical rules on ambulatory support, enrolment age limits for special education, data-check messages, record identifiers, and removes an obsolete staff deduction item while adding the health insurance employer levy.
Wet op het primair onderwijs 178a, derde lid; Wet op de expertisecentra 164a, derde lid; Besluit informatievoorziening WPO/WEC 4
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation amends the VWS subsidy framework regulation to allow subsidies up to €125,000 for patient and disability organisations, and introduces a new route in which subsidies under €25,000 (and now also those up to €125,000 for these organisations) are granted on request and then fixed ex officio, with a mandatory reporting duty for recipients who miss activity deadlines. It also removes an expired sports exception and drops the requirement that subsidies of €25,000 or more be handled under the standard procedure.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

The regulation amends the temporary scheme recognising training courses for radiation protection experts by adding three newly recognised courses at Groningen and Petten. One recognition, for radiodiagnosts and radiologists, takes effect retroactively from 1 April 2013.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation classifies the MERS-CoV coronavirus as a Group A infectious disease under the Public Health Act, thereby making all Group A provisions applicable to it. Besluit inburgering 2.8a, tweede lid; 2.8b, derde lid; 2.12, vierde lid; 3.5, vierde lid; 3.13

This regulation amends the Naturalisation Test Regulation so that a naturalisation applicant who has been exempted from the civic integration obligation by the Minister of Social Affairs (or who holds a DUO advice of non-feasibility) need not sit the naturalisation test. It also sets DUO's criteria for issuing such advice, a EUR 150 fee for a literacy test, and transitional rules for older Regionaal Opleidingencentrum Amsterdam advice.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation sets the accountant control protocol for the 2012 financial year for schools and institutions in Caribbean Netherlands across primary, secondary and vocational/adult education. It establishes the reference framework, required audit products, tolerance levels and procedures the instellingsaccountant must follow.
Wet op het primair onderwijs BES 131, vierde lid, tweede volzin; Bekostigingsbesluit W.V.O. BES 17, zesde lid; Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs BES 2.3.10; Uitvoeringsbesluit WEB BES 5, eerste lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

The regulation sets out the audit protocol that the independent accountant must follow when checking the annual financial accountability of expertise centres for education care (EOZ) on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba for 2012-2013, covering the legality of spending public subsidy funds and the truth and fairness of the accounts. It also fixes tolerance thresholds, reporting duties and the procedure for submitting the accountant's statement to DUO and the ministry.
subsidiebeschikking EOZ van 3 augustus 2012 artikel 10, derde lid

Amends the Uitvoeringsregeling zeevisserij to prohibit possessing more than 25 pieces or 20 kilograms of sea bass and cod caught by recreational fishers at sea and nearby, and prohibits landing filleted or headless sea bass or cod. The aim is to make the EU ban on selling recreational catch enforceable, with an exemption for fish demonstrably from a commercial vessel.
Reglement zee- en kustvisserij 1977 artikel 3, vierde lid

This temporary ministerial regulation exempts farmers from the statutory ban on applying manure without low-emission methods, allowing cattle slurry to be spread evenly on arable land on sandy or loess soil in the peat colonies area where crops are sown or planted, to prevent wind erosion damage. It replaces the earlier 2013 exemption, drops the water-spray and prior-notification requirements, and expires on 1 June 2013.

The Minister of Economic Affairs amends the Subsidieregeling energie en innovatie to split offshore wind subsidy into two tenders (fundamental/industrial and experimental/demonstration), raises the minimum score threshold, adds new ranking and rejection criteria, and updates the innovation-line annex for 2013. It also amends the Regeling openstelling en subsidieplafonds to set the 2013 opening periods and budget ceilings for these tenders.

This amending regulation lets the Minister of Economic Affairs shorten the one-year deadline that nuclear licence holders have to resubmit an updated security package after a change in the reference threat, where circumstances justify it and the holder can reasonably comply. It also updates the name of the responsible ministry and takes effect on 1 July 2013.

This ministerial regulation adds an article to the 2009 Postal Regulation allowing the universal postal service tariffs to rise on average by up to 13% in 2013, instead of the normal cumulative consumer price index cap. It is adopted because falling mail volumes have made the tariffs no longer cost-covering, and it enters into force the day after publication, departing from the cabinet's fixed change dates.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending decree to the Besluit uitvoering Wet arbeid vreemdelingen exempts visiting lecturers (gastdocenten) at higher education institutions from the work permit requirement by admitting them as knowledge migrants, and exempts au pairs, working holiday, EVS and certain exchange participants from the permit requirement for up to one year. It also extends free work rights to dependants of persons holding humanitarian residence permits and makes several technical adjustments to cross-references.
Wet arbeid vreemdelingen 3, eerste lid, onder c

This ministerial regulation amends the Kadaster fee regulation so that the per-quarter-hour surcharge for manual work does not apply when a deed is submitted with a pre-deposited mutation file enabling automated registration, and likewise for apartment-right splitting deeds. It also gives retroactive effect to 1 January 2013 to correct an omission and reduce costs for the target group.

This amending decree restricts the exemption from the landfill ban for non-reinigbare soil, so that such soil may only be landfilled if the minister certifies it is neither cleanable nor cold-immobilisable. Cold-immobilisable soil therefore may no longer be landfilled, reducing landfill use and primary raw material demand.

This amending decree extends the flexibility scheme for non-road mobile machinery engines (type approval under the Besluit typekeuring luchtverontreiniging) to locomotives, implementing EU Directive 2011/88/EU, and updates a ministry name. It adds a definition of the flexibility scheme and a new paragraph allowing certain engines to be placed on the market under the scheme.
richtlijn 2011/88/EU; Wet milieubeheer artikel 9.5.1 Wet milieubeheer

This amending decree adjusts the Besluit externe klachtencommissie raad voor de kinderbescherming: it drops sending complaint decisions to the Minister, requires annual publication of a complaints analysis instead of case-by-case publication, and revises membership rules (up to eight members, a conflict-of-interest bar, looser qualification criteria, and a 'ten hoogste' term limit). It also removes the secretary's pay provision and makes the secretary accountable only to the commission.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This amendment to the Besluit beheer sociale-huursector aligns the maximum rent increase norm for social housing associations with the new income-dependent rent increase rules, setting the base at the basishuurverhogingspercentage (inflation plus 1.5 percentage points). It also excludes income-based rent decreases and increases from the calculation of the average rent rise.

This regulation amends the Regeling universele dienstverlening en eindgebruikersbelangen to require separate disclosure of the call-traffic tariff and the information tariff for 0900, 0906, 0909 and 18 premium numbers, and to cap the per-minute information tariff for 0900 customer-service numbers at zero and the per-call tariff at EUR 1. It extends the cap to all customer-service calls under an existing contract and adds a notification duty for number users to the platform provider.
Telecommunicatiewet 7.8; Besluit universele dienstverlening en eindgebruikersbelangen 3.6a

The regulation sets the maximum amount of 262,186,993 euros available for the life insurer rescue scheme under the Wft for 2013, and 131,093,496 euros per rescue situation and as the amount at material risk of non-repayment. It is adjusted annually based on the percentage development of the total required solvency margin of life insurers supervised by De Nederlandsche Bank, and it takes effect retroactively from 1 January 2013.
Wet op het financieel toezicht 3:156, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation amends chapter 5 of the Subsidieregeling sterktes in innovatie, unifying the subsidy rate for FND-MKB innovation projects at 40 percent and switching the allocation of the subsidy ceiling from order of arrival to ranking of applications. It also sets the 2013 application period and subsidy ceilings for FND feasibility and FND-MKB innovation projects.

This regulation establishes a criminal-intelligence unit (criminele-inlichtingeneenheid) within the NVWA-IOD, the investigative service of the Dutch Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority, and sets out its tasks, data handling, access controls, staff training and information-sharing duties. It replaces the earlier AID-DO unit regulation after the 2012 merger and is largely technical, with no substantive change in policy.
Wet op de bijzondere opsporingsdiensten 12, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation opens subsidy ceilings and conditions for 2013 under the Regeling praktijkleren en Groene plus, covering staff cost rates, the AOC sector plan, labour-market post-initial education, Kies Kleur in Groen, skills competitions, higher green education centres of expertise, and Aequor activities. It sets subsidy maxima, application requirements and reporting duties for each activity.
Kaderwet LNV-subsidies 2 en 4; Regeling praktijkleren en Groene plus 17, eerste lid, en 28, eerste lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This Dutch AMvB (Warenwetbesluit informatie levensmiddelen, 2013) sets national rules on food information to consumers, supplementing and implementing EU Regulation 1169/2011, covering lot identification, language, irradiated foods, health and nutrition claims, and food choice logos. It also amends several sector-specific Warenwet decrees and the fines decree, replacing references to the repealed national labelling decrees with EU regulation references.

Richtlijn 1999/2/EG (ioniserende straling voedsel) artikel 6, eerste en derde lid; Warenwet artikelen 8, eerste lid, 13, 14 en 32b, eerste lid; Wijzigingswet (1988) Warenwet artikel II; Prijzenwet artikel 2b, eerste lid, onder a en b
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

The regulation amends the Uitvoeringsregeling huurprijzen woonruimte by adding a new paragraph 6 that defines the group of chronically ill and disabled households who may object to income-dependent rent increases under article 7:252a of the Civil Code. Eligibility is tied to specified care indications under the AWBZ or a housing adaptation decision issued before 1 May 2013, and the regulation takes effect on 1 May 2013.
Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7 252a, zesde lid, onderdeel a
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This regulation amends the Uitvoeringsregeling huurprijzen woonruimte by updating the maximum rent limits for the period 1 July 2013 to 30 June 2014 and adding a rule that tenants proposing a rent reduction must submit an income statement for all residents and a municipal population extract. It also revises the rent increase schedule to reflect new income-based rent increase rules and withdraws the earlier 2012 amending regulation.
Burgerlijk Wetboek 7:252b, tweede lid; Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte 10, tweede lid; Besluit huurprijzen woonruimte 12, eerste en tweede lid

This regulation amends the Regeling praktijkleren en Groene plus to restructure the funding of green vocational and higher education, introducing a national agenda and multi-year investment programmes with additional allocations for institutions for 2013-2015. It also revokes the Regeling kennisverspreiding en innovatie groen onderwijs and sets subsidy timelines and conditions.

Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 85a, eerste lid, 89, eerste lid en artikel 96d, tweede lid; Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.2.3, tweede lid, en 2.5.3, tweede lid; Uitvoeringsbesluit Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek 2008 4.11, eerste lid; Kaderwet LNV-subsidies 2
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation sets the statutory minimum wage from 1 July 2013 at EUR 1,477.80 per month, EUR 341.05 per week and EUR 68.21 per day, under article 8 of the Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag. The explanatory note sets out the indexation calculation based on the CPB contract wage forecast and includes age-scaled youth minimum wages and hourly equivalents.
Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag artikel 14, tweede en tiende lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending regulation lowers the budget ceiling for the Duurzame inzetbaarheid sectoren component of the ESF 2007–2013 subsidy scheme from EUR 20 million to EUR 10 million and raises the number of concurrent applications an applicant may file. It also adds two new eligible activities, makes recoverable-VAT costs eligible, and removes some limits to increase uptake of the programme.
Kaderwet SZW-subsidies artikel 3, eerste lid, en artikel 5

Amends the LNV subsidy scheme to allow geothermal and geothermal heat-storage energy projects receiving subsidy before 31 December 2013 an extra fifth year to install their systems where installation within four years is unfeasible due to unforeseen circumstances outside the applicant's control. The change is retroactive to 1 January 2013 and deviates from the standard two-month pre-publication rule.

This regulation corrects a clerical error in the Regeling vaststelling definitieve correcties duurzame energieproductie 2012, changing a 2008 correction amount for small solar PV installations from EUR 0.0224 to EUR 0.224 per kWh. It applies retroactively from 23 March 2013 and is explicitly a repair in favour of subsidy recipients.
Besluit stimulering duurzame energieproductie artikel 14, vijfde lid

This regulation transposes the operating rules of Rotterdam The Hague Airport from the old designation decision into the new civil airport regime, including runway data, night closure exceptions, circuit flight bans, noise limit values at enforcement points, and restricted zones. It keeps existing use rights unchanged and is placed on the negative list so that no objection or appeal lies against it.

Wet van 18 december 2008 houdende wijziging van de Wet luchtvaart inzake vernieuwing van de regelgeving voor burgerluchthavens en militaire luchthavens en de decentralisatie van bevoegdheden voor burgerluchthavens naar het provinciaal bestuur (Regelgeving burgerluchthavens en militaire luchthavens) artikel X

This ministerial regulation sets the application and allocation procedure for auction licences for FM, medium wave and Band III commercial radio frequencies (kavels A7, B38, C08 and associated digital radio licences). It specifies bid requirements, deposits, eligibility criteria, anti-collusion rules, the award method and payment regime.
Frequentiebesluit 2013 8, 9, eerste lid, 10, eerste lid, 11, derde lid, en 12
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation updates several OCW regulations to replace references to the Queen with the King following the 2013 accession of the new monarch, and changes the oath text for truancy officers and an OCW delegation list to allow delegation of administrative appeal decisions. It also revokes two obsolete holiday regulations for the Caribbean Netherlands.
Leerplichtwet 1969 artikel 16, tweede lid; Leerplichtwet BES artikel 28, tweede lid; Algemene wet bestuursrecht artikel 10:3

This ministerial regulation amends the indicative list of local and national rules within the scope of the Dutch Services Act (Dienstenwet) by adding, removing and replacing numerous municipal and provincial regulations in the annex. It takes effect on 1 July 2013 and is purely informational, with no material change to obligations or administrative burden.

This regulation amends the LNV subsidy rules for the biodiversity and business module, splitting eligible projects into type a (No Net Loss in general) and type b (technological innovation with a customer), changing cost ceilings, rejection grounds and ranking criteria, and opens a second tender from 1 July to 3 September 2013 with a 4 million euro ceiling. It is an executive subsidy regulation under the Kaderwet LNV-subsidies and the EU de minimis regulation.

verordening (EG) nr. 1998/2006 van de Commissie van de Europese Gemeenschappen van 15 december 2006 betreffende de toepassing van de artikelen 87 en 88 van het Verdrag op de-minimissteun; Kaderwet LNV-subsidies 2, 4 en 7

This ministerial regulation amends four environmental regulations to set measurement accuracy and frequency rules for closed and open ground-source energy (bodemenergie) systems, including temperature and energy-balance monitoring. It also exempts closed systems from mandatory soil investigation and adds energy-performance (SPF) and heat/cold demand data to permit applications, while removing the permit form from the Waterregeling annex.

Activiteitenbesluit milieubeheer 1.7, eerste lid, onder a, en 2.11, tiende lid; Besluit lozen buiten inrichtingen 1.5, eerste lid; Besluit omgevingsrecht 4.4, eerste lid; Waterbesluit 6.11, eerste lid

This amendment adds a fourth paragraph to article 4 of the Besluit bewaren en vernietigen niet-gevoegde stukken, allowing the public prosecutor to issue a generic advance order that lets police destroy intercepted communications with confidants (such as doctors, lawyers-like professionals) without case-by-case prosecutorial review. Police must record destruction in a proces-verbaal sent to the prosecutor, reducing administrative burden substantially.

The regulation amends the Subsidieregeling NER 300 to align Dutch subsidy rules with the European Commission's requirements for funding CCS and renewable energy demonstration projects under the EU ETS NER-besluit, including a second-round application deadline of 15 May 2013. It adjusts subsidy decision procedures, advance payments, combination with EU EERP subsidy, and ex officio finalisation of subsidies.

Amends Annex 1 of the Voorschrift Vreemdelingen 2000 to update the list of airports from which airlines must photocopy, scan or photograph passengers' documents, adding nine airports and removing two. The list is based on recent experience with undocumented arrivals, and the changes take effect 1 May 2013 with less than two months' notice.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation shortens from 14 to 7 days the deadline for primary and special schools to deliver enrolment and deregistration dates of pupils to the basic education register, and shortens from 14 to 7 days the deadline for the minister to process and return that pupil data to municipalities and schools. It also makes several wording corrections to the underlying regulation, effective 1 July 2013.
Wet op het primair onderwijs 178a, derde lid; Wet op de expertisecentra 164a, derde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation removes the rules on the establishment and organisation of the Adviescommissie fusietoets in het onderwijs from the Regeling en beleidsregels fusietoets, moving them into a separate Instellingsbesluit published at the same time. It also adjusts the definitions, rewrites article 4 so the chair may find that advice is unnecessary where a merger is evidently unavoidable, and deletes articles 2, 3 and 5 to 8.

Algemene wet bestuursrecht 4:81; Wet op het primair onderwijs 64c, derde en vierde lid; Wet op de expertisecentra 66c, derde en vierde lid; Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 53h, vierde en vijfde lid; Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.1.11, tweede en derde lid

This amending ministerial regulation opens subsidy windows and sets subsidy ceilings for MKB innovation stimulation (MIT) in additional top sectors (Logistics, Life Sciences and Health, Water, Chemistry/Biobased/Energy, Creative industry) and renumbers and corrects instrument codes in the 2013 openstelling regulation. It also adds annexes for these sectors to the Subsidieregeling sterktes in innovatie.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This decree sets working rules for the Commission for Supervision of Party Finances, including its secretariat, deadlines for issuing advice to the minister, and the duty to inform the minister of any intention to advise a fine. It implements article 35(6) of the Party Financing Act.
Wet financiering politieke partijen 35, zesde lid

A temporary ministerial regulation that exempts, until 1 June 2013, the application of cattle slurry on arable land on sandy or loess soil in the Veenkoloniaal area from the emission-reducing application requirement of the Besluit gebruik meststoffen, to prevent wind erosion damage. The exemption is conditional on simultaneous or immediately following water spraying, prior notification to Dienst Regelingen 24 hours in advance, and application only between half an hour before sunrise and half an hour after sunset.

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling kostenverhaal energie for 2013, updating the amounts that grid operators must pay toward the ACM's general regulatory work, including the fixed and variable tariffs for regional electricity and gas grid operators. It makes purely numerical and reference changes, with no new policy choices.
Besluit kostenverhaal energie 2, derde lid, en 4, eerste lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation amends the subsidy regulation for repurposing monuments by raising the annual subsidy ceilings for feasibility studies and wind- and waterproofing of monuments for the period from 1 October 2012 onward. It is backdated to 1 October 2012 and justified by excess demand and urgency, funded by budget freed from lower restoration subsidy settlements.

This regulation amends the Regeling tijdelijke maatregelen dierziekten to lift the restricted zone around Zeewolde that had been set up after low-pathogenic avian influenza was found on a poultry farm. It removes paragraph 2.1 and annex II, effective 11 April 2013, because the 21-day period after completed cleaning and disinfection has passed.

Richtlijn 2005/94/EG (avian influenza control directive) artikel 45, onderdeel a; Richtlijn nr. 90/425/EEG artikel 10, eerste lid; Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren artikelen 17, 18, eerste en tweede lid, en 30, eerste en derde lid
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends Annexes 1 and 2 of the Regeling zorgverzekering, updating the list of registered medicines covered by basic health insurance from 1 June 2013. It adds, reprices and removes product entries and changes the conditions under which rivaroxaban and apixaban are reimbursed.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation amends Annex 1 of the Regeling zorgverzekering by adding, replacing and deleting entries for registered medicines in the reimbursable benefit list. It is a routine monthly update of the medicines that insured care covers, effective 1 April 2013.

This ministerial regulation amends the Subsidieregeling innoveren and the Regeling openstelling en subsidieplafonds EZ 2013 for innovation performance contract (IPC) subsidies: it removes the topsector-alignment criterion, tightens the list of ineligible costs, and reweights the ranking criteria to 60/40 while opening a 7 million euro tender window from 1 May to 20 June. The amendments are largely technical and administrative, with the policy shift limited to dropping the topsector criterion.

This regulation amends the Regeling tijdelijke maatregelen dierziekten to lift the avian influenza restricted zone in Lochem, deleting references to Annex I and removing that annex. It takes effect on 5 April 2013, lifting the zone 21 days after cleaning and disinfection of the infected farm as required by EU Directive 2005/94/EC.

Richtlijn 2005/94/EG van de Raad van de Europese Unie van 20 december 2005 betreffende communautaire maatregelen ter bestrijding van aviaire influenza artikel 45, onderdeel a; Richtlijn nr.90/425/EEG van de Raad van de Europese Gemeenschappen van 26 juni 1990 inzake veterinaire en zoötechnische controles in het intracommunautaire handelsverkeer artikel 10, eerste lid; Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren artikelen 17, 18, en 30, eerste en derde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

The regulation amends the Vergoedingenregeling Raad voor cultuur to set per-meeting fees for members of the Council for Culture's committees (2.4% of the maximum of salary scale 18, with the chair receiving 130% of the member fee) and makes two technical corrections, including a cross-reference fix in the restitution committee decree. Wet vergoedingen adviescolleges en commissies artikel 2, eerste lid

This ministerial regulation amends Annex 1 of the Regeling GLB-inkomenssteun 2006 and the related policy rules, updating references to the statutory basis for cross-compliance standards and adding a sheep and goat identification and registration obligation. It also narrows which non-compliances count as minor, so farmers face income support reductions for failing to meet these obligations.

Wet publieke gezondheid artikel 4a, eerste en tweede lid

This Order in Council (Besluit voorraadvorming aardolieproducten 2013) implements the Wet voorraadvorming aardolieproducten 2012 by setting the 100,000-ton threshold and 12% stock percentage for mandatory oil stockholding, allowing the minister to reduce the obligation via exemptions, and prescribing procedures and information requirements for transfers and changes of stocks. Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation amends three ministerial regulations on Dutch old-age pension and benefit rules: it changes how days at the start and end of insurance periods are counted, adds a rule for merging partial calendar years for the minimum insurance requirement, and corrects age references in the WWB regulation. It also drops a reference to the half-orphan benefit in a holiday allowance regulation, following the Wet vereenvoudiging regelingen SVB.

This decree amends the Eindexamenbesluit VO and Staatsexamenbesluit VO so that the minister may issue a replacement educational document (such as a diploma, certificate or transcript) to a person whose first name or surname has changed, including transgender people whose names changed under the Civil Code. Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs 29 en 60

Wet op bijzondere medische verrichtingen artikel 6, tweede lid

This temporary ministerial regulation requires a licence from the Minister of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation for exports and brokering of listed dual-use goods destined for Syria that are not in Annex I of Regulation 428/2009. It sets the application contents, the inspector's power to request supporting documents, and conditions, restrictions and revocation grounds for licences, citing the chemical-weapons risk in Syria.
Wet strategische diensten 4 tot en met 6; Besluit strategische goederen 4
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This regulation sets the 2013–2014 amounts for staff funding (personele bekostiging) for primary and special schools under the WPO and WEC, including salary cost norms, per-student and per-school allocations, and personnel/labour market policy budgets. This ministerial regulation updates the monthly norm amounts and standard housing costs used in the creditworthiness test for consumer credit in the Caribbean Netherlands, indexing them to consumer price inflation for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba effective 1 April 2013. It also corrects an erroneous statutory cross-reference from article 7:16 to article 7:17 of the Bfm BES.

Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation corrects a cross-reference error in article 14(4) of the Algemene uitvoeringsregeling stimulering duurzame energieproductie, replacing the reference to the 2013 category designation regulation with the 2012 one and correcting the effective date to 4 April 2013. Besluit stimulering duurzame energieproductie 62, vierde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation sets a per-meeting fee for members and the chair of committees of the Raad voor cultuur, tied to salary scale 18 of the civil servants' pay decree, with the chair receiving 130% of member pay. It also removes an obsolete provision from the Vergoedingenregeling Raad voor cultuur and corrects a cross-reference in the Besluit adviescommissie restitutieverzoeken cultuurgoederen en Tweede Wereldoorlog.
Wet vergoedingen adviescolleges en commissies 2, eerste lid

The regulation amends the LNV subsidies regulation to add a state guarantee scheme for loans financing investments in aquaculture, with eligibility, exclusions, amounts and conditions set out, including a higher 'plus' guarantee for sustainable aquaculture. It also amends the Openstellingsbesluit and the annex on subsidies for techniques reducing fine particulate emissions from agriculture, adding application windows, ceilings and ranking rules.

verordening (EG) nr. 1857/2006 van de Commissie artikelen 87 en 88 van het Verdrag; verordening (EG) nr. 736/2008 van de Commissie artikelen 87 en 88 van het Verdrag; Kaderwet LNV-subsidies artikelen 2, 4 en 7; Regeling LNV-subsidies artikel 1:3

This regulation amends the Subsidieregeling sterktes in innovatie to add new subsidy chapters for SME innovation stimulation in the top sectors (MIT), covering feasibility studies, knowledge vouchers, seconded highly qualified staff, R&D cooperation projects, networking activities and innovation brokers. This amending decree changes the Subsidy Decree for private youth detention institutions so that operating subsidy is differentiated into operational capacity, reserve capacity and decommissioned buildings, with a new hardship clause allowing the Minister to moderate subsidy reductions. It also extends the list of acts requiring ministerial consent to include forming provisions under Dutch Civil Code article 374.

This Besluit amends the Reglement verpleging ter beschikking gestelden, the Penitentiaire maatregel and the Reglement justitiële jeugdinrichtingen to implement the broadened statutory possibility of involuntary medical treatment for detainees, persons under TBS-type detention and young offenders. It sets detailed procedural requirements for treatment plans, multidisciplinary consultation, notification of the supervisory commission, the Minister and the inspector, and mandatory inspection after each involuntary treatment.

Beginselenwet verpleging ter beschikking gestelden 8, derde lid, 16, derde lid, 16c, zesde en zevende lid, 19, tweede lid, 26, derde lid; Penitentiaire beginselenwet 7, vierde lid, 14, vierde lid, 32, tweede lid, 46b, derde lid, 46e, zesde en zevende lid; Beginselenwet justitiële jeugdinrichtingen 7, vijfde lid, 8, zevende lid, 37, tweede lid, 51b, derde lid, 51e, zesde en zevende lid; Wet van 13 september 2012 tot wijziging van de Beginselenwet verpleging ter beschikking gestelden, de Penitentiaire beginselenwet en de Beginselenwet justitiële jeugdinrichtingen (Stb. 2012, 410) artikel VII

This ministerial regulation amends the rules for how bids are submitted in the procedure to designate a provider of the telephone relay (bemiddelingsdienst) service. It adds a fixed annual payment of €750,000 to the designated provider and a 10% discount on the per-minute rate beyond 10 million minutes, and it extends the bid submission deadline.

This Regeling amends the Regeling identificatie en traceerbaarheid van explosieven voor civiel gebruik to implement Directive 2012/4/EU, exempting lonten, slaghoedjes and veiligheidslonten from the unique identification requirement. It also replaces TNO with DCMR Milieudienst Rijnmond as the competent national authority for the tasks under the Directive.
Wet explosieven voor civiel gebruik 3, vierde en vijfde lid

The regulation amends the Regeling niet in betekenende mate bijdragen (luchtkwaliteitseisen) to exclude, for designated areas with high PM10 concentrations, livestock farms emitting more than 800 kg PM10 per year from using the 'not significantly contributing' ground for permits, and corrects an article reference in the air quality assessment regulation. It takes effect the day after publication, with an exemption for applications already submitted.
Besluit niet in betekenende mate bijdragen (luchtkwaliteitseisen) 2, tweede lid; Wet milieubeheer 5.20, eerste lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Uitvoeringsregeling visserij to expand three locations in the Waddenzee and Oosterschelde where mussel seed collection installations (MZI's) may be placed, by changing area descriptions and coordinates. It is issued to enable the mussel sector transition under the Convenant transitie mosselsector en natuurherstel Waddenzee, and it departs from the standard publication timing.

This ministerial regulation sets out which public bodies, services and supervisors the Autoriteit Consument en Markt may share information with, for the performance of their tasks, and gives effect to Article 7(3)(a) of the ACM establishment act. It also amends a series of ministerial regulations to replace the names of the predecessor authorities (NMa, OPTA, CA) with the Autoriteit Consument en Markt and revokes the OPTA board-membership regulation.

This regulation amends the 2013 EZ subsidy openness and ceiling regulation to replace the entry for the ITEA2 innovation projects tender under the Sterktes in innovatie subsidy scheme, setting the window at 22 March to 5 April with a EUR 7,000,000 ceiling. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatscourant and deviates from the standard fixed change-moment policy for urgency reasons.

This amending regulation postpones the entry into force of several market-model regulations from 1 April 2013 to 1 August 2013, aligning them with the introduction of the supplier model for small consumers. It also sets 1 August 2013 as the entry-into-force date for article 9 of the Regeling gegevensbeheer en afdracht elektriciteit en gas.
Elektriciteitswet 1998 26b, eerste lid, 95b, achtste lid, 95cb, zesde lid en 95m, negende lid; Gaswet 12, eerste lid, 44, achtste lid, 44b, zesde lid en 52b, negende lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

The regulation amends the 2012–2013 personnel funding regulation for primary education to add a one-off grant for professionalising school leaders, set at fixed amounts per school for the last seven months of 2012–2013 based on pupil numbers. It also provides that the amount is paid out in one lump sum in May 2013.
Wet op het primair onderwijs artikel 123, eerste lid; Wet op de expertisecentra artikel 120, eerste lid

This regulation amends the Al-Qa'ida Sanctions Regulation 2011 so that the UN sanctions list maintained under Resolution 1267 is used directly, instead of the EU annex to Regulation 881/2002. It extends the freezing measures of Articles 1, 2, 3 and 4(1) of that EU regulation, applied mutatis mutandis, to persons listed by the UN committee but not yet in the EU annex, and makes violation of those measures a prohibited act.
Sanctiewet 1977 artikel 2, tweede lid, en artikel 3

This decree amends two existing decrees under Book 8 of the Dutch Civil Code to align national liability caps for bus and coach passenger transport with EU Regulation 181/2011. It raises the per-passenger injury/death cap to at least EUR 220,000 where the per-event total exceeds EUR 15 million, and sets baggage loss/damage liability at EUR 1,500 per item.

This ministerial regulation sets rules for the tax authority's household-income statement used by landlords to justify income-dependent rent increases. It defines who may request the statement (the holder of the WOZ decision for the dwelling), requires electronic applications, and amends the Uitvoeringsregeling Belastingdienst 2003 to designate the inspector.
Boek 7 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek 252a, tweede lid, onderdeel c, en vierde lid

This temporary ministerial subsidy scheme lets the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment grant one-off subsidies totalling up to EUR 10 million to water boards that extend debt write-offs for residents to include childcare costs, for 2013 to 2017. It sets per-board ceilings, application deadlines, advance payments, reporting duties and audit powers, and ends on 1 January 2018.
Kaderwet subsidies Verkeer en Waterstaat 2, aanhef en onderdeel d, 3 en 4

This temporary regulation sets up a restriction zone around Lochem after a low-pathogenic avian influenza outbreak, banning transport of poultry, eggs, manure, litter and certain vehicle movements within the zone. It adds a new section to the Regeling tijdelijke maatregelen dierziekten and a map annex defining the boundaries.

Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren 17, 18, eerste en tweede lid, 30, eerste en derde lid, 31 en 107; Richtlijn 2005/94/EG (EU directive on avian influenza) implemented; cited as basis; Richtlijn nr. 90/425/EEG 10, eerste lid

This ministerial regulation updates names of agencies and ports across several shipping regulations following the corporatisation of the Port of Amsterdam into Havenbedrijf Amsterdam N.V. It mainly replaces outdated ministry, inspectorate and port references, and designates the Rijkswaterstaat director-general as competent authority for the Noordzeekanaal area with a mandate to the Amsterdam harbour master.

This regulation amends the 2011 regulation setting one-off fees for national commercial radio licences, lowering the fees for licence lots A1, A2 and A3 and A6 after a recalculation of their economic value. The reduction corrects data-entry inconsistencies in the valuation models and is made in the licence holders' favour, with the payment arrangement adjusted accordingly.

The ministerial regulation exempts shipowners of shrimp trawlers (garnalenkotters) under 24 metres and below 750 kW from the minimum crew rules of the Besluit zeevisvaartbemanning, allowing a crew of at least a skipper and deputy skipper for trips up to 48 hours. The exemption is conditional on automated catch processing, a watch-alarm link to autopilot, a safe bulwark or rail, lifejackets on deck, and at least 10 hours between returning and sailing again.
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling subsidie regionale expertisecentra for the AWBZ 2009 package measure, extending the temporary extra support funding for pupils with support needs by one school year, to 2014. It also extends the related cash ceiling and adjusts the deadline for the subsidy's review provision.

This decree amends the Binnenvaartbesluit to allow the minister to exempt certain ferry transport on inland waterways from the Rhine certificate requirement, removes an inspection-frequency provision from the Schepelingenbesluit, and splits the combined SW 4 mariner training into separate helmsman and engineer qualifications in the Besluit zeevisvaartbemanning. It is largely technical, with the training change applied retroactively from 1 June 2012.

Binnenvaartwet artikel 5, tweede lid; Wet van 6 juli 2011 (Stb. 2011, 394) inzake implementatie van het Maritiem Arbeidsverdrag, 2006 artikel XII, tweede lid; Wetboek van Koophandel artikel 407, zesde lid; Zeevaartbemanningswet artikel 19, eerste lid, onderdeel a

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling invoer, uitvoer en verkeer van planten by inserting article 12n, which requires citrus fruit of Brazilian origin to meet the conditions of the annex to Decision 2004/416/EC as last amended by Implementing Decision 2013/67/EU. It implements an EU implementing decision that drops the temporary emergency measures on Xanthomonas campestris while keeping the other measures in force.

Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This AMvB amends the Registratiebesluit BIG to create a legal basis for the Stichting Transparantieregister Zorg to use the BIG registration number when recording financial relations between healthcare professionals and pharmaceutical companies. It also obliges the companies to include that number when reporting such relations.
Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens artikel 24, tweede lid

This amending decree to the Besluit dierlijke producten defines dairy products and gives Stichting COKZ a legal basis to issue public-law export certificates on dairy, infant and follow-on formula quality characteristics, for requests driven by third-country requirements or exceptional circumstances (the latter requiring prior ministerial consent). It also sets a tariff-setting mechanism subject to ministerial approval and formalises an existing practice.

This amending regulation adjusts several Dutch tax and customs implementing regulations to reflect the reorganisation of the Belastingdienst, replacing the 13 regional tax districts with four nationally operating segments led by landelijk directeuren and an algemeen directeur Belastingen. It also updates the appointment of officials as inspecteur and ontvanger, the designation of a belastingdeurwaarder, and the residence-based allocation rules, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2013.

Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen 2, 3, 67 en 84; Invorderingswet 1990 2 en 5; Algemene douanewet 1:3; Douane- en Accijnswet BES 1.1; Belastingwet BES 1.3 en 8.1; Registratiewet 1970 1, 8 en 13; Wet op het centraal testamentenregister 6; Wet openbaarheid van bestuur 14

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling acceptatie afvalstoffen op stortplaatsen to add a new chapter 3a setting conditions for temporary storage of metallic mercury classed as waste at landfills for more than one year (up to five years). It transposes Council Directive 2011/97/EU, covering acceptance criteria, packaging, certification, storage facilities, monitoring, emergency plans, record-keeping and removal to permanent storage abroad.

Richtlijn 2011/97/EU van de Raad van 5 december 2011 tot wijziging van Richtlijn 1999/31/EG met betrekking tot specifieke criteria voor opslag van metallisch kwik dat als afval wordt beschouwd volledige richtlijn; Besluit stortplaatsen en stortverboden afvalstoffen artikel 11f, zevende lid

This amending regulation removes an erroneous cross-reference in the 2013 SDE+ category designation regulation so that heat expansion at waste incineration plants no longer qualifies under the subsidy basis of the Besluit. It also adds a paragraph to the general implementing regulation allowing existing manure co-digestion heat-expansion subsidy recipients on farms to digest plant-based substances as well.
Besluit stimulering duurzame energieproductie 3, eerste lid, onderdeel a, en 62, vierde lid

This amending decree adds new development areas (Rotterdam port area, Bergambacht, Nieuwegein Blokhoeve, Haarlemmermeer Badhoevedorp) and innovative experiments (Eindhoven Spoorzone, Veghel CHV terrain, Flevoland wind turbines, temporary housing and private commissioning in several municipalities) under the Crisis- en herstelwet, and extends the Lelystad Flevokust project. It also exempts certain small structures from the permit application requirement for five years, with the aim of reducing regulatory burden.
Crisis- en herstelwet 1.2, 2.2, eerste lid, 2.4, eerste lid, en 2.18

The regulation amends the Subsidieregeling starten, groeien en overdragen van ondernemingen to replace its chapter 8 with a new state guarantee scheme for ship newbuilding finance, under which the Minister grants a subsidy to a bank in the form of a guarantee covering up to 80 percent of the bank's credit to a Dutch shipyard. It sets eligibility conditions and refusal grounds, a standard guarantee agreement, provisions on fees, reporting and claims, and a transitional deadline for applications on credit agreements concluded from 1 January 2013.
Kaderbesluit EZ-subsidies 4, 5, 15, 16, 17, eerste lid, 18, eerste lid, 19, 25, 30, vijfde lid, 32, derde lid, en 44

This ministerial regulation sets up the Ministry of Economic Affairs' procedure for complaints about undesirable behaviour (harassment, aggression, bullying), appointing confidential counsellors and establishing a complaints committee that investigates and advises the secretary-general. It implements the duty under the Working Conditions Act to prevent psychosocial workload and provides the detailed complaint procedure under the General Administrative Law Act.
Algemene wet bestuursrecht 9:14; Arbeidsomstandighedenwet 3, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation sets out the integrity policy of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, covering oaths, secondary employment, gifts, financial interests and securities holdings, the confidential integrity adviser, and an integrity registration point. It implements Algemeen Rijksambtenarenreglement provisions and a whistleblowing decree, and largely operationalises existing civil-service rules with internal procedures and reporting duties.
Algemeen Rijksambtenarenreglement 51, 61, 61a, 62 en 64, eerste lid; Besluit melden vermoeden van misstand bij Rijk en Politie 8
