This ministerial regulation sets the 2013 per-pupil amount for the regional care budget (EUR 228) and the 2013 supplementary funding per pupil for rebound facilities (EUR 94), and updates the RVC subsidy clawback to be based on 2011 accounts instead of 2010. It is a yearly technical amendment that fixes amounts and reference years under the existing Besluit RVC's en regionaal zorgbudget.

Besluit RVC's en regionaal zorgbudget artikel 5, eerste lid, en artikel 6; Regeling regionaal zorgbudget, subsidie regionale verwijzingscommissies voortgezet onderwijs en reboundvoorzieningen artikel 5

This amending regulation changes how the RDW pays road managers for long-running exceptional-transport exemptions, moving from a per-exemption fee to an annual payment distributed by a fixed key based on each manager's count of incidental exemptions, tied to the introduction of a digital road map. It also sets a nil fee for certain long combination vehicles and renumbers one paragraph without substantive change.

This ministerial regulation amends the Subsidieregeling internationaal excelleren to broaden eligibility for demonstration projects, feasibility studies and advisory subsidies to more emerging markets, tightens some refusal grounds, and sets 2013 subsidy ceilings per instrument and country group. It also extends the Finance for International Business loan to more emerging markets.
Kaderbesluit EZ-subsidies 2, tweede lid, 4 en 16; Algemene wet bestuursrecht 4:81

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling vakbekwaamheid bestuurders 2012 to let the CBR, as designated examination body, suspend or withdraw approvals of practical test providers, training centres and course certifications, and to require training centres to keep proper records and pay fees for supervision and certification. It also adds a rule for the practical trainer re-training examination and corrects earlier omissions.
Reglement rijbewijzen 156c, tweede lid; 156o; 156s, tweede lid; 156w, tweede lid; 156x, eerste en vijfde lid
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This Besluit amends the Bouwbesluit 2012 with technical corrections and simplifications, adding definitions on district heating (warmteplan), changing notification and demolition-notice rules, and revising detailed tables on safety, ventilation and fire protection. It is a technical amendment to building regulations with no new citizen rights or sanctions of note.
Woningwet 2, 3, 6 en 120; Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht 2.26

The regulation amends the Uitvoeringsregeling accijns to remove references to VAT in connection with excise on tobacco, since VAT on tobacco is decoupled from excise from 1 July 2013. It also sets out a transitional refund procedure under which tobacco products held in trade stock at the transition date can have the previously levied VAT refunded to prevent double taxation, with detailed rules and record-keeping obligations.

This regulation amends the annex to the Regeling maximumprijzen geneesmiddelen, replacing the list of maximum pharmacy purchase prices for medicines with an updated 32nd recalibration, effective 1 April 2013. The prices are set as the arithmetic mean of reference-country prices under the Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen.

This Ministry of Finance regulation sets the final attainment levels (eindtermen) and test terms (toetstermen) for the examinations in financial services under the Wft, for each examination module. It assigns each module's annex and defines the taxonomy codes (K, B, V, C) used to indicate required competence levels, and revokes two earlier regulations, effective 1 January 2014.
Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft artikel 9, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation updates the citation of the EU regulation on double-hulled oil tankers in the Dutch implementing regulation, replacing the repealed EC regulation 417/2002 with EU regulation 530/2012 and making minor drafting changes. It changes no substantive prohibitions, obligations or sanctions.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This ministerial regulation amends the Regeling Bouwbesluit 2012, updating references to inspection schemes, standards and correction factors, and adds a definition and a calculation requirement plus a new data requirement to the Regeling omgevingsrecht. It is largely technical, adjusting norm references and procedural details without changing policy choices.

This regulation sets rules for the certification, maintenance and operation of Yakovlev-52 aircraft in the Netherlands, which fall outside EU aviation rules, by providing a special airworthiness certificate based on a basic design and requiring a type rating with specific training and proficiency checks. It also restricts certain uses of these aircraft and amends the Regeling onderhoud luchtvaartuigen to cover them.
Besluit luchtvaartuigen 2008 9, 12, derde lid, 13; Besluit vluchtuitvoering 7, eerste lid; Besluit bewijzen van bevoegdheid voor de luchtvaart 5, 8, eerste lid, 9, 10, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation sets up a compensation fund for individuals whose property was damaged in incidents of group public violence, financed by conditional payments imposed on offenders. It governs eligibility, claim procedures, allocation of available and surplus amounts, and repayment of wrongly paid sums, and it expires on 1 January 2015.
Wetboek van Strafrecht 14c, 141; Wet justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens 39e, eerste lid, onder g, 8a, eerste lid

This Order in Council (Aanbestedingsbesluit) sets technical rules under the Aanbestedingswet 2012 on electronic and other communication in procurement, the own declaration model, the designated offences for the certificate of conduct, and the Gids proportionaliteit and ARW 2012 as binding guidelines. It takes effect on 1 April 2013.
Aanbestedingswet 2012 1.10, derde lid, 1.13, derde lid, 1.16, derde lid, 1.22, eerste lid, 2.84, tweede lid, 4.6, 4.7, eerste lid, onder b, en 4.12, eerste lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation adds a new article to the RDA regulation requiring that the notification for a correction RDA decision be submitted to the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation using a prescribed form, with the form contents set out in an annex. It takes effect on 1 January 2013 and is based on the Besluit RDA.

The regulation amends the Exemption Regulation LVR by adding article 6a, which allows flights outside daylight hours that are part of CPL(A) flight training, subject to conditions such as a filed flight plan, radio contact, minimum visibility and cloud distance, and minimum altitude. It is needed because the Air Traffic Rules otherwise prohibit VFR flight outside daylight, which would hinder obtaining the CPL(A) in the Netherlands.

This amending regulation changes the subsidy rules for manure silos within the POP NU/IMM module, limiting subsidy to silos enlarging storage to 12-14 months and excluding certain storage and manure cellars. It also postpones the second application window to 3-28 December 2012, introduces a flexible budget redistributing unused subsidy ceilings, and makes a minor drafting correction.

This regulation amends the Regeling vaststelling modellen en aanvraagformulieren jacht-, valkeniers- en kooikersakten so that the hunting-permit seals are valid from 1 April 2013 to 31 March 2014 and changes the background colours of the seals for each permit type. This Wijzigingsbesluit amends several executive regulations on police personnel law (rechtspositie) to align them with the Politiewet 2012, including redefining civil servant categories, competent authorities, transfer and disciplinary rules. It also updates references in the Vredesmissies, bezoldiging, werkloosheidsuitkering, Kroonbenoemingen, medaille, misstand-meldingen and overleg/medezeggenschap regulations.

This annual ministerial regulation sets the 2013 design of the insurance plate for non-registered motor vehicles: yellow retroreflective background, black lettering, and the placement of 'Nederland' and '2013'. It also withdraws the 2012 regulation.

This ministerial regulation sets the unit charge for the commercial register at zero euros and the fees for consulting and obtaining register information and products, including new data services, from 1 January 2013. It also adds a rule for partial refund of fees when a person fails to attend an imposed examination without a valid reason, and adds a corresponding no-attendance sanction in the educational-measure and examination provisions.

It fills in the statutory framework with operational procedures and a priority order favouring sustainable generation.

This fourth tranche amending decree of the Besluit uitvoering Crisis- en herstelwet designates additional development areas and innovative projects (such as Soesterberg, Harderwijk, Eerbeek, Tilburg, Arnhem) under the Crisis- en herstelwet, and adds a new category for manure processing installations and new economic projects to the statute's annexes. It also adjusts the mini wind turbine definition, extends groundwater management powers in Tilburg, and creates temporary exemptions from Bouwbesluit 2012 provisions for private-commissioned housing in Almere and an environmental experiment site in Leeuwarden.
Crisis- en herstelwet 1.2, 2.2, eerste lid, 2.4, eerste lid, en 2.18

Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation sets out how tobacco producers and importers must submit ingredient lists electronically via EMTOC to RIVM by 1 October each year, with a signed statement of completeness, and requires RIVM to assess and forward them to the minister and NVWA. It also obliges the minister to publish the public ingredient table annually on the RIVM website, and revokes the 2007 regulation.

This Regeling amends the Activiteitenregeling milieubeheer to add new activity rules, integrate emission requirements for combustion installations from the former Besluit emissie-eisen stookinstallaties, and simplify or correct various provisions. Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation amends the Waterregeling to exempt small groundwater abstractions (dewatering, irrigation, cattle watering and other uses below set hourly volumes) from the water permit requirement in Rijkswaterstaat-managed areas, and replaces several water management maps. Provinces (Gedeputeerde Staten) now decide themselves whether a waste may be landfilled in derogation of the ban, instead of requiring a ministerial declaration, and the minister may designate waste streams by regulation.

Temporarily replaces the noise limit values (Lden) at 35 enforcement points around Schiphol for the 2012 use year, to accommodate groot baanonderhoud (major maintenance of stormwater drainage) on the Buitenveldertbaan. Besluit uitvoering Pensioenwet en Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling artikel 43, tweede lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation sets the maximum reimbursable hourly rates for childcare under the childcare allowance from 1 January 2013, indexing the 2012 rates by 1.52 percent. It applies the indexation mechanism of the Besluit kinderopvangtoeslag and the relocated statutory basis in the Wko.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

This ministerial regulation sets rules for subsidies to institutions training doctors in public health (infectious disease control, youth health care, environmental medicine, tuberculosis control) for the subsidy years 2013 to 2017, distinguishing new intake from continuing training and capping intake under an annual plan. It fixes per-place subsidy amounts, advance payment schedules, application and settlement deadlines, and reporting duties for training institutions.
Ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie

The regulation amends the Regeling werkzaamheden Raad voor plantenrassen to raise the application fee for plant variety approval and breeder's rights, setting a separate higher fee of 468 euro for agricultural crops and 418 euro for horticultural and forestry crops, and raises a second fee from 7.85 to 8 euro, effective 1 January 2013. The explanatory note says the increase is an inflation correction plus a first step toward cost-covering fees for agricultural varieties.
Zaaizaad- en plantgoedwet 2005 artikel 6, tweede lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This amending regulation changes the 2010–2012 Randstad functiemix regulation for secondary-school teachers, extending its dates by one year and raising the available supplementary funding from 52.5 to 61.2 million euros for the second tranche. It also removes a clause linking the budget to 2011 performance and updates the citation title.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending AMvB modifies the Besluit bijstandverlening zelfstandigen 2004 to introduce a normed benefit (baten) figure for municipal business-capital loans, so that municipalities bear more of the cost of poor credit management. It also widens guarantee eligibility to non-bank non-profit microcredit providers, extends the age limit to the AOW pension age, and clarifies that loan repayment on business termination is recoverable under article 58 WWB.

This amending AMvB technically updates the Ambtsinstructie voor de politie and a 1994 designation decree so their cross-references point to the new Politiewet 2012, replacing the former regional police chiefs with the national korpschef and reassigning some functions. It makes no substantive change to police powers, consistent with its stated purpose of technical adjustment.

This AMvB (Besluit verplichte politiegegevens) sets out which police data the police and the Rijksrecherche must process, for which purposes, and how criminal-intelligence units handle criminal intelligence, informant data, exchange and reporting to the national unit. It is based on the Politiewet 2012 and the Wet politiegegevens and takes effect on 1 January 2013.
Politiewet 2012 21, 24 en 54; Wet politiegegevens 6, zesde lid, 11, derde lid, 15, tweede lid

This Order in Council (AMvB) sets detailed rules implementing the Wet op het notarisambt, covering professional entry requirements for notaries, appointment and assistant rules, the register for the notariat, the Commissie toegang notariaat, disciplinary procedure before the kamers voor het notariaat, and enforcement of disciplinary fines. It consolidates and replaces several earlier decrees (Besluit beroepsvereisten kandidaat-notaris, Besluit deeltijd notaris, Besluit kamers van toezicht notariaat) following the 2011 evaluation amendment of the Act.
Wet op het notarisambt 5, vijfde lid, 6, derde lid, 8, vierde lid, 29, vierde lid, 94, tiende lid, en 103a, vijfde lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This AMvB establishes an experimental framework (Experimenteerbesluit vm2) allowing schools and vocational institutions to run an integrated leergang combining the vmbo basisberoepsgerichte leerweg years three and four with the mbo2 basic vocational programme. Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 11a.1, eerste, tweede, zesde en zevende lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This Besluit amends the Uitvoeringsbesluit WHW 2008 in several phases: it introduces a central register rule for student enrolments with data supply obligations for institutions, revises research funding (onderzoekscholen, academic hospital support) and tuition-fee amounts and indexation, and tightens the residence requirement for student status. It also makes many technical and transparency-oriented changes, including repealing an obsolete 1994-1996 dentistry enrolment limit.
Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek 2.6, 6.13, derde lid, 7.45, tweede, derde en zevende lid, 7.45a, derde lid, 7.45b, derde lid, en 7.52, vijfde lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This regulation sets the statutory minimum wage from 1 January 2013 at EUR 1469.40 per month, EUR 339.10 per week and EUR 67.82 per day, under Article 14 of the Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag. This ministerial regulation sets detailed technical standards for accommodation and living facilities aboard seagoing vessels, including sleeping rooms, day rooms, sanitary facilities, sick bays and recreational facilities, implementing the Maritime Labour Convention 2006 and EU Directive 2009/13/EC. It also grants the minister power to grant exemptions from these standards after consultation with shipowner and seafarer organisations.

Wet zeevarenden (Zeevaartbemanningswet, as renamed) 1, tweede lid; 2, eerste, vierde en vijfde lid; 7, derde lid; 19, derde en vierde lid; 20, tweede lid; 21; 22; 22a, vierde lid; 38, derde lid; 48; 48a; 48b; 48c; 48d; 55c, tweede lid; 55e; 62; 66; 69a, tweede lid; 69b, tweede lid; Arbeidstijdenbesluit vervoer 6.4:1, tweede lid; 6.4:2, vierde lid; Besluit zeevarenden handelsvaart en zeilvaart 5; 6, tweede lid; 8, tweede lid; 103, eerste lid; 104; 106, eerste, tweede en derde lid; Binnenvaartbesluit 29, eerste lid

This regulation replaces the annex table of country residence factors (woonlandfactoren) in the 2012 residence-country principle regulation, updating the percentages applied to Dutch benefits paid abroad. Algemene Kinderbijslagwet 12, tweede lid; Algemene nabestaandenwet 17, derde lid, 18, derde lid, 25, tweede lid, 29, derde lid, 29a, achtste lid, en 67, twaalfde lid; Wet op het kindgebonden budget 2, tiende en elfde lid; Wet werk en inkomen naar arbeidsvermogen 62, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation amends the Kentekenregeling so that three-wheeled vehicles in category L5e may, on a voluntary basis, carry the smaller motorcycle licence plate (model 27.10) instead of the car plate. It takes effect on 1 January 2013 and imposes no mandatory exchange of plates.
Wegenverkeerswet 1994 artikel 40, derde lid; Kentekenreglement artikel 2, tweede lid

This regulation amends the 1997 recognition scheme for consumer dispute committees: it broadens the definition of consumer complaint, requires committees to affiliate with the umbrella foundation SGC as a condition of recognition, and removes the requirement to submit a member list while adding SGC annual reporting duties. It also drops the reference to the former Minister of Economic Affairs and updates several procedural points.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This temporary order amends the Besluit uitvoering Pensioenwet en Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling by adding Article 19a, which suspends the duty of pension transfer when the required additional employer contribution exceeds €15,000 and 10% of the transfer value and the employer is a small employer. Small employers are given a month to prove their status and are asked whether they will voluntarily pay, and the scheme lapses when the future transfer regime takes effect.
Pensioenwet 71, zevende lid en 72a, eerste lid; Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling 82, zevende lid en 83a, eerste lid

This decree sets out detailed rules for calculating the annual supervisory fees that financial supervisors charge to supervised persons, based on size metrics and data periods. It also provides reduced fee rates for parties participating fully in a recognised self-regulation scheme and repeals the earlier separate fee regulations that the Wet bekostiging financieel toezicht now covers.

It also opens the 2012 subsidy window and sets a EUR 4 million ceiling for 29 October to 30 November 2012.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This regulation revises the 2012 total cost estimate of the heffingskortingen (tax credits) and the resulting contributions per social insurance fund, lowering the total from €36,606,500,000 to €36,573,230,000 and adjusting the three fund amounts. It follows the Central Planbureau's updated projections and applies the formula set in the Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen.
Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The regulation removes transcatheter heart valve interventions (THIs) from the Planningsbesluit PCI's, ICD's en THI's, so that their planning falls back under the general permit requirement for special cardiac interventions in the Planningsbesluit bijzondere interventies aan het hart 2008. Wet op bijzondere medische verrichtingen 5 en 6, tweede lid
Ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie

This ministerial regulation reopens the mineral concentrate pilot to two new producers for a limited enrolment window, adjusts related article references, and adds a crop-residue substance (chicory root tips) to the list of permitted fertilisers. Archiefwet 1995 9, eerste lid; Archiefwet BES 3 en 8, tweede lid

This ministerial regulation sets out a procedure for resolving disputes in the sectoral consultation (SOBES) for public employees on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, requiring a list of three mediators, notification and meeting deadlines, and mediation by an independent mediator. If mediation fails, parties may jointly seek advice from the Advies- en Arbitrage Commissie Rijksdienst.

This Besluit amends the Besluit algemene regels voor inrichtingen milieubeheer (Activiteitenbesluit) to add agricultural activities (agrarische activiteiten) as a regulated category, replacing the separate landbouwinrichting concept and extending discharge, notification, noise and pesticide-use rules to farms and related activities. It implements several EU water, nitrate, waste and emissions directives and sets out new notification duties, exemptions and maatwerkvoorschriften for competent authorities.

This amending regulation makes a standard subsidy application rejected if the applicant has already started the subsidised activity before filing, and it adjusts patent-cost subsidy terms, removes a relocation-consent requirement, and removes references to repayment exemptions in two innovation subsidy schemes, following a European Commission review. It is framed as technical alignment with EU state-aid frameworks.

This Regeling amends the annex to the Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij by replacing it with a new annex setting ammonia emission factors per animal place for different livestock housing systems. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatscourant.
Wet ammoniak en veehouderij artikel 1, eerste lid
Ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie

This ministerial regulation corrects two clerical errors: it replaces a wrong cross-reference to a paragraph in the Subsidieregeling energie en innovatie, and it changes a date in the Tijdelijke regeling stimulering betere dienstverlening aan bedrijven from 31 December 2012 to 31 December 2013. It takes effect the day after publication and imposes no new administrative burden.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This Dutch AMvB amends the Besluit aanstellingskeuringen and the Besluit klachtenbehandeling aanstellingskeuringen to clarify rules on pre-employment medical examinations, requiring that examinations be done by a company doctor and that employers obtain written advice from one in most cases. It also restructures the complaints commission so that the Sociaal-Economische Raad, rather than the minister, appoints its members, expands its powers, and allows anonymised or, in the public interest, non-anonymised publication of its rulings.
Wet op de medische keuringen artikel 14, eerste en tweede lid
Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This Dutch AMvB (Besluit rijkssubsidiëring instandhouding monumenten 2013) sets rules for state financial support to owners of protected rijksmonumenten, covering low-interest loans and restoration subsidies. It restricts regular multi-year subsidy to normal maintenance, shifts detailed subsidy rules to ministerial regulation, and defines key terms such as owner and separate component.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

This amending decree (AMvB) revises the Inburgering Decree to strengthen the personal responsibility of civic integration obligees: it narrows exemptions, makes the integration exam and language levels stricter, shifts examination to ministerial control, redesigns the social loan (sociale lening) with new amounts, terms and repayment rules, and removes several chapters and provisions. It also makes conforming changes to the Besluit brede doeluitkering, the Besluit participatiebudget and the Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000.

This amending decree changes the funding model for the knowledge centres for vocational education and business (kenniscentra), splitting the national budget into 20% for qualification-structure tasks and 80% for workplace-learning tasks, with new allocation formulas. Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs 2.4.1, eerste lid

This AMvB amends the Besluit capaciteitsverdeling hoofdspoorweginfrastructuur so that, during peak hours on congested main rail lines, regional and national public transport gets priority over conventional, heavy and fast freight on most lines, except a listed set of corridors where freight keeps priority. Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

It is a technical update enabling those elections to proceed under the existing election rules.

This amending decree repairs technical and minor substantive defects across several environmental and transport regulations under the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment, including the Activiteitenbesluit, Besluit milieueffectrapportage, Besluit omgevingsrecht, and inland shipping rules. It updates cross-references, terminology, thresholds and ADNR-to-ADN references, and adds some narrow changes such as new permit grounds and a retroactive transitional rule for Waterbesluit.

Wet milieubeheer 1.1, derde lid, 7.2, eerste, tweede, derde en achtste lid, 8.40, eerste lid, 8.41, eerste lid, 10.41, 10.42, 10.43 en 10.44, derde lid, 21.8; Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht 1.1, derde lid, 2.1, eerste lid, onder i, 2.1, derde lid, 2.4, tweede lid, 2.9a, eerste lid, 2.17, 2.27, eerste lid, en 3.9, derde lid, tweede volzin; Binnenvaartwet 7, tweede lid; Wet vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen 3 en 12; Scheepvaartverkeerswet 4, eerste lid, onder a, en derde lid; Waterwet 6.5, 6.6 en 6.7

It tightens the Minister's instruction power in response to municipal non-compliance, and the Association of Dutch Municipalities objected that no proportionality safeguard was included.

This amendment excludes bestuurders of AM-category mopeds who also hold another licence category from the alcohol lock programme (asp) for drink-driving on a moped, substituting an educational measure or fitness examination instead. Wet milieubeheer 15.13, eerste tot en met derde lid

This ministerial regulation reduces the 2012 budget ceiling for the Valorisatieprogramma subsidy scheme from EUR 25,000,000 to EUR 15,000,000, following a generic subsidy cut in the Lente-akkoord. It states that applications already submitted are unaffected under the Awb rules and that the change does not alter information obligations.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

It takes effect on 1 October 2012 and replaces earlier specific interbestuurlijk toezicht provisions now moved into the Gemeentewet.

Ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie

Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This ministerial regulation sets the procedure for submitting applications to extend the term of existing GSM licences, specifying a filing window of 20 to 25 working days after the auction notice, delivery address and receipt requirements. Besluit continuïteit mobiele telecommunicatiedienstverlening artikel 1, vierde lid
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This amending regulation updates the reference years, data dates and weights of the objective distribution model used to allocate municipal income-support funds (gebundelde uitkering) and the participatieberbudget for 2013. This Order in Council (AMvB) sets out the composition, appointment, powers and procedures of the advisory commission that advises the procurator-general at the Supreme Court on whether a further investigation into a novum in closed criminal cases is desirable, implementing article 462(4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure. Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

It takes effect on 1 September 2011, with retroactive effect if published late.

It takes effect on 1 October 2011 with retroactive effect to 1 July 2011.

Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This ministerial regulation sets the 2010–2011 school-year amounts for personnel funding in primary education, special primary schools, secondary special education, and related schemes such as the leerlinggebonden budget and the municipal education-disadvantage grant. It also adjusts the multiplier for the specific grant to municipalities and provides special funding for boat-owning families' children (schipperskinderen).

This ministerial regulation amends three remuneration and pension decrees for political office-holders in the Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba), correcting an erroneous salary figure, renumbering duplicated articles, and adding rules for offsetting side income and paying permanent acting governors. This decree amends the Besluit deskundigheidseisen gastouders kinderopvang to add a new ground for admission: holding a recognition of professional qualifications under the Algemene wet erkenning EG-beroepskwalificaties for the work a childminder will perform. Amends the Regeling selectie, plaatsing en overplaatsing van gedetineerden to implement the Modernisering Gevangeniswezen by reducing about forty detainee differentiations to six target groups, deleting several articles on special care forms, and renaming Penitentiair Ziekenhuis to Justitieel Medisch Centrum. This AMvB amends the Uitvoeringsbesluit EG-verordening PRTR to implement the 2009 integration of environmental reporting duties into a single integrated PRTR report, adding supplementary reportable data, quality-assurance rules and permit-based reporting options for odour and noise. It also makes related technical amendments to the Besluit emissie-eisen stookinstallaties, Besluit emissie-eisen titaandioxide-inrichtingen, Besluit identificatie en registratie van dieren and Uitvoeringsbesluit Meststoffenwet.
Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer

This decree amends the Besluit biobrandstoffen wegverkeer 2007 by lowering the mandatory blending percentage for biofuels in 2009 from 4.5% to 3.75% and for 2010 from 5.75% to 4.00%. It is adopted because of concerns about the sustainability and indirect effects of biofuel demand, such as food prices and biodiversity loss.

This AMvB amends the Besluit nevenvestigings- en nevenzittingsplaatsen to let cases involving prosecutors' staff be handled at a sitting place in another district, fixes an omission on the Haarlemmermeer status change, and updates court-district lists for municipal mergers in Bennebroek/Bloemendaal and Alkemade/Jacobswoude to Kaag en Braassem. This Order in Council designates two high-speed rail lines (Hoofddorp–Rotterdam West and Barendrecht–Belgian border) as main rail infrastructure under the Railways Act and sets rules for the HSL-levy, a surcharge on track-usage fees intended to recover state construction costs. It fixes how the levy per train-kilometre is calculated, caps HSA's total payments under its concession, and exempts certain unused or disrupted paths.

This amending decree replaces the model report that attending physicians must submit for deaths from euthanasia or assisted suicide, removing the 'nota bene' requiring reporting of psychiatric or dementia-related cases as non-requested deaths and revising the questions. It also gives the model a formal basis under the Burial Act and adds a citation title to the 2002 decree.
Wet op de lijkbezorging artikel 9, tweede lid; artikel 7

This AMvB sets detailed rules for granting legal aid mediation grants (toevoeging ten behoeve van mediation), including eligibility criteria, the client's own contribution (eigen bijdrage), and how mediators are compensated. It applies provisions of the existing legal aid regulations by analogy and sets point-based fee calculations.

Wet op de rechtsbijstand 33e, eerste en derde lid, juncto de artikelen 12, derde lid, 25, zesde lid, 28, tweede lid, 34, vierde lid, 34a, vierde lid, 34d, derde lid, 35, 37, tweede en vijfde lid, en 41

This decree amends the 2007 AMvB that designates items subject to the private copying levy under the Auteurswet and sets the levy amounts, re-enacting the provisions that had lapsed on 1 January 2009 so that the extended freeze of the home-copying regime until 1 January 2010 is legally clear. It restates the levy rates per carrier and provides that the levy scheme lapses on 1 January 2010, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2009.

Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

This AMvB extends the experimental Tijdelijk besluit innovatieve kinderopvang by adding a new paragraph to its article 4 setting an end date of 27 April 2011. It gives retroactive effect to 27 April 2009 where the Staatsblad appears after that date, so the experiment can continue lawfully beyond the four-year limit in article 87 of the Wet kinderopvang.
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This decree exempts certain legal persons without business activity, unincorporated associations without business, church communities and public-law legal persons from the SER levy supplement on Chamber of Commerce registration fees. Wet op de bedrijfsorganisatie 54, tweede lid
Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer

It also deletes related document requirements such as Chamber of Commerce extracts, reducing administrative burdens.
Woningwet 40a, eerste en tweede lid, en 57, tweede en derde lid

This decree amends the Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 to extend the visa-free stay period for certain foreigners in exceptional circumstances, expand exemptions from the requirement of a provisional residence permit (mvv) for Turkish self-employed persons, family members of asylum holders, minors who have lived in the Netherlands for three years, and cases where removal would breach article 8 ECHR, and to regulate exchange programmes and in-person application. Vreemdelingenwet 2000 12, 14, tweede lid, 17, onderdeel g, 24, eerste lid, en 112
Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer

This decree amends three environmental AMvBs (on organic halogen content of fuels, non-notifiable soil remediation cases, and PCB/PCT and chloroethene rules) by replacing references to article 4 of the Sea Pollution Act with references to article 3(1) of that Act, following the 2008 amendment that moved the exemption regime. The changes are purely technical cross-reference updates with no effect on administrative burdens.
Wet bodembescherming 28, vierde lid; Wet milieubeheer 9.2.2.1
Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

The decree amends the Inkomensbesluit Wet WIA so that wages earned before a partially disabled person takes life-course leave or early retirement count as income from work for the WGA earnings test and the earnings-related benefit. It thereby preserves eligibility for wage supplements during such leave, aligning WIA with other disability and leave rules.
Wet werk en inkomen naar arbeidsvermogen 52, vijfde lid, 60, vijfde lid, en 61, negende lid
Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer

This decree amends the Besluit energieprestatie gebouwen to add a definition of air-conditioning systems, remove an expired paragraph, clarify the monument exemption from energy labels, and insert a new Article 3a requiring inspection of air-conditioning systems of 12 kW nominal cooling capacity or more at least every five years by independent qualified or accredited experts. It is adopted to explicitly implement Article 9 of EU Directive 2002/91/EC after the Commission objected to the Netherlands' fragmented approach.

Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

This AMvB amends the Besluit uitvoering Wet arbeid vreemdelingen to widen work-permit exemptions: business meetings and trade-fair work, short development-project visits of up to four weeks, and certain minors in vocational training with medical-stay permits. Wet arbeid vreemdelingen artikel 3, eerste lid, onderdeel c

This amending decree extends the implementing decree on mutual recognition of financial sanctions to confiscation orders, adding a separate certificate model, applying the language regime to confiscation certificates, and applying the list of offences without a double-criminality check. It also replaces the proceeds-sharing article so that distribution is set by ministerial regulation, with the Minister of Justice responsible.
Wet wederzijdse erkenning en tenuitvoerlegging strafrechtelijke sancties 7, eerste lid, 24, tweede lid, 28 en 31, eerste lid

It takes effect on 1 July 2009, with a transitional period allowing products labelled under the old rules to be sold until 31 October 2012.
Warenwet artikel 8, eerste lid, onder c

This AMvB amends the Reglement verkeersregels en verkeerstekens 1990, the Besluit administratieve bepalingen inzake het wegverkeer and a 1994 military traffic decree, mainly to create a milieuzone for lorries via a new sign C22a that closes zones to non-compliant lorries (exemptions by Euronorm and roetfilter, tightening over time), and to raise the speed limit for cars towing light trailers to 90 km/h on motorways, allow children under three on laps in buses, and clarify the red-cross sign over closed hard shoulders. It also makes technical corrections and sets commencement dates.
Wegenverkeerswet 1994 4, eerste lid, 13, eerste lid, 14 en 71
Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer

This Besluit sets out rules on the accountability report and the report on use of advance payments for urban renewal (ISV-2), and it fixes how the investment budget is reduced when agreed performance targets are not met. It specifies the calculation method, the sanction formula, and the transitional and repeal provisions.
Wet stedelijke vernieuwing 13, tweede lid, 16, tweede lid, en 16a, derde lid

It sets out the permit requirement, application procedure via the uniform document, consent and objection deadlines, grounds for refusal, conditions, and obligations to take back non-completed shipments.
Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

Experimentenwet Kiezen op Afstand 4, tweede en vierde lid

This decree sets detailed rules for inland navigation under the Binnenvaartwet, covering market access via Rijnvaartverklaringen and permits, certificates of inspection, crew requirements, skippers' licences (vaarbewijzen) and medical examinations. It is largely technical, with definitions, categories of vessels, validity periods and procedures for certificates and licences.

This amendment to the Besluit participatiebudget creates a temporary financial incentive for municipalities to help inactive people aged 27 or older into jobs of at least 20 hours per week held for six months, allowing them to spend 12,000 euro per placement from the participation budget on other participation-promoting costs in the following year. It also allows advance spending of 6,000 euro per person in 2009 for up to 5,000 placements and applies retroactively from 1 January 2009, expiring on 1 January 2015.
Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit

This AMvB amends the Legkippenbesluit 2003 to ban enriched cages for laying hens, allowing only 'koloniehuisvesting' (colony housing) cages that meet new minimum space and equipment standards. It grants transitional exemptions for enriched cages built or licensed before 18 April 2008 until 31 December 2016 and for battery cages built before 2003 until 31 December 2011.
Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren 35, 38 en 45

This AMvB amends the 2004 decree on annual report content to implement the corporate governance statement requirement of EU Directive 2006/46/EC for listed public limited companies. This amending decree adds an LRIT (long range identification and tracking) chapter to the Besluit gegevens scheepvaart 2007, requiring Dutch-flagged and certain foreign ships to automatically report position data via designated service providers to a central data centre, and lets the minister designate those bodies and set reporting intervals. It also updates a cross-reference in the seafarer training decree to the new EU minimum training directive 2008/106/EC.

This Postal Decree (Postbesluit 2009) implements the Postal Act 2009 by setting rules on which items fall under the universal postal service, its quality and tariffs, liability amounts, and how the regulator's costs are recovered from postal operators. Postwet 2009 artikel 2, eerste lid, onderdeel b, 15, zevende lid, 17, eerste lid, 29, vierde lid, en 65, tweede lid

This amendment adds a new article 3a to the Besluit financieel beheer netbeheerder requiring grid operators, after being split off from production or supply groups, to hold equity of at least 40 percent of total capital as an investment reserve. The requirement may be lowered below 40 percent only where the reduction is fully caused by financing necessary grid investments made after the split, and the requirement does not apply to operators already compliant when the decree takes effect.

This decree amends the Besluit stimulering duurzame energieproductie (SDE) to add bundled applications and offshore wind provisions, adjust basic electricity and gas price formulas, tighten subsidy conditions and reporting, and allow a mandatory implementation agreement and a new innovation subsidy for offshore wind. It also moves previously annual ministerial-regulation elements into the decree itself.

This decree sets national sales and use prohibitions for radar detector devices and keeps the frequency rules for the periodic vehicle inspection (APK), replacing the former Voertuigreglement. This decree amends a number of algemene maatregelen van bestuur to replace references to the Voertuigreglement with references to the new ministerial Regeling voertuigen, following the restructuring of vehicle regulation under the Wegenverkeerswet 1994. It also updates references from directive 70/156/EEG to directive 2007/46/EG and makes some smaller technical changes, including a new provision on the Kentekenreglement for vehicle registration documents.

This amending decree to the Kentekenreglement allows owners to suspend, extend or lift the suspension of a vehicle registration document online via the RDW website using DigiD, instead of only in person at a post office or RDW office. Wegenverkeerswet 1994 67, derde en vijfde lid, 69, tweede lid, en 70, tweede lid

It sets out the topics to discuss, rules on who represents minors and incapacitated adults, and requires a report to parliament within three years.
Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer

This Order in Council (AMvB) sets out detailed rules for the Dutch basic registers of addresses and buildings, specifying the content required for municipal decisions on residential areas, public spaces, numbering, and stand/mooring places. It also designates which documents count as source documents for the address and building registers, and sets rules on data changes, the national facility, and the control elements.
Wet basisregistraties adressen en gebouwen 6, vierde lid, 10, eerste lid, onderdeel a, 17, eerste lid, aanhef en onderdeel b, 19, derde lid, 28, 37, derde lid, en 42, vierde lid

Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid

Warenwet artikel 8, eerste lid, onder b, en artikel 32b, eerste lid

This Dutch administrative decree (AMvB) implements the Rijkswet Kustwacht voor de Nederlandse Antillen en Aruba by setting out the visible markings of Coast Guard vessels and aircraft and a detailed use-of-force instruction covering warnings, permitted weapons, firearms, non-penetrating munitions, handcuffs, pepperspray and mandatory reporting of force incidents. Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer

This AMvB raises court filing fees (griffierechten) and fixed fees (vast recht) under the Algemene wet bestuursrecht, the Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen, the Beroepswet, the Wet bestuursrechtspraak bedrijfsorganisatie, the Wet op de Raad van State, the Wet op de rechtsbijstand and the Wet tarieven in burgerlijke zaken by about 1.1% (with some 2.5% for one fee), effective 1 February 2008. It exempts certain small-scale excavations (e.g. test and survey dredging) from the permit requirement under conditions, sets notification and reporting duties, specifies permit application contents and a fee schedule, and allows a shortened preparation procedure for certain categories.

This AMvB amends the annex to the implementing decree of the Wet melding ongebruikelijke transacties and Wet identificatie bij dienstverlening. It raises the cash-transaction threshold for dealers in high-value goods from EUR 15,000 to EUR 25,000 for objective reporting, and shifts money-transfer reporting so that only the network provider, not the agent, files objective reports on transactions of EUR 2,000 or more.

This AMvB amends the Reglement Dienst Buitenlandse Zaken to limit the state-secretary-level salary supplement for senior foreign-service posts to a fixed 7.5% monthly allowance on the director-general salary, and adds a transitional provision preserving the old state-secretary salary for officials already receiving it. This amendment to the Besluit ammoniakemissie huisvesting veehouderij allows internal offsetting (interne saldering) of ammonia emissions across housing systems within one livestock farm, so that not every system must individually meet the emission limits as long as total emissions are not higher. It also removes the fixed 30 October 2007 deadline for IPPC farms and adds a power for the competent authority to set stricter emission limits or earlier deadlines for IPPC installations.
